    quote: 'This section contains the General Conditions of Contract (GCC) and the Contract Data for BMRCL Tender
      No. `BMRCL/Phase-3/JPN-MRS/Demolition/DLN-P1/2026/157`, concerning partial and full demolition or dismantling
      of buildings and structures identified for Bangalore Metro Rail Project Phase 3.


      The GCC sets out the contractual rights, obligations and procedures of the Employer, the Engineer and the
      Contractor across 18 clauses. The Contract Data gives the project-specific values and options for selected
      GCC sub-clauses.


      This file lists clause headings and sub-clause (x.y) headings only. Deeper numbering (for example 4.2.1 or
      11.1.2) is omitted.'

    source_document: Vol1DLNP1.pdf
    source_sha256: 74441e621d2e627d9132506a894883aff3b5fe3fdfa9600f5be3c7ec394d5c5c
    pdf_pages:

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"1\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 70,\n      \"text\": \"1\
      \      DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION\\n\\n       Definitions    1.1       The following contract terms and\
      \ expressions as used in the contract defined shall\\n                             have the meanings assigned\
      \ to them, except where the context otherwise requires.\\n                           Words indicating persons\
      \ or parties include corporations and other legal entities\\n                                except where\
      \ the context requires otherwise.\\n\\n                        1.1.1     Documents\\n\\n                 \
      \       1.1.1.1    “Appendix/Attachment”  means  the  completed  pages  in   title  Appendix/\\n         \
      \                        Attachment, which are appended to and form part of the Tender.\\n               \
      \         1.1.1.2     “Construction  and/or  Manufacture  Documents”  means   all  drawings,\\n          \
      \                           calculations, computer software (programs), samples, patterns, models, operation\\\
      n                             and maintenance manuals, and other manuals and information of a similar nature,\\\
      n                                      to be submitted by the Contractor.\\n                        1.1.1.3\
      \     “Contract” means the written Contract Agreement, the Letter of Acceptance,\\n                      \
      \         General Conditions of Contract, Special Conditions of Contract, the Employer’s\\n              \
      \                Requirements& Technical specifications, the Tender, the Notice of Invitation to\\n      \
      \                          Tender, Instructions to Tenderers, the Contractor’s Proposal, the Schedules of\\\
      n                         BOQ, Clarifications issued and such further documents which are listed in the Letter\\\
      n                                      of Acceptance or Contract Agreement (if completed).\\n            \
      \            1.1.1.4     “Contract Agreement” means the contract agreement pursuant to acceptance\\n     \
      \                                      letter  referred  to  in Sub-Clause  1.4.   It  shall  also  include\
      \  all subsequent\\n                                    modifications/  amendments  to  record  the  Contract\
      \  as  a  result  of  the\\n                               communications or negotiation proceedings between\
      \ the parties.\\n                        1.1.1.5     “Contractor’s Proposal” means the proposal submitted\
      \ by the Contractor with the\\n                                Tender, as modified and accepted by the Employer\
      \ and included in the Contract.\\n                            Such documents may include the Contractor’s\
      \ preliminary Design.\\n                        1.1.1.6    “Design Data” means all specifications, plans,\
      \ drawings, details, graphs, sketches,\\n                                models, levels, setting-out dimensions,\
      \ calculations duly checked by the Contractor\\n                             and other documents relating\
      \ to the Design of the works prepared or to be prepared\\n                              by or on behalf of\
      \ the Contractor.\\n                        1.1.1.7    “Drawings” means the Employer’s Drawings and the Drawings\
      \ submitted by the\\n                                  Contractor and any modification of such drawings as\
      \ any, from time to time, be\\n                                   furnished or for which the Engineer has\
      \ issued a Notice of No Objection.\\n                        1.1.1.8    “Employer’s Requirements” means the\
      \ description of the scope, standard,\\n                                      specifications, drawings, programme\
      \ of work, indigenisation programme (where\\n                                    applicable) as included in\
      \ the Contract, and any alterations and modifications\\n                                    thereto in accordance\
      \ with the Contract.\\n                        1.1.1.9     “Letter of Acceptance” means the letter from the\
      \ Employer or the Engineer, or a\\n                               person nominated by them on their behalf\
      \ for this purpose, to the Contractor,\\n                                conveying acceptance of the Tender,\
      \ subject to any modifications agreed to\\n                             between the parties and includes advance\
      \ acceptance of the tender.\\n                       1.1.1.10    “Safety, Health and Environmental (SHE) Manual”\
      \ means the Employer’s\\n                             manual containing the requirements and conditions to\
      \ be met during the execution\\n                                      of the Works by the Contractor.\\n \
      \                      1.1.1.11   “Schedules” means the information and data submitted with the Tender, as\\\

          \ by the Contractor.\\n                        1.1.1.3     “Contract” means the written Contract Agreement,\
          \ the Letter of Acceptance,\\n                               General Conditions of Contract, Special Conditions\
          \ of Contract, the Employer’s\\n                              Requirements& Technical specifications,\
          \ the Tender, the Notice of Invitation to\\n                                Tender, Instructions to Tenderers,\
          \ the Contractor’s Proposal, the Schedules of\\n                         BOQ, Clarifications issued and\
          \ such further documents which are listed in the Letter\\n                                      of Acceptance\
          \ or Contract Agreement (if completed).\\n                        1.1.1.4     “Contract Agreement” means\
          \ the contract agreement pursuant to acceptance\\n                                           letter  referred\
          \  to  in Sub-Clause  1.4.   It  shall  also  include  all subsequent\\n                             \
          \       modifications/  amendments  to  record  the  Contract  as  a  result  of  the\\n             \
          \                  communications or negotiation proceedings between the parties.\\n                 \
          \       1.1.1.5     “Contractor’s Proposal” means the proposal submitted by the Contractor with the\\\
          n                                Tender, as modified and accepted by the Employer and included in the\
          \ Contract.\\n                            Such documents may include the Contractor’s preliminary Design.\\\
          n                        1.1.1.6    “Design Data” means all specifications, plans, drawings, details,\
          \ graphs, sketches,\\n                                models, levels, setting-out dimensions, calculations\
          \ duly checked by the Contractor\\n                             and other documents relating to the Design\
          \ of the works prepared or to be prepared\\n                              by or on behalf of the Contractor.\\\
          n                        1.1.1.7    “Drawings” means the Employer’s Drawings and the Drawings submitted\
          \ by the\\n                                  Contractor and any modification of such drawings as any,\
          \ from time to time, be\\n                                   furnished or for which the Engineer has issued\
          \ a Notice of No Objection.\\n                        1.1.1.8    “Employer’s Requirements” means the description\
          \ of the scope, standard,\\n                                      specifications, drawings, programme\
          \ of work, indigenisation programme (where\\n                                    applicable) as included\
          \ in the Contract, and any alterations and modifications\\n                                    thereto\
          \ in accordance with the Contract.\\n                        1.1.1.9     “Letter of Acceptance” means\
          \ the letter from the Employer or the Engineer, or a\\n                               person nominated\
          \ by them on their behalf for this purpose, to the Contractor,\\n                                conveying\
          \ acceptance of the Tender, subject to any modifications agreed to\\n                             between\
          \ the parties and includes advance acceptance of the tender.\\n                       1.1.1.10    “Safety,\
          \ Health and Environmental (SHE) Manual” means the Employer’s\\n                             manual containing\
          \ the requirements and conditions to be met during the execution\\n                                  \
          \    of the Works by the Contractor.\\n                       1.1.1.11   “Schedules” means the information\
          \ and data submitted with the Tender, as\\n                                  included in the Contract.\\\
          n                       1.1.1.12   “Tender or Bid “means the completed offer made by individual, Firm,\
          \ Company,\\n                                   Corporation, Joint Venture or Consortium for the execution\
          \ of the works.\\n                       1.1.1.13    Deleted\\n\\n                       1.1.1.14    “Special\
          \ Conditions of Contract” means any special conditions of contract issued\\n                         \
          \     by the Employer prior to submission of the Tender or negotiated and agreed in\\n               \
          \                       writing by the Employer and the Contractor prior to acceptance of the Tender.\\\
          n                       1.1.1.15   “Works Programme” means the programme showing the sequence, method\

          \ execution (including\\n                                     dismantling/demolition/restoration),  manufacture,\

  text: The Contractor's general obligations include designing (if in scope), executing, completing, testing, and
    commissioning the Works within the Time for Completion and remedying defects, while taking full responsibility
    for the adequacy, stability, and safety of all site operations.

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 77,\n  \"text\": \"  Any  work  necessary  to meet  the  Employer's  Requirements,\
      \  Technical\\n                                   Specifications, the Contractor's Proposal, and Contract\
      \ Forms\\n                               Any work implied by the Contract or arising from the Contractor's\
      \ obligations\\n                                 All works not explicitly mentioned in the Contract but necessary\
      \ for stability,\\n                                completion, safe operation, or reliable and efficient functioning\
      \ of the Works.\\n\\n                      The Contractor shall design (if in the scope of work), manufacture,\
      \ execute, install,\\n                          complete, test and commission, the Works, including providing\
      \ Construction and/or\\n                         Manufacture Documents, within the Time for Completion and\
      \ shall remedy any defects\\n                             within the Contract Period. The Contractor shall\
      \ provide all superintendence, labour,\\n                             Plant, Materials, Contractor’s Equipment,\
      \ Temporary Works and  all other things,\\n                         whether of a temporary or permanent nature,\
      \ required in and for such design,\\n                          manufacture, execution,  installation, completion,\
      \ testing and commissioning and\\n                        remedying of defects.\\n\\n                    \
      \     Before commencing design, (if in the scope of the contract) the contractor shall satisfy\\n        \
      \                   himself regarding the Employer's Requirements &Technical specifications (including\\n\
      \                         design criteria and calculations, if any) and the items of reference mentioned in\
      \ Sub-\\n                        Clause 4.8.\\n                      The Contractor shall give notice to the\
      \ Engineer of any error, fault or other defect in\\n                           the Employer's Requirements\
      \ or such items of reference. After receipt of such notice,\\n                           the Engineer shall\
      \ determine whether Clause 12 shall be applied, and shall notify the\\n                           Contractor\
      \ accordingly.\\n\\n                     The Contractor shall take full responsibility for the adequacy, stability\
      \ and safety of all\\n                             Site operations, of all methods of construction, manufacture,\
      \ and of all the Works,\\n                             irrespective of any approval or consent by the Engineer.\\\
      n\\n                     The Contractor shall be deemed to have satisfied himself before submitting his Tender\\\
      n                        as to the correctness and sufficiency of his Tender to cover all his risks, liabilities\
      \ and\\n                            obligations set out in or implied by the Contract and all matters and\
      \ things necessary\\n                                for the proper Design, manufacture, execution,  installation,\
      \ completion,  testing,\\n                        commissioning of the Works and remedying of the Defects.\\\
      n                     The Contractor acknowledges responsibility for ascertaining and securing at his own\\\
      n                             cost:\\n\\n                                  (a) conditions bearing upon the\
      \ proper transportation, disposal, handling and\\n                                 storage of materials (including\
      \ but not limited to hazardous toxic substances\\n                            and excavated materials);\\\
      n                                  (b)  availability of electricity, water and gas;\\n                   \
      \                (c)  availability of skilled manpower;\\n                                  (d) the character\

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 78,\n  \"text\": \"Security  shall be provided  either the forms  of   a) unconditional\

      \ bond in accordance\\n                                           with provision with set out below;\\n  \
      \                                                 (a) e- Bank Guarantees  shall be from an Indian Schedule\
      \ bank\\n                                                 (excluding Cooperative Banks) or from a schedule\
      \ Foreign Bank as\\n                                                defined in Section 2(e) of RBI Act 1934\
      \ read with Second Schedule.\\n                                           e-Bank Guarantee format is provided\
      \ in the contract forms. All e-\\n                                        Bank Guarantees should be payable\

      \ Venture, e-Bank Guarantees can be\\n                                                 furnished by any member\
      \ or members of the consortium/JV.\\n                                                   (b) The Insurance\
      \ Surety Bond  shall be issued by an Insurance\\n                                     Company   authorized\
      \  by   the   ‘Insurance   Regulatory  and\\n                                          Development Authority\
      \ of India (IRDA).\\n\\n\\n                                 The e-Bank Guarantee shall be denominated in the\
      \ type and proportion of\\n                                         currencies  in which the Contract Price\
      \  is payable. An electronic Bank\\n                                    Guarantee (e-BG) complying with the\
      \ conditions shall also be deemed\\n                                         acceptable.\\n\\n\\n        \
      \                                                                  ii. Performance Security (including Additional\
      \ Performance Security  if any)\\n                                              shall be initially valid and\
      \ enforceable up to 60 days beyond completion\\n                                           period. In case\
      \ the completion period is extended, then the contractor is\\n                                         required\
      \ to extend the validity of Performance Security e-BG/Insurance\\n                                       Surety\
      \ Bond at his own cost. If the contractor fails to extend the validity of\\n                             \
      \            the Performance Security e-BG/Insurance Surety Bond, then Employer shall\\n                 \
      \                        claim the full amount of Performance Security.\\n\\n\\n                         \
      \                                                  iii.  If the offer of the successful Tenderer is considered\
      \ as abnormally low,\\n                                           seriously unbalanced or front loaded in\
      \ the opinion of the Employer, the\\n                                    Employer may require that the amount\
      \ of the performance security set forth\\n                                   above vide sub para (i) be increased\
      \ and an additional performance security\\n                              may be obtained at the expense of\
      \ the Successful Bidder to a level sufficient\\n                                              to protect the\
      \ Employer against financial loss in the event of default of the\\n                                      \
      \  successful bidder under the contract.\\n                                                     iv. The approved\
      \ format is provided in the “contract forms of Contract” and may\\n                                  be modified\
      \ by the employer to comply with the tender condition or any other\\n                                    \
      \  form approved by the Employer.\\n                                             v.  In the case of a Joint\
      \ Venture (JV), the Performance Security may be\\n                                       submitted by any\
      \ one or more of the JV members.\\n                                                     vi. The Extension\
      \ of Time for submission of Performance Security beyond 30\\n                                            \
      \    (Thirty) days up to 60 days from date of issue of LOA may be given by the\\n                        \
      \                   Authority who is competent to sign the Contract Agreement. However, a\\n             \
      \                        Penal Interest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the entire period i.e.,\\n \
      \                                     from the date of issue of LOA to the date of submission of Performance\\\
      n                                            Security.\\n\\n     Forfeiture          4.2.2        Failure\
      \ by the successful tenderer to furnish the required Performance Security\\n                             \
      \           shall constitute grounds for annulment of the contract award and forfeiture of the\\n        \
      \                       Tender Security\\n                             The failed Contractor shall be debarred\
      \ not only from participating in re-tender for\\n                                        that work but also\
      \ in any other tender of BMRCL for a period of one year from date\\n                                     \
      \   of issue of letter of annulment of LOA\\n                             The Performance Security amount\
      \ as may be consider  fit shall be liable to be\\n                                         forfeited by the\
      \ Employer at the discretion of the Employer, in the event of any\\n                                 breach\
      \ of Contract on the part of the Contractor.\\n\\n    Release of        4.2.3       After completion of the\
      \ entire Work, the Performance Security shall be released to\\n    performance                 the Contractor,\
      \ on issue of last Taking Over Certificate if more than one Certificate\\n     security                  \
      \        exist, by the Engineer, in accordance with Sub-Clause 9.1 and 9.2 of these\\n                   \
      \                 Conditions. The release of Performance Security shall not relieve the Contractor\\n    \
      \                            from his obligations and liabilities, to make good that may be detected during\
      \ the\\n                                 Defects Liability Period.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 84,\n  \"text\": \"Access Route    4.11       The Contractor shall be deemed to have\
      \ satisfied himself as to the suitability and\\n                                           availability of\
      \ the access routes he chooses to use. The Contractor shall (as\\n                               between the\
      \ Parties) be responsible for the maintenance of access routes. The\\n                                   \
      \ Contractor shall provide at his cost signs or directions, which he may consider\\n                     \
      \            necessary or as instructed by Engineer for the guidance of his staff, labour and\\n         \
      \                             others. The Contractor shall obtain any permission concessions and related\\\
      n                              easement right that may be required from the relevant authorities for the use\
      \ of\\n                               such routes, signs and directions.\\n                             The\
      \ Contractor shall select routes, choose and use vehicles so that movement of\\n                         \
      \            Contractor’s Equipment, Plant and Materials from and to the Site is limited so that\\n      \
      \                                         traffic is not delayed and damage to highways and bridges is prevented.\
      \ If there\\n                                              is any delay or damage or injury, the cost of rectification\
      \ or reconstruction of\\n                                highways or bridges shall be borne by the Contractor.\
      \ In case of claim arising of\\n                                    the execution of work from any aggrieved\
      \ party, the Contractor shall immediately\\n                                      report the facts to the\
      \ Engineer and negotiate a settlement. The Contractor shall\\n                                   indemnify\
      \ the Employer in respect of all claims, demands, proceedings, damages,\\n                               \
      \       costs, charges and expenses whatsoever arising out of or in relation to any such\\n              \
      \                      matters.\\n                             The Employer will not be responsible for any\
      \ claims which may arise from the use\\n                                     or otherwise of any access route.\
      \ The Employer does not guarantee the suitability\\n                                     or availability of\
      \ any particular access route, and will not entertain any claim for\\n                               any non-suitability\
      \ or non-availability for continuous use during construction of any\\n                               such\
      \ route.\\n\\n    Avoidance of     4.11.1        All operations for the execution of the Works shall be carried\
      \ out so as not to\\n     Interference                     interfere unnecessarily with the convenience of\
      \ the public or the access to public\\n                                     or private roads or footpaths\
      \ or properties owned by the Employer or by any other\\n                                   person.\\n\\n \
      \    Rights of way    4.12       The Employer will acquire and provide land for Permanent Works and right\
      \ of way\\n    and Facilities                   (within BMRCL’s  land)  for access  thereto over routes  established\
      \ by the\\n                                     Contractor. The Contractor shall bear all cost and charges\
      \ for special or temporary\\n                                         rights of way which he may require including\
      \ those for access to the Site. The\\n                                    Contractor shall also obtain, at\
      \ his risk and cost, any additional facility outside the\\n                                       Site which\
      \ he may require for the purpose of the Works. The Employer reserves\\n                                  \
      \  the right to make use of these service roads/rights of way for itself or for other\\n                 \
      \                    contractors working in the area, as and when necessary without any payment to\\n    \
      \                                the Contractor.\\n    Programmes     4.13       The Contractor shall submit\
      \ an Initial programme to the Engineer after receipt of\\n                                    the Letter of\
      \ Acceptance but not later than 28 days from the date of receipt of\\n                                   \
      \    Letter of Acceptance. The Contractor shall also submit a revised programme\\n                       \
      \        whenever the Engineer finds that the previous programme is inconsistent with\\n                 \
      \                    actual progress.\\n\\n                             Each programme shall include the following:\\\
      n                               a    the order in which the Contractor proposes to carry out the Works (including\\\
      n                                    each  stage  of  Design,  procurement,  manufacture,  delivery  to  Site,\\\
      n                                             construction, erection, testing and commissioning),\\n     \
      \                          b      all major events and  activities  in  the progress  of Construction   or\\\
      n                                       Manufacture /Documents; and\\n                                  c\
      \   The sequence of all tests specified in the Contract and Commissioning.\\n                            \
      \   d    Requirement of funds, month wise.\\n\\n                                 Unless otherwise stated in\
      \ the Contract, the programmes shall be developed using\\n                                precedence networking\
      \ techniques, showing early start, late start, early finish and\\n                                       \
      \  late finish dates.\\n\\n                          No  significant  alteration to the programmes, or to\
      \ such arrangements and\\n                                methods, shall be made without obtaining consent\
      \ of the Engineer. If the progress\\n                                        of the Works does not conform\
      \ to the programmes, the Engineer may instruct the\\n                                    Contractor to revise\
      \ the programmes, showing the modifications necessary to\\n                                  achieve completion\
      \ within the Time period for Completion.\\n\\n                             The Engineer shall inform the Contractor\
      \ in writing within 21 days after receipt of\\n                                    the above information;\"\
      \n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 81,\n  \"text\": \"experienced contractor at the time of tender, then the Engineer\
      \ shall take\\n                                such delay into account in determining any extension of time\
      \ to which the\\n                                     Contractor is entitled under the Contract.\\n\\n   \
      \                        h      It shall be the responsibility of the Contractor to ensure that the full extent\\\
      n                                         of the Works under the Contract and the works to be carried out\
      \ by\\n                                  Designated Contractors within the Works or, in, on, under, through\
      \ and over\\n                                     the Site are co-ordinated and integrated in their design,\
      \ manufacture,\\n                                           installation and construction. Such responsibility\
      \ shall neither be mitigated\\n                                    nor in any other way affected by virtue\
      \ of similar responsibilities being\\n                                   placed on other contractors.\\n\\\
      n                         The Contractor shall be deemed to have made adequate allowance in the Contract\\\
      n                               Price and in the Works Programme in respect of these obligations.\\n\\n  \
      \                                                 If any act or omission of the Contractor whether directly\
      \ or indirectly results in the\\n                              delay in the execution of the works of a Designated\
      \ Contractor, the Contractor, in\\n                                 addition to his liability in respect of\
      \ Liquidated damages if they become due, shall\\n                          pay  to the Employer, or the Engineer\
      \ may deduct from  Interim Payment\\n                                  Certificates such amount as the Engineer\
      \ shall have certified in respect of\\n                                 additional payments or costs to the\
      \ Designated Contractor in respect of such\\n                                delay.\\n\\nSub-            \
      \   4.5                         The  Contractor  may  sub-contract  works  only  with   prior  consent  of\\\
      nContractors                            Engineer/Employer and limited to the value as stated in ‘contract\
      \ data’.\\n\\n                                   4.5.1       The Contractor shall not subcontract any part\
      \ of works for which\\n                                 subcontracting is not permitted as stated in Contract\
      \ Data.\\n\\n                                                                ’\\n\\n                     \
      \              4.5.2        Unless otherwise stated in the Special Conditions of Contract.\\n\\n\\n      \
      \                               a) the Contractor shall not be required to obtain consent for purchases of\\\
      n                                      Materials which are in accordance with the standards specified in the\\\
      n                                    Contract or provisions of labour or for the sub-contracts for which the\
      \ Sub-\\n                                       contractor is named in the Contract;\\n                  \
      \                   b) the prior consent of the Engineer shall be obtained for other proposed Sub-\\n    \
      \                                   contractors;\\n                                       c) not less than\
      \ 28 days before the intended date of each Sub-contractor\\n                              commencing work,\
      \ the Contractor  shall  notify the Engineer  of such\\n                                          intention;\
      \ and the Contractor shall give fair and reasonable opportunity for\\n                                   \
      \   contractors in India to be appointed as Sub-contractors.\\n\\n\\n                                   4.5.3\
      \       The Contractor shall be responsible for observance by  all Sub-\\n                               \
      \   contractors of  all the provisions of the Contract. The Contractor shall be\\n                       \
      \          responsible for the acts or defaults of any Sub-contractor, his representatives\\n            \
      \                       or employees, as fully as if they were the acts or defaults of the Contractor, his\\\
      n                                  representatives or employees and nothing contained in above Sub-clause\
      \ (a)\\n                                     shall constitute a waiver of the Contractor’s obligations under\
      \ this contract. The\\n                                 Contractor shall provide to the Engineer the details\
      \ of subcontracts upon\\n                                request of the Engineer. The Contractor shall Endeavour\
      \ to resolve all matters\\n                            and payments amicably and speedily with the sub-contractors.\\\
      n\\n\\n                                     In the event of contractor’s default for payment to any of the\
      \ sub-contractors or\\n                             Vendors of any tier engaged by him for carrying out of\
      \ this Contract, the\\n                             Employer  shall  reserve  the  right  to make payment\
      \  to  such  affected\\n                                 subcontractors or vendors on behalf of contractor\
      \ and further employer may\\n                           engage the same subcontractor or vendor on behalf\
      \ of contractor and make\\n                            payment directly to complete that part of the work\
      \ and any sums so paid\\n                                   including interest shall be debited to the Contractor’s\
      \ account.\\n\\n                                   4.5.4       The   Contractor   shall  ensure   that   their\
      \   Sub-contractors,\\n                                material/equipment suppliers, Consultants and other\
      \ agencies deployed by\\n                            them in connection with execution of the Contract do\
      \ not make any claim or\\n                                   raise any dispute before BMRCL. For this, necessary\
      \ provision is to be made in\\n                                 the agreement between Contractor and their\
      \ Sub-contractors/Consultants/other\"\n}"

- kind: summary
  text: The Contractor must take all reasonable steps to protect the environment both on and off the Site, ensuring
    that emissions, discharges, and effluents do not exceed statutory limits or the Employer's Requirements and
    Technical Specifications, while remaining fully liable for any work stoppage due to statutory contraventions.
  evidence_ids:
  - J0e6a74396167c946
  relation_type: none
  explicitness: not_a_relation
  from_id: ''
  to_id: ''
  id: Ce39b84f3baba8806

  - id: J0e6a74396167c946
    okf_path: OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE.md

    heading: Clause 4 — The Contractor
    source_document: Vol1DLNP1.pdf
    source_sha256: 74441e621d2e627d9132506a894883aff3b5fe3fdfa9600f5be3c7ec394d5c5c
    pdf_pages:
    - 88
    sheet_cells: ''
    json_path: parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json

    json_pointer: /clauses/3/fragments/12
    json_record_id: null
    source_review_status: pending_manual_review
    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 88,\n  \"text\": \"Protection   of  4.17       The Contractor shall take all reasonable\
      \ steps to protect the environment (both on\\n     the                       and off the Site) and to avoid\
      \ injury, damage and nuisance to people and property\\n    Environment                   resulting from pollution,\
      \ noise and other results of his operations. The Contractor\\n                                        shall\
      \ ensure that air emissions, surface discharges and effluent from the Site\\n                            \
      \        during the Contract Period shall not exceed the values indicated in the Employer's\\n           \
      \                     Requirements & Technical  specifications, and  shall not exceed the values\\n      \
      \                              prescribed by law. The Contractor shall conform to the Employer’s Requirements\\\
      n                         & Technical specifications and shall indemnify the Employer against any liability\\\
      n                                     or damages or claims arising out of his operations. The Contractor shall\
      \ be\\n                                    responsible and liable for any stoppage, closure or suspension\
      \ of the works due\\n                                        to any contravention of statutory requirements\
      \ relating to the protection of the\\n                                 environment and shall indemnify and\
      \ keep indemnified the Employer in this\\n                                     regard.\\n                \
      \                     Outline Environmental Plan means the environmental plan forming part of the\\n     \
      \                             Tender, setting out,  in summary form, the Contractor's proposed means of\\\
      n                                 complying  with  his  obligations  in  relation  to  environmental  quality.\
      \  Site\\n                                  Environmental Plan means the site environmental plan including\
      \ all supplements\\n                                       thereto, or any amended or varied version thereof,\
      \ as submitted by the Contractor\\n                                           in accordance with Employer’s\
      \ Safety, Health and Environmental Manual (SHE\\n                                  Manual), this Clause and\
      \ which has received the Engineer’s consent. The Site\\n                                  Environmental Plan\
      \ shall include detailed policies, procedures and regulations\\n                                   which,\
      \ when implemented,  will ensure compliance  with  this  Clause. The\\n                                  \
      \  Contractor is required to make himself aware of  all the requirements of the\\n                       \
      \          Employer’s SHE Manual in this regard and comply with them.\\n\\n                             The\
      \ Contractor's Site Environmental Plan shall be developed from his Employer’s\\n                         \
      \            Safety. Health and Environmental Manual (SHE Manual), as per the Employer's\\n              \
      \                   Requirements.\\n\\n                       4.17.1      Within stipulated time as mentioned\
      \ in ‘contract data’, the Contractor shall submit\\n                              a detailed and comprehensive\
      \ Site Environmental Plan based on the Employer’s\\n                                     Safety, Health and\
      \ Environmental Manual (SHE Manual), and shall include such\\n                                        further\
      \ material, which the Contractor considers necessary and relevant.\\n\\n                            Upon the\
      \ Engineer notifying his consent to the Site Environmental Plan, or any\\n                               \
      \  supplemental part thereof, the Contractor shall adhere to the principles and\\n                       \
      \          procedures contained in such document save to the extent that the Engineer may\\n             \
      \                       give his consent to any amended or varied version thereof.\\n                    \
      \         The Contractor shall provide all necessary access, assistance and facilities to\\n             \
      \                    enable the Engineer and the Employer to monitor and conduct tests to verify that\\n \
      \                                   the Site Environmental Plan is being properly and fully implemented.\\\
      n\\n      Electricity,       4.18      The Contractor shall be responsible for making his own arrangements\
      \ at his own\\n    Water and Gas                cost to obtain supply of water, electricity or gas for the\
      \ Works. The Employer where\\n                                       feasible may at his discretion assist\
      \ the Contractor in giving recommendatory\\n                                           letters etc.\\n   \
      \  Tools, Plants     4.19       Except for any specific item mentioned in the Special Conditions of Contract\
      \ or in\\n    And Equipment              Employer’s Requirements, the Contractor shall provide  all tools,\
      \ plants and\\n    Supplied By                Equipment  for the Works.  In respect  of such exceptional \
      \ tools, plants  or\\n    The Employer              Equipment committed to be provided by the Employer under\
      \ terms and conditions\\n                                      specified in the Special Conditions of Contract,\
      \ the Contractor shall take  all\\n                                  reasonable care and shall be responsible\
      \ for all damages or loss caused by him,\\n                                       his representatives, sub-contractors\
      \ or his workmen or others while they are in his\\n                                   charge.\\n         \
      \                 No  tools, plant and equipment shall be supplied by the Employer. Unless\\n            \
      \                             specifically incorporated in special conditions, the Contractor has to arrange\
      \ all\\n                                          tools, plant, equipment required for the work.\\n      \
      \                   On completion of the Works, the Contractor shall hand over the unused balance\\n     \
      \                                   of the tools, plants and Equipment supplied by the Employer to the Employer\
      \ back\\n                                           in good order and repair, fair wear and tear expected,\
      \ and shall be responsible for\\n                               any failure to account for the same or any\
      \ damage done thereto.\\n                             The decision of the Engineer as to the amount recoverable\
      \ from the Contractor on\\n                                            this account shall be final and binding.\"\
      \n}"

- kind: summary
  text: The Contractor must submit an initial programme within 28 days of receiving the Letter of Acceptance, structured
    using precedence networking techniques, and maintain access routes while indemnifying the Employer against associated
    claims or damage.
  evidence_ids:
  - J18ff8ca501f1ddf3
  relation_type: none
  explicitness: not_a_relation
  from_id: ''

    okf_path: OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE.md

    source_review_status: pending_manual_review
    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 84,\n  \"text\": \"Access Route    4.11       The Contractor shall be deemed to have\
      \ satisfied himself as to the suitability and\\n                                           availability of\
      \ the access routes he chooses to use. The Contractor shall (as\\n                               between the\
      \ Parties) be responsible for the maintenance of access routes. The\\n                                   \
      \ Contractor shall provide at his cost signs or directions, which he may consider\\n                     \
      \            necessary or as instructed by Engineer for the guidance of his staff, labour and\\n         \
      \                             others. The Contractor shall obtain any permission concessions and related\\\
      n                              easement right that may be required from the relevant authorities for the use\
      \ of\\n                               such routes, signs and directions.\\n                             The\
      \ Contractor shall select routes, choose and use vehicles so that movement of\\n                         \
      \            Contractor’s Equipment, Plant and Materials from and to the Site is limited so that\\n      \
      \                                         traffic is not delayed and damage to highways and bridges is prevented.\
      \ If there\\n                                              is any delay or damage or injury, the cost of rectification\
      \ or reconstruction of\\n                                highways or bridges shall be borne by the Contractor.\
      \ In case of claim arising of\\n                                    the execution of work from any aggrieved\
      \ party, the Contractor shall immediately\\n                                      report the facts to the\
      \ Engineer and negotiate a settlement. The Contractor shall\\n                                   indemnify\
      \ the Employer in respect of all claims, demands, proceedings, damages,\\n                               \
      \       costs, charges and expenses whatsoever arising out of or in relation to any such\\n              \
      \                      matters.\\n                             The Employer will not be responsible for any\
      \ claims which may arise from the use\\n                                     or otherwise of any access route.\
      \ The Employer does not guarantee the suitability\\n                                     or availability of\
      \ any particular access route, and will not entertain any claim for\\n                               any non-suitability\
      \ or non-availability for continuous use during construction of any\\n                               such\
      \ route.\\n\\n    Avoidance of     4.11.1        All operations for the execution of the Works shall be carried\
      \ out so as not to\\n     Interference                     interfere unnecessarily with the convenience of\
      \ the public or the access to public\\n                                     or private roads or footpaths\
      \ or properties owned by the Employer or by any other\\n                                   person.\\n\\n \
      \    Rights of way    4.12       The Employer will acquire and provide land for Permanent Works and right\
      \ of way\\n    and Facilities                   (within BMRCL’s  land)  for access  thereto over routes  established\
      \ by the\\n                                     Contractor. The Contractor shall bear all cost and charges\
      \ for special or temporary\\n                                         rights of way which he may require including\
      \ those for access to the Site. The\\n                                    Contractor shall also obtain, at\
      \ his risk and cost, any additional facility outside the\\n                                       Site which\
      \ he may require for the purpose of the Works. The Employer reserves\\n                                  \
      \  the right to make use of these service roads/rights of way for itself or for other\\n                 \
      \                    contractors working in the area, as and when necessary without any payment to\\n    \
      \                                the Contractor.\\n    Programmes     4.13       The Contractor shall submit\
      \ an Initial programme to the Engineer after receipt of\\n                                    the Letter of\
      \ Acceptance but not later than 28 days from the date of receipt of\\n                                   \
      \    Letter of Acceptance. The Contractor shall also submit a revised programme\\n                       \
      \        whenever the Engineer finds that the previous programme is inconsistent with\\n                 \
      \                    actual progress.\\n\\n                             Each programme shall include the following:\\\
      n                               a    the order in which the Contractor proposes to carry out the Works (including\\\
      n                                    each  stage  of  Design,  procurement,  manufacture,  delivery  to  Site,\\\
      n                                             construction, erection, testing and commissioning),\\n     \
      \                          b      all major events and  activities  in  the progress  of Construction   or\\\
      n                                       Manufacture /Documents; and\\n                                  c\
      \   The sequence of all tests specified in the Contract and Commissioning.\\n                            \
      \   d    Requirement of funds, month wise.\\n\\n                                 Unless otherwise stated in\
      \ the Contract, the programmes shall be developed using\\n                                precedence networking\
      \ techniques, showing early start, late start, early finish and\\n                                       \
      \  late finish dates.\\n\\n                          No  significant  alteration to the programmes, or to\
      \ such arrangements and\\n                                methods, shall be made without obtaining consent\
      \ of the Engineer. If the progress\\n                                        of the Works does not conform\
      \ to the programmes, the Engineer may instruct the\\n                                    Contractor to revise\
      \ the programmes, showing the modifications necessary to\\n                                  achieve completion\
      \ within the Time period for Completion.\\n\\n                             The Engineer shall inform the Contractor\
      \ in writing within 21 days after receipt of\\n                                    the above information;\"\
      \n}"

  text: The Contractor bears full responsibility for the safety of the Works, persons, and adjoining properties,
    must implement an approved Site Safety Plan, report serious accidents immediately, and maintain firefighting
    and first aid facilities.
  evidence_ids:
  - Jfad7cf2ceee3f634

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 86,\n  \"text\": \"specifications, tolerances and production output to the entire\
      \ satisfaction of\\n                                 Engineer before commencement of work.\\n\\n         \
      \                                    All plants / equipment deployed on the work shall be of proven efficiency\
      \ and shall\\n                              be operated and maintained  at  all times  in a manner  prescribed\
      \ by the\\n                                  manufacturer and / or acceptable to the Engineer.\\n\\n     \
      \                                        All plants / equipment to be deployed on the work shall carry designated\
      \ authority\\n                                            certificate. Where not specified,  it shall have\
      \ third party safety certificate for the\\n                                   safe working of the equipment\
      \ and shall be renewed after every 3 months. This\\n                                           certificate\
      \ shall be produced to the Engineer as and when required.\\n\\n                                          \
      \   All the construction plant shall be provided with the experienced operators having\\n                \
      \                         valid license issued by the competent authority.\\n                            \
      \ Any material or equipment not meeting the approval of the Engineer shall be\\n                         \
      \     removed from the site immediately.\\n\\n                                             All Contractor’s\
      \ Equipment and Temporary Works provided by the Contractor\\n                                           shall,\
      \ when brought on to the site, be deemed to be exclusively intended for\\n                               \
      \    execution of the Works and not be removed without the consent in writing of the\\n                  \
      \                 Engineer. Such consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.\\n\\n            \
      \           4.15.2     Upon completion of the Works the Contractor shall remove from the Site all the\\n \
      \                                   said Contractor’s Equipment, Temporary works and his unused materials.\\\
      n                       4.15.3     The Employer shall not at any time be liable for the loss or damage to\
      \ any of the\\n                                     Contractor’s Equipment, Temporary Works or materials save\
      \ as mentioned in\\n                                Clause 14.1\\n                       4.15.4       In respect\
      \ of any Contractor’s Equipment which the Contractor shall have imported\\n                              \
      \            for the purpose of the Works, the Employer may assist the Contractor, where\\n              \
      \                        required, in procuring any necessary Government consent for re-export of the\\n \
      \                          same after the completion of the Works.\\n                       4.15.5     The\
      \ Employer may assist (but is not obliged to) the Contractor, where required, in\\n                      \
      \               obtaining clearance through the Customs of Contractor’s Equipment, materials\\n          \
      \                    and other things required for the Works.\\n\\n     Safety of Works  4.16      The Contractor\
      \ shall throughout the execution of the Works including carrying out\\n                                  \
      \         of any testing, commissioning or remedying of any defect:\\n\\n                                \
      \        a. takes full responsibility for the adequacy, stability, safety and security of the\\n         \
      \                         Works, Plant, Contractor's, Temporary Works, operations on Site and methods\\n \
      \                                          of manufacture, installation, construction and transportation;\\\
      n                                        b. have full regard for the safety of all persons on or in the vicinity\
      \ of the Site\\n                                          (including without limitation persons to whom access\
      \ to the Site has been\\n                                     allowed by the Contractor), comply with all\
      \ relevant safety regulations, including\\n                                        provision of safety gear,\
      \ and insofar as the Contractor is in occupation or\\n                                     otherwise is using\
      \ areas of the Site, keep the Site and the Works (so far as the\\n                             same are not\
      \ completed and occupied by the Employer) in an orderly state\\n                                       appropriate\
      \ to the avoidance of injury to  all persons and shall keep the\\n                                  Employer\
      \ indemnified against all injuries to such persons.\\n                                          c. provides\
      \ and maintain  all  lights, guards, fences and warning signs and\\n                               watchmen\
      \ when and where necessary or required by the Engineer or by laws\\n                                     \
      \   or by any relevant authority for the protection of the Works and for the safety\\n                   \
      \             and convenience of the public and all persons on or in the vicinity of the Site;\\n        \
      \                        and\\n                                        d. where any work would otherwise be\
      \ carried out in darkness, ensure that all parts\\n                                           of the Site\
      \ where work is being carried out are so lighted as to ensure the safety\\n                              \
      \             of all persons on or in the vicinity of the Site and of such work.\\n\\n                   \
      \    4.16.1         Contractor is required to take note of all the necessary provisions in Employer’s\\n \
      \                                       Safety, Health and Environment Manual (SHE Manual) and the Contractor’s\\\
      n                                         price shall be inclusive of all the necessary costs to meet the\

      \ the above; the Employer may\\n                                      provide  the  necessary arrangements\
      \ and  recover  the  costs  from  the\\n                                        Contractor.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 87,\n  \"text\": \"4.16.2       Within stipulated time as mentioned in ‘contract\

      \ comply\\n                              with them. The Site Safety Plan shall include detailed policies,\
      \ procedures and\\n                              regulations which, when implemented,  will ensure compliance\
      \ with this Sub-\\n                           Clause.\\n                       The Contractor shall, from\
      \ time to time and as necessary or required by the\\n                            Engineer, produce supplements\
      \ to the Site Safety Plan such that it is at all times\\n                        a detailed, comprehensive\
      \ and contemporaneous statement by the Contractor of\\n                               his site safety and\
      \ industrial health obligations, responsibilities, policies and\\n                           procedures (under\
      \ the laws of India) or as stated in the Contract or elsewhere\\n                                relating\
      \ to work on Site.\\n                                                 If at any time the Site Safety Plan\
      \ is, in the opinion of the Engineer, insufficient or\\n                              requires revision or\
      \ modification to ensure the security of the Works and the safety\\n                                of  all\
      \ workmen upon, and visitors to the Site, the Engineer may instruct the\\n                             Contractor\
      \ to revise the Site Safety Plan. The Contractor shall, within 14 days,\\n                           submit\
      \ the revised plan to the Engineer for review.\\n                        Any omission, inconsistency or error\
      \ in the Site Safety Plan or the Engineer\\n                           concurrence or rejection of the Site\
      \ Safety Plan and/or supplements thereto shall\\n                        be without prejudice to the Contractor's\
      \ obligations with respect to site safety and\\n                                 industrial health and shall\
      \ not excuse any failure by the Contractor to adopt proper\\n                        and recognised safety\
      \ practices throughout the execution of the Works.\\n                        The Contractor shall adhere to\
      \ the Site Safety Plan and shall ensure that all sub-\\n                              contractors of all tiers\
      \ have a copy of the Site Safety Plan and comply with its\\n                               provisions.\\n\
      \                        The Contractor shall provide all necessary access, assistance and facilities to\\\
      n                           enable the Engineer and the Employer to carry out surveillance to verify that\
      \ the\\n                               Site Safety Plan is being properly and fully implemented.\\n      \
      \                  The contractor shall have full regard for the safety of works (till it is handed over\\\
      n                                to the Employer), adjoining properties and all persons on/ or in the vicinity\
      \ of the\\n                                  site (including without limiting to the persons to whom the access\
      \ has been\\n                           allowed by the contractor), existing utilities etc. and comply with\

      n                      He shall be responsible for accidents, injury, damage to properties, loss of life /\\\

      n                            execution of the work until they are taken over by the Employer even though all\\\
      n                           reasonable and proper precautions may have taken by him. Such cost, loss or\\\
      n                      damage  or compensation  (including  that payable under  the  provisions  of\\n   \
      \                     Workmen’s Compensation Act or any statutory amendment thereof) to any person\\n    \
      \                          or persons including third party sustaining damage as omission on part of the\\\
      n                              contractor is to be borne by the contractor and he shall keep the Employer\

      \ shall notify the Engineer immediately of any occurrence or\\n                               incident that\
      \ results in death or serious injury as defined in the Indian Penal Code.\\n                       Such initial\
      \ notification may be verbal and confirmed in writing thereafter and shall\\n                        be  followed\
      \ by a  comprehensive  written  report  within 24  hours  of  the\\n                              occurrence/incident.\
      \ The Contractor  shall duly complete standard forms as\\n                             required by the Engineer\
      \ and Statutory Authorities.\\n                         The Contractor  shall provide and maintain  all necessary\
      \ temporary  fire\\n                              protection and firefighting facilities on the Site during\
      \ the construction of the Works\\n                                  in accordance with the statutory regulations\
      \ and as required by the Engineer. The\\n                             Contractor shall ensure that all gases,\
      \ fuels and other dangerous Materials and\\n                         goods are stored and handled in a safe\
      \ manner and in accordance with the\\n                               statutory regulations and as required\
      \ by the Engineer.\\n                          The obligations and requirements for safety and industrial\

      \ derogate from, the\\n                              Contractor’s statutory obligations, with respect to safety\
      \ and industrial health.\\n\\n                               First aid Base\\n                         The\

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 92,\n  \"text\": \"not indulge in Prohibited conduct which includes ‘corrupt practice’\
      \ and ‘fraudulent\\n                                        practice’ defined as follows;\\n\\n          \
      \                                              (i)      “corrupt practice” means the offering, giving, receiving\
      \ or soliciting of\\n                                   anything of value to Employer, Engineer or any of\
      \ their employees, influence in\\n                                    the procurement process or during Contract\
      \ execution; and\\n                                                            (ii)      “fraudulent practice”\
      \ means a misrepresentation of facts  in order to\\n                                     influence a procurement\
      \ process or during the execution of a Contract to the\\n                                    detriment of\
      \ the Employer, and includes collusive practice among Tenderers (prior\\n                                \
      \        to or after tender submission) designed to establish tender prices at artificial non-\\n        \
      \                            competitive levels and to deprive the Employer of the benefits of free and open\\\
      n                                     competition.\\n\\n                                        In pursuance\
      \ with this policy, the Employer:\\n\\n                                        a. Will reject the Tender for\
      \ the Work or rescind the Contract,  if the Employer\\n                                 determines that the\
      \ Tenderer/Contractor has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent\\n                                       practices,\
      \ and\\n                                        b. Will declare a Tenderer/Contractor ineligible, either indefinitely\
      \ or for a minimum\\n                                    period of 2 years from the date of identification\
      \ of such prohibited conduct, to be\\n                              awarded a Contract/s  if he at any time\
      \ determines that the Contractor has\\n                              engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practices\
      \ in competing for, or in executing the\\n                                     Contract.\\n\\n    Compensation\
      \   4.33.2       In the event of rescission of Contract under Sub-clause 4.33.1, the Contractor\\n     to\
      \ Contractor                   shall not be entitled to any compensation whatsoever, except for the work done\\\
      n    on rescission              up to the date of rescission.\\n     of Contract\\n    under this\\n     clause\\\
      n\\n     Quality           4.34       Unless otherwise stated in Special Conditions of Contract and/or Employer’s\\\
      n    Assurance                  Requirement, the Contractor  shall  institute a  quality assurance system\
      \  to\\n                                 demonstrate compliance with the requirements of the Contract. Such\
      \ system shall\\n                              be in accordance with the details stated in the Contract. Compliance\
      \ with the\\n                                        quality assurance system shall not relieve the Contractor\
      \ of his duties, obligations\\n                                     or responsibilities.\\n              \
      \                        Details of all procedure and compliance documents shall be submitted to the\\n  \
      \                               Engineer for his consent before each execution stage is commenced.\\n\\n \
      \    Confidentiality   4.35       The Contractor shall not use or divulge, except for the purpose of the Contract\
      \ or\\n     of Information                 with the written permission of the Employer, any information relating\
      \ to the Works\\n                                     or the Project provided in the Contract or otherwise\
      \ provided by the Employer, or\\n                                    the Engineer. The Contractor shall ensure\
      \ that his sub-contractors of any tier shall\\n                              be bound by a like confidentiality\

      \ assignment has\\n                              been made in accordance with Sub-clause 2.4 may use any information\
      \ provided\\n                               by the Contractor in accordance with the Contract. The Employer\
      \ shall use\\n                                  reasonable endeavors to ensure that the Engineer and any third\
      \ party- referred to\\n                                           in aforesaid Sub-Clause 2.4 shall not, divulge\
      \ such information except for any\\n                                purpose connected with the Contract.\"\
      \n}"

      \ with the Engineer at all reasonable times\\n                               during the Contract Period.\\\

      n                               forms.\\n\\nContractor’s      5.2          a.     The Contractor shall be\
      \ fully responsible, for the suitability, adequacy,\\nwarranty of                       integrity, durability\
      \ and practicality of the Contractor’s proposal.\\nDesign                          b.     The Contractor warrants\
      \  that the  Contractor’s Proposals meet the\\n                             Employer’s Requirements and is\
      \ fit for the purpose thereof. Where there is any\\n                             inadequacy, insufficiency,\
      \ impracticality or unsuitability in or of the Employer’s\\n                           Requirements or any\
      \ part thereof, the Contractor’s Proposal shall take into\\n                              account, address\
      \ or  rectify such inadequacy,  insufficiency,  impracticality or\\n                                   unsuitability\
      \ at Contractor’s own cost.\\n                                    c.     The Contractor warrants that the\
      \ Works have been or will be designed,\\n                             manufactured, installed and otherwise\
      \ constructed and to the highest standards\\n                                available using proven up-to-date\
      \ good practice\\n                                  d.     The Contractor warrants that the Works will, when\
      \ completed, comply with\\n                           enactments and regulations relevant to the Works\\n\
      \                                  e.     The  Contractor  warrants  that  the  design  of  the Works and\

      n                           Requirements\\n                                  g.     The Contractor  shall\

      n\\n                                                                 i   Notwithstanding that such design\

      \ In this event, Sub-Clause12.3 shall\\n                                   apply to such work.\\n\\n    Extension\

      \ have been\\n                                      delivered, erected and taken over.\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 109,\n      \"text\": \"Failure to         10.4             If the Contractor fails to\

      \ with the Employer's\\n                                 Requirements.\\n\\n    Time for          8.2    \

      \ in\\n                                      ‘Contract Data’.\\n\\n    Delay             8.3           In\
      \ case of delay on the part of the Contractor, the Contractor shall be liable to pay\\n                  \

      \                          the Employer as per Clause 8.5.  This is without prejudice to the right of the\\\
      n                                Employer to rescind the Contract.\\n\\n                                 \
      \     Failure or delay by the Employer or the Engineer, to hand over to the Contractor\\n                \
      \                    the Site necessary for execution of Works, or any part of the Works, or to provide\\\
      n                                 necessary Drawings or instructions or clarifications or to supply any material,\
      \ plant\\n                                      or machinery, which under the Contract, is the responsibility\
      \ of the Employer, shall\\n                                           in no way affect or vitiate the Contract\
      \ or alter the character thereof, or entitle the\\n                                    Contractor to damages\
      \ or compensation thereof and in any such case, the\\n                                 Engineer shall extend\
      \ the time period for the completion of the Contract, as in his\\n                                    opinion\
      \ is / are reasonable.\\n\\n    Extension of     8.4        Extension of Time for Completion\\n    Time for\\\

      \ not\\n                                          forming part of this Contract and on whose performance,\
      \ the performance\\n                                                 of the Contractor necessarily depends.\\\
      n                                            e.  Any act of prevention or Breach of the Contract by the Employer\
      \ and not\\n                                       mentioned in this Clause\\n                           \
      \                                      f.  Any order of Court restraining the performance of the Contract\
      \ in full or in\\n                                     any part thereof and the Contractor not being in default\
      \ as to reason of\\n                                      such order of court.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 105,\n      \"text\": \"g.  Any other event or occurrence which, according to the Employer is\
      \ not\\n                                due to the Contractor’s failure or fault, and is beyond his control\
      \ without\\n                                  Employer being responsible for the same.\\n                \
      \                       h.  An Employer’s Variation.\\n\\n                           However, the Contractor\
      \ shall not be entitled to any extension of time where the\\n                                  instructions\

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"9\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 107,\n      \"text\": \"\
      9         Handing over by Contractor and Taking over by Employer.\\n\\nTaking Over       9.1       The works\
      \ shall be taken over by the Employer when they have been completed\\nCertificate                        in\
      \ accordance with the Contract, have passed the Tests on Completion including\\n                         \
      \       integrated testing and commissioning wherever applicable as per contract. The\\n                 \
      \           Taking Over Certificate for the Works will be issued by the Engineer/Employer.\\n\\n         \
      \                                          If the Works are divided into sections/stations/Depot/Reaches,\
      \ the Contractor\\n                                   shall be entitled to apply for a Taking Over Certificate\
      \ for each section/station. The\\n                               Contractor may apply by notice to the Engineer\
      \ for a Taking-Over-Certificate not\\n                                    earlier than 14 days before the\
      \ works in the Contractor’s opinion, be complete and\\n                            ready for taking over.\
      \ The Engineer shall, within 28 days after the receipt of the\\n                                Contractor’s\
      \ application:\\n\\n                                    (a)   Issue the Taking Over Certificate to the Contractor,\
      \ stating the date on\\n                                  which the Works or section/stations/Depot/Reaches\
      \ were completed,\\n                                       including  the Tests on Completion  including \
      \ integrated  testing and\\n                                  commissioning wherever applicable as per contract.\
      \ (except for minor\\n                                     outstanding work that does not affect the use and\
      \ safety of the Works or\\n                                    Section for their intended purposes); The \
      \ list of such Works along with\\n                                     the target date of completion  for\
      \ each Work  shall be enclosed with the\\n                                  Taking Over Certificate and completion\
      \ of all these Works / Rectification\\n                                          of defects within  the stipulated\
      \ time  shall be the  responsibility  of the\\n                                     Contractor  and any failure\
      \  in  it may be considered  a reason by the\\n                                   Engineer to cancel the Taking\
      \ Over Certificate issued earlier; or\\n                                    (b)   Reject the application,\
      \ giving his reasons and specifying the work required\\n                                          to be done\
      \ by the Contractor to enable the Taking Over Certificate to be\\n                                      issued.\
      \ The Contractor shall then complete such work before issuing a\\n                                       \
      \   further notice under this Sub-Clause.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 108,\n      \"text\": \"Taking\
      \ over of    9.2       The Engineer may, at the sole discretion of the Employer issue a Taking Over\\n   \
      \  Parts of the                     Certificate for any part of the Permanent Works.\\n    Works         \
      \                               If the Employer uses any part of the Works for revenue service before the\
      \ Taking\\n                               Over Certificate is issued:\\n\\n                              \
      \            (a)   The part which is used shall be deemed to have been taken over at the\\n              \
      \                           date on which it issued,\\n                                          (b)   The\
      \ Engineer shall, immediately issue a Taking Over Certificate for this\\n                                \

      n                                            contractor shall carry out these works as soon as practicable\

      \ Employer, except for deficiency\\n                                   and defects listed in.\"\n    }\n \

      \ Plan and the Employer's Requirements. The quality manual\\n    Execution                    should address\
      \  the  quality system as  required by ISO 9001-1991. Any\\n                                supplement to\
      \ the Site Quality Plan shall be submitted at least 14 days before\\n                            commencement\
      \ of the relevant work.\\n                            Upon the Engineer  notifying his consent  to the Site\
      \ Quality Plan, or any\\n                                supplement thereto, the Contractor shall, adhere\
      \ to the principles and procedures\\n                                   contained in such document, except\
      \ where the Engineer gives his consent to any\\n                            amended or varied version  thereof.\
      \ The Contractor  shall cause any sub-\\n                                     contractors to adhere to this\
      \ Plan.\\n                             The Contractor shall appoint a suitably qualified and experienced person,\
