      \ manager of the\\n                                        quality assurance system and shall provide such\
      \ other personnel and resources\\n                                as required to ensure effective operation\
      \ of the quality assurance system. The\\n                                     said manager shall carry out\
      \ audits of the application of the quality assurance\\n                                  system, and ensure\
      \ effective quality control and delivery of quality assurance.\\n                             The Contractor\
      \ shall provide all necessary access, assistance and facilities to\\n                                  enable\
      \ the Engineer to carry out surveillance visits both on and off the Site to\\n                           \
      \               verify that the quality assurance system is being properly and fully implemented.\\n     \
      \                     No extra payment shall be made in this regard and the cost of the Work under\\n    \
      \                                       this element shall be deemed to be included in the Contract Price.\\\
      n\\n                                             All Plant and Materials to be supplied shall be manufactured,\
      \ and all work to be\\n                              done shall be executed, in the manner prescribed in the\
      \ Contract. Where the\\n                              manner of manufacture and execution is not set out in\
      \ the Contract, the work shall\\n                              be executed in a proper, workman like and careful\
      \ manner, with properly equipped\\n                                               facilities and  non-hazardous\
      \  Materials, and  in  accordance  with modern\\n                                  recognized good practice.\\\
      n\\n\\n\\n    Source of        7.2         Source of materials being supplied shall be intimated to the Engineer\
      \ and are\\n     Materials                      subject to his approval. Materials that are not specified\
      \ in the contract document\\n                                         shall confirm to the relevant Indian\
      \ standard or in their absence, shall confirm to\\n                               any international standard\
      \ approved by the Engineer.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 101,\n      \"text\": \"Save as otherwise\
      \ expressly provided in the contract, sample shall be supplied by\\n                               the Contractor\

      \  transport,  receiving,\\n                              unloading and safe keeping of  all Plant, construction,\
      \ Materials, Contractor's\\n                           Equipment and other things required for the completion\

      n                                   a.     has full access to all parts of the Site and to all places from\
      \ which natural\\n                                materials are being obtained, and\\n                   \
      \                b.      during production, manufacture, fabrication and construction (at the site\\n    \
      \                      and elsewhere) be entitled to inspect, examine, measure and test the materials\\n \
      \                         and workmanship, and to check the progress of manufacture, of all Plant and\\n \
      \                               Materials to be supplied under the Contract.\\n                         The\
      \ Contractor shall give the Engineer full opportunity to carry out these activities\\n                   \
      \              including providing access, facilities, permissions and safety equipment. No such\\n      \
      \                             activity/inspection  shall  relieve  the  Contractor  from  any  obligation\
      \  or\\n                                    responsibility.\\n\\nTesting           7.5          This sub-\
      \ clause shall apply to all tests specified in the Contract and required to\\n                          be\
      \ carried out as per Quality Assurance plan.\\n                         The Contractor shall provide all documents\
      \ and other information necessary for\\n                                            all types of testing and\
      \ such assistance, labour, materials, electricity, fuel, stores,\\n                             apparatus\
      \ and instruments as are necessary to carry out such tests efficiently.\\n\\n                         The\
      \ Contractor shall agree, with the Engineer, the time and place for the testing\\n                       \
      \            of any Plant, Materials and other parts of the Works as specified in the Contract.\\n\\n    \
      \                     The Engineer shall give the Contractor not less than 24 hours’ notice of his\\n    \
      \                              intention to attend the tests.\\n\\n                                      \
      \              If the Engineer does not attend at the time and place agreed, or if the Contractor\\n     \

      \                         proceed with the tests, unless the Engineer instructs the Contractor otherwise.\\\
      n                         Such tests shall be deemed to have been made in the Engineer's presence.\\n\\n \
      \                        The Contractor shall promptly forward to the Engineer duly certified reports of the\\\
      n                                    tests. If the Engineer has not attended the tests, he shall accept the\
      \ readings as\\n                                accurate. When the specified tests have been passed, the Engineer\
      \ shall endorse\\n                               the Contractor's test certificate, or issue a certificate\
      \ to him, to that effect.\\n                         The expense of conducting such Tests shall be borne by\
      \ the Contractor. No such\\n                                  testing shall relieve the Contractor from any\
      \ obligation or responsibility.\\n\\nRejection         7.6        As a result of inspection, examination or\
      \ testing, any Plant, Material, Design or\\n                           workmanship is found to be defective\
      \ or otherwise not in accordance with the\\n                                Contract, the Engineer may reject\
      \ the same and by giving notice to the Contractor\\n                                 with reasons. The Contractor\
      \ shall then promptly make good the defect and\\n                            ensure that the rejected item\
      \ after rectification complies with the Contract.\\n                                                    If\
      \ the Engineer requires such Plant, Material, Design or workmanship to be\\n                             \
      \    retested, the tests shall be repeated under the same terms and conditions. If such\\n               \
      \                   rejection and retesting cause the Employer to incur costs, such costs shall be\\n    \
      \                          recoverable from the Contractor by the Employer, and may be deducted by the\\n\
      \                           Employer from any monies due, or to become due, to the Contractor.\\n\\n     \
      \                                            “If the tests are required to be carried out from the outside\
      \ laboratory, the Engineer\\n                                   shall decide and approve the laboratory and\
      \ the sample shall be collected and\\n                             sealed in presence of the Engineer or his\
      \ authorised representative. The cost of\\n                                  testing shall be borne by the\
      \ contractor and nothing extra shall be paid for the\\n                           expenses incurred on the\
      \ testing. In the event of variations in the results of in\\n                           house testing and\
      \ outside lab testing the decision of Engineer with respect to\\n                             importance and\
      \ relevance attached to a particular report and recourse to sort out\\n                               the\
      \ dispute arisen because of difference in results shall be final and binding on\\n                       \
      \        the contractor”.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 102,\n      \"text\": \"Liability after  \

      n    covering up\\n\\n    Cost              7.10.2     The Contractor shall uncover any part or parts of the\
      \ Works, or make openings in\\n     of uncovering                 or through the same, as the Engineer may\
      \ from time to time direct, and shall\\n     the work                        reinstate and make good such\
      \ part or parts, to the satisfaction of the Engineer.  If\\n     already                    any such part\
      \ or parts have been covered up, or put out of view after compliance\\n    covered up                    with\
      \ the requirement of Sub-clause 7.5 and the Works are found to be executed\\n                            \
      \               in accordance with the Contract, the expenses of uncovering, making openings in\\n       \
      \                              or through, reinstating and making good the same, shall be borne by the\\n\

      n                                    negotiated price.\\n\\n                             The decision of the\

      \ that each item of the Plant and Work can\\n                                      safely undertake the next\

      n                                           (c) trial operation which shall demonstrate that the Works or\
      \ Section perform\\n                                          reliably and in accordance with the Contract\\\
      n\\n                             The Contractor at his own cost shall arrange  all tools, equipment, gadgets,\\\
      n                                               facilities or as deemed necessary by the Engineer for such\

      \ Engineer shall make allowances for\\n                                    the effect of any use of the Works\

      \ the Works. As soon as the Works, or a Section, have passed\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 103,\n\
      \      \"text\": \"the Tests on Completion described in sub-paragraphs (a) (b) or (c), the Contractor\\n \

      \ the results\\n                                   of all such Tests.\\n\\nDelayed Tests    7.11.2       \
      \    If the Engineer opines that Tests on Completion are being unduly delayed by the\\n                  \

      n                           such Tests on such day or days as the Contractor may fix and of which he shall\\\
      n                                give notice to the Engineer.\\n\\n                                      \

      10        Defects Liability\\n\\n    Completion of    10.1       “Defects Liability Period” is as stated in\
      \ ‘Contract Data’ from the date of Taking\\n    Outstanding                 over mentioned in the Taking Over\
      \ Certificate being issued for whole of the Works\\n    Work and                 and not any sub-section or\
      \ part thereof.\\n    Remedying                  Provided that, if any part of the Works or sub-systems or\
      \ component of that part\\n     Defects                    has been replaced, renewed or repaired, the “Defects\
      \ Liability Period” in respect\\n                                        of that part or sub-system or components\
      \ of that part shall start from the date of\\n                               such replacement, renewal or\
      \ repair has been completed to the satisfaction of the\\n                                   Engineer.\\n\\\
      n                             The Contractor shall remedy, at no extra cost to the Employer, the defect or\
      \ failure\\n                                                (fair wear and tear excluded) after any part of\
      \ the Work are taken over by the\\n                               Employer until the end of Defects Liability\
      \ Period.\\n\\n                                        In order that the Construction and/or Manufacture Documents\
      \ and the Works shall\\n                              be in the condition required by the Contract(fair wear\
      \ and tear excepted)at, or as\\n                               soon as practicable after the expiry of the\
      \ Contract Period, the Contractor shall:\\n                                         (a)   Complete any work\
      \ which is out standing on the date stated in a Taking\\n                                    Over Certificate,\
      \ as soon as practicable after such date, and\\n                                         (b)   Execute  all\
      \ such work of amendment, reconstruction, and remedying\\n                                          defects\
      \ or damage, as may be instructed in writing by the Employer or the\\n                                   \
      \    Engineer during the Contract Period.\\n\\n    Cost of           10.2         All work referred to in\
      \ Sub-Clause10.1(b)shall be executed by the Contractor at\\n    Remedying                     his own cost,\
      \ if the necessity for such work is due to:\\n     Defects\\n                                         (a)\
      \    Design (if any) of works for which the contractor is responsible.\\n                                \
      \         (b)    Plant, Materials or workmanship not being in accordance with the Contract\\n            \
      \                                                           ; or\\n                                      \
      \    (c)    Failure by the Contractor to comply with any of his other obligations.\\n\\n                 \
      \                                           If in the opinion of the Engineer, such necessity is due to any\
      \ other cause, he shall\\n                                  determine an adjustment to the Contract Price,\
      \ with the approval of the Employer,\\n                              and shall notify the Contractor accordingly.\

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 110,\n  \"text\": \"11         Contract Price and Payment\\n\\n    The          \
      \    11.1       Contract Price\\n     Contract Price\\n                                   Contract Price is\
      \ the sum stated in the Letter of Acceptance, subject to such\\n                                     additions\
      \ or deductions as may be made under the provisions of the Contract. The\\n                              \
      \      Contractor shall be responsible for and shall pay all taxes, duties, royalties, and\\n            \
      \                       fees arising from or required under this Contract, except as specifically provided\\\
      n                                      herein. The Employer shall reimburse Output GST to the Contractor in\
      \ accordance\\n                                     with the provisions of the Goods and Services Tax Act,\
      \ 2017 and the rules made\\n                                    thereunder.\\n                           \
      \  The Contract Price shall remain firm and shall not be subject to any adjustment\\n                    \
      \          on account of tax-related changes, except for adjustments expressly permitted\\n              \
      \                   under Sub-Clause 11.1.1\\n\\n                       11.1.1     Change in Law\\n\\n\\n\
      \                             The Contract Price is based on the applicable taxes as on last day of the month\\\
      n                                   previous to the month of invitation of this tender. Any subsequent change\
      \ in these\\n                                 laws that becomes effective after this date shall be considered\
      \ a ‘Change in Law’\\n                                          for the purposes of this Clause\\n\\n\\n \
      \                                                                    i. Any imposition, abolition, increase,\
      \ decrease, or change in the rate or scope\\n                                            of any tax, duty,\
      \ levy, or cess (including but not limited to Goods and Services\\n                                 Tax (GST))\
      \ applicable to the output of the Works/Services under this Contract,\\n                                 \
      \   whether by way  of primary  legislation,  notification,  circular,  or  judicial\\n                  \
      \                 pronouncement, shall result in a corresponding adjustment to the Contract\\n           \
      \                                Price, limited to the actual variation in tax liability arising from such\
      \ change,\\n                                         calculated on the value of the portion of the Works executed\
      \ after the effective\\n                                      date of such change.\\n                    \
      \                                                   ii. The adjustment contemplated in the preceding paragraph\
      \ shall not apply to\\n                                  any taxes, duties, royalties, or fees arising from\
      \ or required under this Contract\\n                                               in relation to the inputs\
      \ for the Works. Such input-related levies shall remain\\n                                        the sole\
      \ responsibility of the Contractor and shall not give rise to any change\\n                              \
      \                 in the Contract Price.\\n                                                              \
      \          iii. Should there be a partial or complete waiver or exemption for any taxes and\\n           \
      \                                duties, etc. in  full or part thereof during the execution of the project,\
      \ the\\n                                         contractor shall be obliged to follow and obtain exemption\
      \ / refund of such\\n                                         taxes, duties etc., from the concerned Authorities\
      \ and pass on the benefit so\\n                                      obtained to the employer. In case of\
      \ failure by the contractor to obtain and\\n                                         remit the exemption /\
      \ concession within reasonable time to the employer (to\\n                                 be decided by the\
      \ employer& intimated to the contractor), the same will be\\n                                     recovered\
      \ by the employer from the amounts due to the contractor.\\n                                             \
      \      iv. The Contractor shall maintain complete records in respect of payments made\\n                 \
      \                 by them for taxes and duties payable to various authorities (except Income\\n          \
      \                       Tax or Corporate Tax) and advise the Employer the summary of such payment\\n     \
      \                                every month in a format advised by the Employer during execution of the\\\
      n                                           contract.\\n                                            v. The\
      \ detailed records shall however remain open for inspection by the Engineer\\n                           \
      \                 at any time and copies of the records shall be furnished as required by the\\n         \
      \                             Engineer. The amount payable/recoverable from the contractor will generally\\\
      n                                 be calculated based on these records. However, Engineer  at  his sole\\\
      n                                            discretion, if not satisfied with the veracity of records or\
      \ records are incomplete\\n                                         or otherwise, may separately determine\
      \ the amount payable/recoverable from\\n                                       the contractor in accordance\
      \ with the conditions of the contract, which shall be\\n                                                 \
      \ final and binding.\"\n}"

      - **Recovery of Amount Due to the Employer** (Clause 11.21)'

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 115,\n  \"text\": \"11.1.2.2        If any item of work is derived from COMMON SR\
      \ of KPWD under the BoQ\\n                            schedule “ITEMS UNDER SCHEDULE OF RATE PUBLISHED BY\
      \ KPWD” the\\n                                 price variation is applicable.\\n\\n                   11.1.2.3\
      \    Price Variation during Extended Period of Completion:\\n                         The price adjustment\
      \  will be applicable for the work done from the date of\\n                       commence to the stipulated\
      \ completion date of the work including the extended\\n                               period of completion\
      \ where such extension has been granted under Sub-Clause\\n                                8.4.1 of GCC or\
      \ it is specifically mentioned that extension is with price variation\\n                                 \
      \ also. However, where extension has been granted under Sub-Clause 8.4.3 of\\n                       GCC,\
      \ price adjustment will be reckoned as follows:\\n                                   In case the indices increase\
      \ above the indices applicable to an IPC made on the\\n                                     last date of original\
      \ completion period or the extended period under Sub-Clauses\\n                                8.4.1 of GCC,\
      \ the price adjustment for the period of extension under Sub-Clause\\n                                8.4.3\
      \ of GCC will be limited to the amount payable as per the indices applicable\\n                          \
      \        to the IPC made on the last date of the original completion period or the extended\\n           \
      \                    period under Sub-Clauses 8.4.1 of GCC as the case may be.\\n                        \
      \           In case the indices fall below the indices applicable to an IPC made on the last\\n          \
      \                   date of the original completion period or extended period of completion granted\\n   \
      \                         under sub clause 8.4.1, then the lower indices will be adopted for Price Adjustment\\\
      n                                    for the period of extension under Clause 8.4.3 of GCC.\\n\\n        \
      \           11.1.2.4    Price Variations for extra item of work:\\n                                      \
      \              If the extra item of work is derived in accordance with clause GCC12.3.2, price\\n        \
      \                          variation shall not be applicable up to Twelve months from the base month\\n  \
      \                      recommended by the Engineer. However, when the period of execution of such\\n     \
      \                         items exceeds more than Twelve months’ price variation is applicable and the\\n\
      \                         Base month for calculation of Price Variation will be the month in which NT item\\\
      n                           has been recommended by the Engineer.\\n\\nAdvance          11.2      Advance\
      \ Payments\\nPayments\\n                                      All Advances as admissible as stated in sub-clause\
      \ of GCC 11.2 shall be payable\\n                               only at Contractor’s written request to the\
      \ Employer. The Advance payment will\\n                          be paid against submission of either unconditional\
      \ and irrevocable e- Bank\\n                             Guarantee(s) or Insurance Surety bond in accordance\
      \ with provision with set out\\n                              below.\\n                                  \
      \     (a) e-Bank Guarantees (e-BG): The e- Bank Guarantees shall be from an\\n                           \
      \            Indian Schedule bank (excluding Cooperative Banks) or from a schedule\\n                    \
      \                 Foreign Bank as defined in Section 2(e) of RBI Act 1934 read with Second\\n            \
      \                        Schedule. e-Bank Guarantee format is provided in the contract forms. All\\n     \
      \                           e-Bank Guarantees should be payable in Bangalore at the designated\\n        \
      \                            Branch. In case of Joint Venture, e-Bank Guarantees can be furnished by\\n  \
      \                               any member or members of the consortium/JV.\\n                           \
      \            (b) Insurance Surety Bond: The Insurance Surety Bond shall be issued by\\n                  \
      \              an Insurance Company authorized by the Insurance Regulatory and\\n                        \
      \         Development Authority of India (IRDAI) and shall be payable in Bengaluru\\n                    \
      \                          in favor of Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL).  It shall\\n    \
      \                               conform to the prescribed format provided in Contract forms. In case of\\\
      n                                          Joint Venture, Insurance Surety Bond can be furnished by any member\
      \ or\\n                              members of the consortium/JV.\\n                                    \
      \     (c) Wherever e-Bank Guarantee or Insurance Surety Bond is to be extended\\n                        \
      \                or fresh e-Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond is to be obtained, the\\n               \
      \                        cost towards getting extension of e-Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety\\n          \
      \                     Bond or fresh e-Bank Surety Bond and other incidental charges will be in\\n        \
      \                               the contractor’s account.\\n                                       (d) BMRCL\
      \ is not liable to pay GST on any advances paid to the contractor.\\n                                    \
      \   (e) The Contractor shall issue the receipt voucher for having received the\\n                        \
      \         advance to the Employer as per the GST Laws.\\n\\nMobilisation      11.2.1       Interest free Mobilization\
      \ Advance Payment shall be paid for an amount as stated\\nAdvance                          in ‘Contact Data’.\
      \ The number of instalments  (if more than one) and  their\\n                               proportions shall\
      \ be as stated in the contract Data. If an amount is not stated in\\n                                  ‘contract\
      \ data’ this sub- clause shall not apply.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 110,\n  \"text\": \"11         Contract Price and Payment\\n\\n    The          \
      \    11.1       Contract Price\\n     Contract Price\\n                                   Contract Price is\
      \ the sum stated in the Letter of Acceptance, subject to such\\n                                     additions\
      \ or deductions as may be made under the provisions of the Contract. The\\n                              \
      \      Contractor shall be responsible for and shall pay all taxes, duties, royalties, and\\n            \
      \                       fees arising from or required under this Contract, except as specifically provided\\\
      n                                      herein. The Employer shall reimburse Output GST to the Contractor in\
      \ accordance\\n                                     with the provisions of the Goods and Services Tax Act,\
      \ 2017 and the rules made\\n                                    thereunder.\\n                           \
      \  The Contract Price shall remain firm and shall not be subject to any adjustment\\n                    \
      \          on account of tax-related changes, except for adjustments expressly permitted\\n              \
      \                   under Sub-Clause 11.1.1\\n\\n                       11.1.1     Change in Law\\n\\n\\n\
      \                             The Contract Price is based on the applicable taxes as on last day of the month\\\
      n                                   previous to the month of invitation of this tender. Any subsequent change\
      \ in these\\n                                 laws that becomes effective after this date shall be considered\
      \ a ‘Change in Law’\\n                                          for the purposes of this Clause\\n\\n\\n \
      \                                                                    i. Any imposition, abolition, increase,\
      \ decrease, or change in the rate or scope\\n                                            of any tax, duty,\
      \ levy, or cess (including but not limited to Goods and Services\\n                                 Tax (GST))\
      \ applicable to the output of the Works/Services under this Contract,\\n                                 \
      \   whether by way  of primary  legislation,  notification,  circular,  or  judicial\\n                  \
      \                 pronouncement, shall result in a corresponding adjustment to the Contract\\n           \
      \                                Price, limited to the actual variation in tax liability arising from such\
      \ change,\\n                                         calculated on the value of the portion of the Works executed\
      \ after the effective\\n                                      date of such change.\\n                    \
      \                                                   ii. The adjustment contemplated in the preceding paragraph\
      \ shall not apply to\\n                                  any taxes, duties, royalties, or fees arising from\
      \ or required under this Contract\\n                                               in relation to the inputs\
      \ for the Works. Such input-related levies shall remain\\n                                        the sole\
      \ responsibility of the Contractor and shall not give rise to any change\\n                              \
      \                 in the Contract Price.\\n                                                              \
      \          iii. Should there be a partial or complete waiver or exemption for any taxes and\\n           \
      \                                duties, etc. in  full or part thereof during the execution of the project,\
      \ the\\n                                         contractor shall be obliged to follow and obtain exemption\
      \ / refund of such\\n                                         taxes, duties etc., from the concerned Authorities\
      \ and pass on the benefit so\\n                                      obtained to the employer. In case of\
      \ failure by the contractor to obtain and\\n                                         remit the exemption /\
      \ concession within reasonable time to the employer (to\\n                                 be decided by the\
      \ employer& intimated to the contractor), the same will be\\n                                     recovered\
      \ by the employer from the amounts due to the contractor.\\n                                             \
      \      iv. The Contractor shall maintain complete records in respect of payments made\\n                 \
      \                 by them for taxes and duties payable to various authorities (except Income\\n          \
      \                       Tax or Corporate Tax) and advise the Employer the summary of such payment\\n     \
      \                                every month in a format advised by the Employer during execution of the\\\
      n                                           contract.\\n                                            v. The\
      \ detailed records shall however remain open for inspection by the Engineer\\n                           \
      \                 at any time and copies of the records shall be furnished as required by the\\n         \
      \                             Engineer. The amount payable/recoverable from the contractor will generally\\\
      n                                 be calculated based on these records. However, Engineer  at  his sole\\\
      n                                            discretion, if not satisfied with the veracity of records or\
      \ records are incomplete\\n                                         or otherwise, may separately determine\
      \ the amount payable/recoverable from\\n                                       the contractor in accordance\
      \ with the conditions of the contract, which shall be\\n                                                 \
      \ final and binding.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 112,\n  \"text\": \"Lo =The average consumer price index for industrial workers for\
      \ Bangalore Centre\\n\\n                                as applicable for the month of submission of the tender\
      \ as published by Labour\\n\\n                                 Bureau, Ministry of Labour, GOI.\\n\\n    \
      \                                       Li = The average consumer price index for industrial workers for Bangalore\
      \ Centre\\n\\n                                    during the ‘month under consideration’ as published by Labour\
      \ Bureau, Ministry\\n\\n                                        of Labour, GOI.\\n\\n                    \
      \             PL =cost co-efficient of “Labour” to the total cost.\\n\\n                                 \
      \        b. Adjustment for High-Speed Diesel component:\\n\\n                                    Price adjustment\
      \ for increase or decrease in the cost of High-Speed Diesel (HSD)\\n\\n                              components\
      \ shall be paid in accordance with following formula (Base: 2022-\\n\\n                                 23=100).\\\
      n\\n                                VF = R X PF x [(Fi –Fo)/Fo] where\\n\\n                              \
      \  VF = Increase  or decrease  in the cost  of work during the month under\\n\\n                         \
      \           consideration due to change in rates for High-Speed Diesel components.\\n\\n                 \
      \           Fo = All India average wholesale price index for High-Speed Diesel component as\\n\\n        \
      \                             applicable for the month of submission of the tender as published by Office\
      \ of the\\n\\n                              Economic Adviser.\\n\\n                                      \
      \  Fi = All India average wholesale price index for High-Speed Diesel component for\\n\\n                \
      \                    the ‘month under consideration’ as published by Office of the Economic Adviser.\\n\\\
      n                                PF = cost co-efficient of “Fuel and Lubricants” to the total cost.\\n\\n\
      \                                            c. Adjustment on account of Other Materials component:\\n\\n\
      \                                    Price adjustment  for increase  or decrease  in the  cost  of  other\
      \  materials\\n\\n                              components shall be paid in accordance with following formula\
      \ (Base: 2022-\\n\\n                                 23=100).\\n\\n                             VM = R X PM\
      \ x [(Mi –Mo)/Mo] where\\n\\n                             VM = Increase  or decrease  in the cost  of work\
      \ during the month under\\n\\n                                    consideration due to change in rates for\
      \ other material components.\\n\\n                        Mo = The wholesale price index for ‘All Commodities’\
      \ as applicable for the month\\n\\n                                        of submission of the tender as\
      \ published by Office of the Economic Adviser.\\n\\n                                Mi = The whole sale price\
      \ index for ‘All Commodities’ during the month preceding\\n\\n                                    the ‘month\
      \ under consideration’ as published by Office of the Economic Adviser.\\n\\n                             PM\
      \ =cost co-efficient of “Other Materials” to the total cost.\\n\\n                                       \
      \  d. Adjustment on account of Plant, Machinery and spares:\\n\\n                                    Price\
      \ adjustment for increase or decrease in the cost of Plant, Machinery and\\n\\n                          \
      \       spares component shall be paid in accordance with following formula (Base: 2022-\\n\\n           \
      \                      23=100).\\n\\n                               VP = R X PP x [(Pi – Po)/Po] where\\n\\\
      n                               VP = Increase  or decrease  in the cost  of work during the month under\\\
      n\\n                                    consideration due to change in rates for Plant, Machinery and spares\
      \ components.\\n\\n                           Po = the wholesale price index for Construction Machine/Equipment\
      \ including\\n\\n                               Batching Plants as applicable for the month of submission\
      \ of the tender as\\n\\n                                   published by Office of the Economic Adviser.\"\n\
      }"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 116,\n  \"text\": \"The Contractor shall have, prior to making a request for the\
      \ first instalment of\\n                                      mobilization advance, (a) submitted the Performance\
      \ Security in accordance with\\n                                    the Contract,  (b) commenced the mobilization\
      \ process as  certified by the\\n                                   Engineer. and  (c)  shall  submit an \
      \ unconditional and  irrevocable e-Bank\\n                                  guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond\
      \ for a value of 110% of the approved advance\\n                                amount.\\n               \
      \              The Contractor shall have, prior to making a request for the second instalment of\\n      \
      \                              the mobilization advance; (a) submitted a statement of utilization of the \
      \ first\\n                                    instalment of mobilization advance paid to the Contractor along\
      \ with a certificate\\n                                 from the Engineer and (b) shall submit an unconditional\
      \ and irrevocable e-Bank\\n                                  guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond for a value of\
      \ 110% of the approved advance\\n                                amount.\\n                             The\
      \ Mobilization Advance shall be paid by the Employer within 30 days of receipt\\n                        \
      \                of request letter from the contractor.\\n    Advance         11.2.2       Interest free Plant\
      \ & Machinery Advance Payment shall be paid for an amount as\\n     against Plant                  stated\
      \ in ‘Contact Data’. If an amount is not stated in ‘contract data’ this sub- clause\\n    and Machinery  \
      \                shall not apply.\\n\\n                                   This advance is payable in the currency\
      \ (i.e.) and in same proportion as stated in\\n                                    the LOA against purchase\
      \ of new plant & machinery and staging materials,\\n                                   provided the same have\
      \ reached the site, or in the case of new items meant\\n                                         specifically\
      \ for the works, firm purchase order has been placed and the invoices\\n                                 \
      \    received. The plant and machinery shall be valued by the Engineer as follows:\\n\\n                 \
      \                        (a)   New Machinery 80% of purchase price\\n\\n                                 \
      \        (b)   New staging materials 80% of purchase price\\n\\n\\n                              Advance Payment\
      \ will be paid against submission of unconditional and irrevocable\\n                              e-Bank\
      \ Guarantee(s)/Insurance Surety Bond for a value of 110 % of the\\n                                approved\
      \ advance amount.\\n\\n                             The Advance against Plant & Machinery and staging materials\
      \ will be paid by the\\n                                Employer within 30 days’ receipt of request letter\
      \ from the contractor.\\n                             The Contractor should give an Undertaking that “No advance/loan\
      \ has been taken\\n                                     against  the  subject  plant &machinery from any \
      \ other  individual/financial\\n                                             institution/ organization etc.”\
      \ If a wrong/false undertaking is given, all the Bank\\n                                Guarantees can be\
      \ forfeited and the contract is liable for termination under clause\\n                                   13.0\
      \ of GCC.\\n                             The contractor shall submit along with Bank Guarantees;\\n\\n   \
      \                                                      (i)     the invoice and RC book (wherever applicable)\
      \ in original at the time of\\n                                      obtaining advance amount.\\n\\n     \
      \                                                        (ii)    an Indemnity bond in favour of an Employer\
      \ as against Third Party claim.\\n\\n                                                                (iii)\
      \    Contractor shall not seek the possession of machinery and staging\\n                                \
      \      material brought to the site till the Advance obtained from Employer is fully settled.\\n\\n      \
      \                       The contractor should ensure that in the case of “Machinery and Equipment\\n     \
      \                           Advance” insurance and hypothecation in favour of the Employer should be done.\\\
      n                             The contractor should submit the proof of document related to Insurance and\\\
      n                                  Hypothecation  to  the  Engineer who  will  certify  that  the  insurance\
      \ and\\n                                   hypothecation to the Employer has been done in proper manner.\\\
      n                                Employer shall be the sole custodian of the entire plant & machinery and\
      \ staging\\n                                     materials whenever the advance amount is given to the contractor\
      \ and the same\\n                                         shall remain in the custody of Employer, till the\
      \ Advance obtained from Employer,\\n                                               is fully settled.\\n  \
      \                           The machinery, equipment and staging material brought to the site shall be\\n\
      \                                      exclusively intended for the execution of the work of Employer and\
      \ shall not be\\n                              removed without the consent of the Engineer.\\n           \
      \                  The contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless, the Employer against  all\\n        \
      \                               actions,  suits, proceedings, claims, damages, losses, expenses, demands\\\
      n                                      pertaining to Advance amount towards plant and machinery.\\n\\n   \
      \                          The contractor;\\n                                      a) Shall not mortgage /\
      \ create charge / hypothecate /encumber, in any way the\\n                                   machinery, equipment\
      \ and staging material brought to site from the amounts\\n                               advanced by Employer\
      \ and shall give an undertaking in writing to that effect in\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 111,\n  \"text\": \"vi. Custom Duty\\n\\n\\n                                Bangalore\
      \ Metro Rail Project is eligible for the concessional rate of custom\\n                                 duty\
      \ under Chapter 98.01 of Custom Tariff Act for Project Imports. All the\\n                               \
      \ process of project import registration, deposits of security money (if any) to\\n                      \
      \        custom authority and refund back after the completion of imported supplies\\n                   \
      \                    shall be the responsibility of contractor. The contractor shall indemnify BMRCL\\n  \
      \                                    of clearance and projects imports proceedings. Upon receipt of request\
      \ from\\n                                     contractor, BMRCL will issue authorization letter or facilitate\
      \ the Contractor for\\n                                   obtaining sponsoring/recommendation letter from\
      \ the Ministry of Housing and\\n                             Urban Affairs (MoHUA) or from the Government\
      \ of Karnataka (GoK) or any\\n                                   other authority as the case may be for getting\
      \ the project registered with the\\n                            Custom Department for availing Project Import\
      \ benefits\\n\\n\\n                                               vii. Project Authority certificate shall\
      \ be issued by the Employer for imported items.\\n                           The imports for the metro project\
      \ under Project Import Regulation (PIR) are\\n                               covered under HSN 98010019(other\
      \ Projects) and present Basic custom duty\\n                             (BCD) applicable as mentioned in\
      \ ‘Contract Data’.\\n                                                 viii. Any change in the rate of existing\
      \ Basic custom duty (BCD) will be reckoned\\n                              by payment of extra amount in case\
      \ of increase of Basic custom duty (BCD)\\n                             based on difference of revised Basic\
      \ custom duty (BCD) and existing Basic\\n                             custom duty (BCD) or by recovery amount\
      \ if the BCD reduces with respect to\\n                                  the existing BCD.\\n\\n\\nPrice Variation/\
      \   11.1.2      Price Variation/ Price Adjustment:\\nAdjustment in               Price  Variation   /  Adjustment\
      \  is  applicable,   if  value  of  weightages\\nContract Price                 (coefficients) are given in\
      \ the ‘contract data’.  If no value of weightages\\n                                  (Coefficients) given\
      \ in ‘Contract Data’, Price variation / adjustment shall not be\\n                                 applicable.\
      \ The rates as per the accepted Bill of Quantities shall be applicable until\\n                          \
      \     the completion of the Work and will be varied only to the extent of permissible\\n                 \
      \                price variation under this Clause. However, this adjustment shall be to the extent\\n   \
      \                               that full compensation for any rise or fall in costs to the Contractor if\
      \ not covered\\n                           by the Price variation formula, the rates in the accepted Bill\
      \ of Quantities shall be\\n                        deemed to include amounts to cover the contingency of such\
      \ rise or fall in costs.\\n                         Payment as per the contract shall be subject to adjustment\
      \ in accordance with the\\n                                 following Price Variation formula, and other terms\
      \ given herein, to provide for\\n                                  variation in the market rates of inputs\
      \ like labour, materials and fuel / energy during\\n                               the currency of the Contract:\\\
      n\\n                                                         i. V = VL +VF+VM+VP+VSR+VSS+VC Where\\n\\n  \
      \                      V = Total adjustment on account of all components.\\n\\n                          \
      \      VL = Adjustment on account of labour component.\\n\\n                               VF = Adjustment\
      \ on account of High-speed diesel component.\\n\\n                           VM = Adjustment on account of\
      \ other materials component.\\n\\n                              VP = Adjustment on account of Plant, machinery\
      \ and spares.\\n\\n                                VSR = Adjustment on account of Steel Reinforcement component.\\\
      n\\n                                VSS = Adjustment on account of Structural Steel / MS Steel / Pre-stressing\\\
      n\\n                                        strands components.\\n\\n                             VC = Adjustment\
      \ on account of Cement component.\\n\\n\\n                                       a.    Adjustment for Labour\
      \ Component:\\n\\n                               Price adjustment for increase or decrease in the cost due\
      \ to labour shall be paid\\n\\n                                     in accordance with following formula.\
      \ (Base: 2016=100).\\n\\n                            VL = R X PL x [(Li – Lo)/Lo] Where\\n\\n            \
      \                 VL = Increase or decrease in the cost of work during the month under consideration\\n\\\
      n                          due to changes in rates for local labour.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 114,\n  \"text\": \"Co = All India average wholesale price index for Ordinary Portland\
      \ Cement as\\n\\n                                     applicable for the month of submission of the tender\
      \ as published by Office of the\\n\\n                              Economic Adviser.\\n\\n               \
      \                    Ci = All India average wholesale price index for Ordinary Portland Cement for\\n\\n \
      \                                   the month preceding the ‘month under consideration’ as published by Office\
      \ of the\\n\\n                              Economic Adviser.\\n\\n                              PC =cost\
      \ co-efficient of “Cement” to the total cost.\\n\\n\\n                                         h. R= “Gross\
      \ value of the work done” by the Contractor for the period of work\\n                                   under\
      \ consideration, after excluding there from the cost of any materials\\n                                 \
      \     supplied free or at fixed rate to the Contractor as also any specific payments to\\n               \
      \                 be made to the Consultants engaged by the Contractor, which shall be\\n                \
      \                        indicated in the Contractor’s offer letter.\\n\\n                               \
      \     “Gross value of the work done” means work done value of the all the schedules\\n                   \
      \                        of BoQ. Unless otherwise specified in ‘contract Data’, determination of\\n      \
      \                               Price variation is applicable to all the schedules of BoQ.\\n\\n         \
      \                                                         i.  “PL”, “PF”, “PM”, PP”,”PSR”,”PSS”,” PC” and\
      \ “PX” are weightages (coefficients) of\\n                                       the Components representing\
      \ the estimated proportion of Labour, Fuel, Other\\n                                         Materials, Plant&\
      \ Machinery, Reinforcement Steel, Structural Steel / MS Steel\\n                                         \
      \                       / Pre-stressing  strands, Cement cost element and Nonadjustable Fixed\\n         \
      \                       component related to the execution of the Works, as stated in the relevant table\\\
      n                                              in ‘contract data’.\\n\\n\\n                              \
      \                                    ii. Period of Work under consideration will mean as under:\\n\\n    \
      \                                      a. In the case of first “On- account Bill” (IPC) the period from the\
      \ month in\\n                                     which the Contract agreement executed to the month of measurement\
      \ of\\n                                         the first bill.\\n                                       \
      \   b. In the case of second and subsequent “On-account” (IPC) and final bills, the\\n                   \
      \                    Period from the date of measurement for previous  bill to the date of\\n            \
      \                      measurement of that bill.\\n\\n                                                   \
      \               iii. Note:\\n\\n                                                1. Responsibility of arranging\
      \ the Price indices from the Office of the\\n                                 Economic Adviser/ Labour Bureau\
      \ (Ministry of Labour, GOI) etc., as desired\\n                                  by the Employer or the Engineer\
      \ shall rest with the Contractor.\\n                                                2. In case, Office of\
      \ the Economic Adviser stops publishing the Price indices,\\n                                      then Price\
      \ indices of any other Government Publications shall be considered.\\n\\n                                \
      \                  iv. Procedure in case of Delay in Availability of Final Indices:\\n                   \
      \           Where the final Price Indices are not available in the Office of the Economic\\n             \
      \                          Adviser, while making payment towards On-account  bills (IPC), payment\\n     \
      \                              towards Price Variation will be made on provisional basis based on the indices\\\
      n                                          available, to be adjusted in subsequent Payments as and when the\
      \ final Indices\\n                                         figures become available.\\n\\n               \
      \         11.1.2.1    Adjustment on Account of Price Variation:\\n\\n                                 Adjustment\
      \ on account of Price Variations may be positive (in which case extra\\n                              amount\
      \ shall be paid to the Contractor), or negative (in which case the amount of\\n                          \
      \          Price Variation shall be recovered from the Contractor). Adjustment on account of\\n          \
      \                          Price Variation shall be calculated separately, for each period, between two\\\
      n                                  successive dates of measurements for bills and to be claimed in each IPC.\\\
      n\\n                                    Preferably contractor to submit IPCs (RA Bills) monthly. In case,\
      \ the IPCs (RA\\n                                              Bills) submission period is more than One Month,\
      \ then the indices considered in\\n                                      price adjustment formula shall be\
      \ average of the indices of the corresponding\\n                              months under consideration between\
      \ previous and present IPCs.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 113,\n  \"text\": \"Pi = the wholesale price index for Construction Machine/Equipment\
      \ including\\n\\n                         Batching Plants during the month preceding the ‘month under consideration’\
      \ as\\n\\n                            published by Office of the Economic Adviser.\\n\\n                 \
      \          PP=cost co-efficient of “Plant, Machinery and Spares” to the total cost.\\n\\n                \
      \                   e. Adjustment on account of Reinforcement Steel components:\\n\\n                    \
      \         Price adjustment for increase or decrease in the cost of Reinforcement Steel shall\\n\\n       \
      \                 be paid in accordance with following formula. (Base: 2022-23=100)\\n\\n                \
      \           VSR = R X PSR x [(Si – So)/So] where\\n\\n                          VSR= Increase  or decrease\
      \  in  the  cost  of work  during the month under\\n\\n                             consideration due to changes\
      \ in rates for HYSD/TMT FE 500/550D Steel bar\\n\\n                             reinforcement.\\n\\n     \
      \                 So = All India average wholesale price index for Bars and Rods of Mild Steel as\\n\\n  \
      \                            applicable for the month of submission of the tender as published by Office of\
      \ the\\n\\n                        Economic Adviser.\\n\\n                              Si = All India average\
      \ wholesale price index for Bars and Rods of Mild Steel for\\n\\n                             the month preceding\
      \ the ‘month under consideration’ as published by Office of the\\n\\n                        Economic Adviser.\\\
      n\\n                           PSR=cost co-efficient of “Reinforcement Steel” to the total cost.\\n\\n   \
      \                                             f. Adjustment on account of Structural Steel  / MS Steel  /\
      \ Pre-stressing\\n                            strands components:\\n\\n                             Price\
      \ adjustment for increase or decrease in the cost of Structural Steel and Pre-\\n\\n                     \
      \         stressing strands shall be paid in accordance with following formula. (Base: 2022-\\n\\n       \
      \                  23=100)\\n\\n                           VSS = R X PSS x [(Si – So)/So] where\\n\\n    \
      \                      VSS= Increase  or decrease  in  the  cost  of work  during the month under\\n\\n  \
      \                           consideration due to changes in rates for Structural Steel  / MS Steel  / Pre-\\\
      n\\n                           stressing strands.\\n\\n                      So = All India average wholesale\
      \ price index for Hot-Rolled Structural Angles,\\n\\n                        Shapes, Sections, Beams, Channels\
      \ and Girders of Iron and Non-Alloy Steel\\n\\n                         as applicable for the month of submission\
      \ of the tender as published by Office of\\n\\n                             the Economic Adviser.\\n\\n  \
      \                            Si = All India average wholesale price index for Hot-Rolled Structural Angles,\\\
      n\\n                        Shapes, Sections, Beams, Channels and Girders of Iron and Non-Alloy Steel\\n\\\
      n                                  for the month preceding the ‘month under consideration’ as published by\
      \ Office of\\n\\n                             the Economic Adviser.\\n\\n                           PSS=cost\
      \ co-efficient of “Structural Steel” to the total cost.\\n\\n                                 g. Adjustment\
      \ on account of cement component:\\n\\n                             Price adjustment for increase or decrease\
      \ in the cost of cement shall be paid in\\n\\n                          accordance with following formula.\
      \ (Base: 2022-23=100)\\n\\n                        VC = R X PC x [(Ci – Co)/Co] where\\n\\n              \
      \          VC= Increase or decrease in the cost of work during the month under consideration\\n\\n       \
      \                 due to changes in rates for cement components.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 117,\n  \"text\": \"favour of Employer. For other machinery and staging materials\
      \ not advanced by\\n                     BMRCL the contractor can mortgage the same for financial undertakings.\\\
      n                                 b)      Shall not sell or alienate any part/portion of machinery, equipment\
      \ and\\n                                staging material without the consent of Employer.\\n             \
      \                      c)      In the event of any such sale/alienation of any portion or part of machinery\\\
      n                                 or staging materials, Employer shall hold First Charge and the proceeds\
      \ of such\\n                                sale or alienation shall be appropriated towards the loan/ credit/\
      \ advance in\\n                               respect of plant & machinery and staging materials brought to\
      \ the site by\\n                                  contractor.\\n\\nSpecial /          11.2.3     The cumulative\
      \ Special/Acceleration Advance Payment shall be paid for an\\nAcceleration               amount as stated\
      \ in ‘Contact Data. If an amount is not stated in ‘contract data’,\\nAdvances                         this\
      \ sub- clause shall not apply. The Special advance shall be payable in the\\n                            \
      \  currency and in same proportion as stated in the LOA, which shall be released in\\n                   \
      \          stages as and when deemed appropriate as decided by the Engineer/Employer.\\n                 \
      \        The advance released at the time shall not exceed 2.5% of the contract price.\\n\\n             \
      \              Employer at his sole discretion, may provide Special/Acceleration Advance based\\n        \
      \                  on the recommendation of the Engineer to expedite works or to bring forward the\\n    \
      \                         completion date(s) and on account  of immediate additional mobilization  to\\n \
      \                           complete   balance   works   as   targeted,   the   Employer  may   grant\\n \
      \                               ‘Special/Acceleration Advance’ to the contractor.\\n\\n                  \
      \       The Special/Acceleration Advance shall carry interest at the prevailing one-year\\n              \
      \      MCLR rate of the State Bank of India. Further, if the contractor does not accelerate\\n           \
      \               even after getting the advance and does not fulfil the commitments regarding\\n          \
      \                    work, then the simple interest shall be levied 18% per annum on the balance\\n      \
      \                    amount to be recovered against the Special/Acceleration advance, from the date\\n   \
      \                               of  communication   to  the  contractor  by  the  Engineer/Employer.  The\\\
      n                               Special/Acceleration Advance shall be paid on request of the Contractor.\\\
      n\\n                              Special Advance Payment will be paid against submission of unconditional\
      \ and\\n                                irrevocable Bank Guarantee(s)/Insurance Surety Bond for a value of\
      \ 110% of an\\n                           approved advance amount.\\n\\nRecovery of      11.2.4     The recovery\
      \ of advances granted under Sub-Clauses 11.2 commences once\\nAdvances              15% of the original Contract\
      \ Price has been paid and shall be completed by the\\n                              time 85% of the original\
      \ Contract Price has been paid or by the original Date of\\n                             Completion, whichever\
      \ occurs  earlier. The  total recovery from each Interim\\n                         Payment Certificate (IPC)\
      \ shall not exceed 30%. Recoveries shall be effected in\\n                               the same proportion\
      \ of currency(ies) in which the advance was originally paid.\\n                      No  request  for  deferment\
      \  of  recovery  of  interest-free  advances, namely\\n                                Mobilization Advance\
      \ and Plant & Machinery Advance,  shall  ordinarily be\\n                                entertained. However,\
      \ in exceptional circumstances, such as low billing or to ease\\n                               the Contractor’s\
      \ cash flow, BMRCL may consider such requests subject to the\\n                                 following\
      \ conditions:\\n\\n                                                (i) The amount of deferred recovery shall\
      \ be treated as a Special Advance.\\n\\n                                                   (ii) The e-BG/Insurance\
      \ Surety Bond shall neither be released nor reduced until\\n                                            full\
      \ recovery of the Special Advance.\\n\\n                                                      (iii) The Contractor\
      \ shall pay interest at the prevailing one-year MCLR of the State\\n                         Bank of India.\\\
      n\\n                           SBI MCLR shall be applicable on such Special Advance from the date of the IPC\\\
      n                                     in which recovery is deferred until the date of full recovery, at the\
      \ prevailing one-\\n                             year MCLR of the State Bank of India.\\n                \
      \        The  Contractor  shall have  the  option  to have  the  aforesaid  recoveries\\n                \
      \       commenced and / or completed earlier, and / or to have recoveries effected in\\n                 \
      \              instalments of higher amounts, and to repay part or whole of the advance by direct\\n     \
      \                     payment in advance rather than through on-account bills. The contractor shall\\n   \
      \                         ensure that the guarantee is valid and enforceable until the advance payment has\\\
      n                          been repaid. In  case  the  Contract  is  terminated  due  to  default  of  the\\\
      n                               Contractor or rescinded/foreclosed, due to any other reason, the Contractor\
      \ shall\\n                                 return the unrecovered amount  of  all advances  within 15 days\
      \  of issue  of\\n                                notice of termination/rescission/ foreclosure of the Contract\
      \ if the Contractor fails\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 121,\n  \"text\": \"Retention        11.7\\nMoney\\n                  11.7.1    \

      n                                  Data’ Alternatively, the contractor may submit e-Bank guarantee/Insurance\\\

      n                                para along with 1st IPC so as to facilitate not to deduct retention money\
      \ in\\n                             each IPC.\\n\\n                                                      \
      \        ii. If the contractor chooses to recover money from IPCs, then, at the request of\\n            \
      \                       the contractor, the Employer shall exchange retention money held by him for\\n   \
      \                          a e-Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond of like amount.\\n\\n                \
      \                                              iii. Whenever contract amount exceeds the contract price (as\
      \ stated in LoA),\\n                                     retention money equal to 5 percent of the increased\
      \ amount due to the\\n                                  Contractor will be deducted from subsequent IPCs.\
      \ At the request of the\\n                                     contractor, the Employer shall exchange retention\
      \ money held by him for a e-\\n                            Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond of like amount.\\\
      n\\n                                             iv. No retention money will be deducted against the Price\
      \ Variation sums paid to\\n                                   the contractor.\\n\\n                      \
      \                v. The Retention money is held by the Employer without obligation to invest them\\n     \
      \                               or account for interest thereon or to place them in a designated account.\
      \ No\\n                                       interest of whatsoever nature and type will be paid to the Contractor\
      \ by the\\n                              Employer in respect of Retention money.\\n\\n                   \
      \                         vi. e-Bank Guarantees shall be issued by an Indian Schedule bank (excluding\\n \
      \                                Cooperative Banks) or from a schedule Foreign Bank as defined in Section\\\
      n                                    2(e) of RBI Act 1934 read with Second Schedule.\\n\\n               \
      \                                 vii. Insurance Surety Bond: The Insurance Surety Bond shall be issued by\
      \ an\\n                                 Insurance  Company  authorized  by  the  Insurance  Regulatory  and\\\
      n                              Development Authority of India (IRDAI) and shall be payable in Bengaluru in\\\
      n                                  favour of Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL).\\n\\n     \
      \                                              viii. Retention Money e-BGs/Insurance Surety Bond shall be\
      \ valid for a period of\\n                             6 months beyond the contract period and should be extended,\
      \ as and when\\n                                   required by the Employer. The cost towards getting fresh\

      \ will be borne by the\\n                                     contractor. Format  for Retention Money e-BG/Insurance\
      \ surety Bond  is\\n                                 provided in contract forms.\\n\\n                   \
      \                         ix. In case contractor is a Joint Venture, then e-BG /Insurance Surety Bond shall\\\
      n                             be submitted by any member or members of JV.\\n\\n                  11.7.2 \

      \ and/or\\n                          money) shall become due to the Contractor on the date  of issue  of the\\\
      n                            Performance Certificate and the remainder shall become due to the Contractor\\\
      n                          upon final payment by the employer.\\n\\nStatement at      11.8       Not later\
      \ than 60 days after the issue of the Taking Over Certificate for the whole\\nCompletion                 \

      \  an estimate of amounts which the Contractor considers will become due\\n                              \

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 119,\n  \"text\": \"11.4.2      Evaluation\\n                            Except as\
      \ otherwise stated  in the Contract, the Engineer shall proceed  in\\n                            accordance\
      \ with Sub-Clause 3.5 [Determinations] to agree or determine the\\n                              Contract\
      \ Price by evaluating each item of work applying the measurement agreed\\n                               \
      \ or determined in accordance with the above Sub-Clauses 11.4 and 11.4.1 and the\\n                      \
      \      accepted rate for the item.\\n\\nInterim           11.5        Interim Payment Certificates\\nPayment\\\
      nCertificates\\n\\nApplication for   11.5.1     The Contractor shall submit Statement in Two copies to the\
      \ Engineer preferably\\nInterim                           after the end of each month, in a form approved\
      \ by the Engineer, showing in detail\\nPayment                      the amounts to which the Contractor considers\
      \ himself to be entitled, together with\\nCertificates                   supporting documents. The contractor\
      \ shall submit supporting documents viz.,\\n                               Detailed measurements recorded\
      \ in Measurement sheets, Abstract sheets along\\n                                with recorded bill for the\
      \ item actually executed including soft copy of the same for\\n                             checking and payment.\\\
      n\\n                         The Statement shall include the following items, as applicable, which shall be\\\
      n                            expressed in the various currencies in which the Contract Price is payable, in\
      \ the\\n                          sequence listed:\\n                                   (a) Value of the Works\
      \ executed.\\n                                   (b) any amount to be deducted for retention in accordance\
      \ with GCC Cl.11.7;\\n                                    (c) any amounts to be added and/or deducted for\
      \ ‘Change in law’ in accordance\\n                                    with Sub-Clause 11.1.1;\\n         \
      \                          (d) Applicable Output GST. Declaration of the turnover of the previous  bill in\\\
      n                       GSTR 1 and payment of taxes in GSTR 3B of the particular month is the\\n         \
      \                       evidence to be submitted as documentary proof of payment of taxes.\\n            \
      \                       (e) Applicable Price variation,\\n                                            (f)\
      \  any other additions or deductions which may have become due under the\\n                              \
      \    Contract or otherwise, including those under Clause 17 [Claims and Disputes];\\n                    \
      \         and\\n                                   (g) the deduction of amounts certified in all previous\
      \ Payment Certificates.\\n                                   (h) Any other document specified in Special condition\
      \ of Contract.\\n\\nIssue of Interim   11.5.2     Engineer shall, within 02 working days after receiving a\
      \ Statement & supporting\\nPayment                  documents under sub-clause11.5.1, deliver to the Employer,\
      \ with a copy to the\\nCertificates                    Contractor, an Interim Payment Certificate for adhoc\
      \ payment of 80% of bill value.\\n                                 Further, the Engineer shall, within 7 working\
      \ days of receiving a statement and\\n                              supporting documents, deliver to the Employer,\
      \ with a copy to the Contractor, an\\n                                 Interim Payment Certificate showing\
      \ the balance amount (i.e. 20%) which the\\n                            Engineer  fairly determines to be\
      \ due, with  all supporting particulars for any\\n                               reduction or withholding\
      \ made by the Engineer on the Statement if any.\\n\\n                         The Engineer may exclude any\
      \ item certified in any previous interim payments or\\n                            reduce the proportion of\
      \ any item previously certified in any of the interim\\n                          payments in light of any\
      \ information provided at a later stage.\\n\\n                        Where only a part of the payment applied\
      \ for is disputed, payment certificate shall\\n                          be issued for the undisputed amount.\\\
      n\\n                         The Engineer shall have the power to omit from any of the contractor’s requests\\\
      n                                    for payment the value of any work executed or Materials supplied or services\\\
      n                              rendered, with which he may for the time being be dissatisfied and for that\
      \ purpose\\n                          and for any other reason which to him may seem proper, may delete, correct\
      \ or\\n                             modify the sum(s) previously certified by him as being due to the Contractor.\\\
      n\\nPayment-         11.6     No amount  will be paid  until the Employer has received and approved the\\\
      nInterim and                 Performance Security. Also, no amount  will be paid  until the Employer has\\\
      nFinal                         received the Mobilization advance  utilization  certificate from Contractor\
      \ duly\\n                                     certified by the Engineer.\\n\\n                           \
      \       In case of joint venture following procedure will  be adopted for payment\"\n}"
