    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 120,\n  \"text\": \"A) Invoicing: The invoice shall be raised by\\n             \
      \                                                             i. the Joint venture\\n                    \
      \                          or\\n                                                                         \
      \    ii.  the  lead member  provided such  provision has been made  in  the\\n                           \
      \          JV/consortium agreement.\\n\\n                                 B) Payment: subject to (A)\\n\\\
      n                                                                          i.   Payment shall be made to Joint\
      \ Venture\\n                                         or\\n                                               \
      \                              ii.    to the lead member provided such provision has been made in the JV\\\
      n                                  agreement\\n                                          or\\n           \
      \                                                                  iii.  To the JV members separately in their\
      \ account provided such provision\\n                                  has been made in the JV/consortium agreement.\\\
      n\\n                                     a)   Payment of IPCs\\n\\n                                      \
      \                  (i)   After scrutiny and certification by the Engineer for payment of 80% of bill\\n  \
      \                                     value issued under sub-clause 11.5.2, the Employer within 04 working\
      \ days\\n                                             shall make the payment for the certified value. The\
      \ balance amount (i.e. 20%)\\n                                             shall be paid within 05 working\
      \ days from the certification of interim payment\\n                                                certificate\
      \ by the Engineer.\\n                                                            (ii)  In the IPC, the contractor\
      \ should certify that the amount received through IPC\\n                                    No. ______ for\
      \ a value of Rs. ______ has not been diverted to other projects\\n                                  and the\
      \ funds are fully utilised for execution of the subject contract. The\\n                                 \
      \      copies  of the supporting vouchers  of the disbursement made by the\\n                            \
      \            Contractor should also be attached with the IPC.\\n                                         \
      \                      (iii)  In case the contractor diverts the funds from this work to other projects\\\
      n                                            resulting in poor progress/mobilization of resources at work\
      \ site, then the\\n                                    employer is at liberty to either have the jointly managed\
      \ account or monitoring\\n                                 mechanism for contractor’s Bank account.\\n   \
      \                                             (iv) For payment of the contractor’s  bills and such other payment\
      \ releases,\\n                              BMRCL, at  its discretion, may adopt ESCROW mechanism of accounts,\\\
      n                                     which shall be binding on the contractor.\\n\\n                    \
      \                 b)   Incorrect Measurements and Billing.\\n                                            In\
      \ the event of Contractor submitting incorrect measurements or bill for the\\n                           \
      \                             first time, the Engineer will issue a written warning to him to the effect that\
      \ the\\n                                                    facility of 80% payment without detailed check\
      \ will be withdrawn in future.  If\\n                                        the contractor repeats the same,\
      \ this 80% payment facility may be completely\\n                                     withdrawn in respect\
      \ of this contract with BMRCL.\\n                                            In addition, a penalty of Rupees\
      \ one lakh shall be imposed for submission of\\n                                        the incorrect bill.\\\
      n                                        c) On-Accounts” Payments not prejudicial to final settlement.\\n\
      \                                     “On-Accounts” Payments made to the Contractor shall be without prejudice\
      \ to\\n                                        the  final making up  of the accounts (except where measurements\
      \ are\\n                                             specifically noted in the Measurement Book as “Final\
      \ Measurement” and as\\n                                   such have signed by the Contractor) and shall in\
      \ no respect be considered or\\n                                  used as evidence of any facts stated in\
      \ or to be inferred from such accounts\\n                                      nor of any particular quantity/quality\
      \ of work having been executed nor the\\n                                manner of its execution being satisfactory.\\\
      n                                Payment made against any item doesn’t necessarily mean acceptance are\\n\
      \                                   hundred percent with respect to quality of construction (as defects could\
      \ arise\\n                                               later on), tests to be done may not have been undertaken\
      \ due to whatever\\n                                    reason before release of payment\\n              \
      \                       d)   Final Payment\\n                                The Employer shall pay the amount\
      \ certified in the Final Payment Certificate\\n                                     payable within 56 days\
      \ from the date of issue of the Final Payment Certificate.\\n                                   Employer shall\
      \ make the payment of applicable Output GST.\\n                                The Employer shall make Price\
      \ Variation Payment\\n\\n                                     e)  BMRCL is not liable to pay Interest, for\
      \ any delay in payment/payments due\\n                                             to the contractor under\
      \ this contract.\"\n}"

- kind: parameter
  text: Retention money is deducted from running account bills as stated in the Contract Data, or alternatively
    the contractor may submit an e-Bank Guarantee or Insurance Surety Bond equal to the maximum retention amount
    along with the 1st IPC.
  evidence_ids:
  - J80396ccc60e8914a
  relation_type: none
  explicitness: not_a_relation

    okf_sha256: cc7b637ccd04c0125cec18eeb4887040af71ec0620ae2143a949342599d405b3

    json_pointer: /clauses/10/fragments/11
    json_record_id: null
    source_review_status: pending_manual_review
    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 121,\n  \"text\": \"Retention        11.7\\nMoney\\n                  11.7.1    \
      \                           Retention Money is the Security Deposit for the performance of the obligations\
      \ of\\n                                the contractor during the contract period.\\n\\n                  \
      \                                           i. From running account bills/IPCs the Employer shall deduct towards\
      \ Retention\\n                          money as an amount as stated ‘Contract Data’, subject to condition\
      \ that\\n                          maximum amount of Retention money shall not exceed as Stated in ‘Contract\\\
      n                                  Data’ Alternatively, the contractor may submit e-Bank guarantee/Insurance\\\
      n                                 Surety Bond equal to maximum amount of Retention money stated in above\\\
      n                                para along with 1st IPC so as to facilitate not to deduct retention money\
      \ in\\n                             each IPC.\\n\\n                                                      \
      \        ii. If the contractor chooses to recover money from IPCs, then, at the request of\\n            \
      \                       the contractor, the Employer shall exchange retention money held by him for\\n   \
      \                          a e-Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond of like amount.\\n\\n                \
      \                                              iii. Whenever contract amount exceeds the contract price (as\
      \ stated in LoA),\\n                                     retention money equal to 5 percent of the increased\
      \ amount due to the\\n                                  Contractor will be deducted from subsequent IPCs.\
      \ At the request of the\\n                                     contractor, the Employer shall exchange retention\
      \ money held by him for a e-\\n                            Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond of like amount.\\\
      n\\n                                             iv. No retention money will be deducted against the Price\
      \ Variation sums paid to\\n                                   the contractor.\\n\\n                      \
      \                v. The Retention money is held by the Employer without obligation to invest them\\n     \
      \                               or account for interest thereon or to place them in a designated account.\
      \ No\\n                                       interest of whatsoever nature and type will be paid to the Contractor\
      \ by the\\n                              Employer in respect of Retention money.\\n\\n                   \
      \                         vi. e-Bank Guarantees shall be issued by an Indian Schedule bank (excluding\\n \
      \                                Cooperative Banks) or from a schedule Foreign Bank as defined in Section\\\
      n                                    2(e) of RBI Act 1934 read with Second Schedule.\\n\\n               \
      \                                 vii. Insurance Surety Bond: The Insurance Surety Bond shall be issued by\
      \ an\\n                                 Insurance  Company  authorized  by  the  Insurance  Regulatory  and\\\
      n                              Development Authority of India (IRDAI) and shall be payable in Bengaluru in\\\
      n                                  favour of Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL).\\n\\n     \
      \                                              viii. Retention Money e-BGs/Insurance Surety Bond shall be\
      \ valid for a period of\\n                             6 months beyond the contract period and should be extended,\
      \ as and when\\n                                   required by the Employer. The cost towards getting fresh\
      \ e-BG/Insurance\\n                                 Surety Bond or extension of e-BG/Insurance Surety Bond\
      \ will be borne by the\\n                                     contractor. Format  for Retention Money e-BG/Insurance\
      \ surety Bond  is\\n                                 provided in contract forms.\\n\\n                   \
      \                         ix. In case contractor is a Joint Venture, then e-BG /Insurance Surety Bond shall\\\
      n                             be submitted by any member or members of JV.\\n\\n                  11.7.2 \
      \                          Release of Retention Money:\\n\\n                                             \
      \              i. One half of the Retention money (Bank Guarantees and/or money) shall\\n                \
      \         become due to the Contractor on the date of issue of the Taking Over Certificate\\n            \
      \                         for the whole of the works or the date of issue of last Taking over Certificate,\
      \ if\\n                         more than one Taking Over Certificate exist.\\n\\n                       \
      \                                       ii. One half of the balance of the Retention money (Bank Guarantees\
      \ and/or\\n                          money) shall become due to the Contractor on the date  of issue  of the\\\
      n                            Performance Certificate and the remainder shall become due to the Contractor\\\
      n                          upon final payment by the employer.\\n\\nStatement at      11.8       Not later\
      \ than 60 days after the issue of the Taking Over Certificate for the whole\\nCompletion                 \
      \    of Works, the Contractor shall submit, to the Engineer, six copies of a statement\\n                \
      \                  of completion with supporting documents, showing in detail, in the form approved\\n   \
      \                        by the Engineer under Sub-Clause 11.5:\\n                                    (a)\
      \    the final value of all work done in accordance with the Contract, up to the\\n                      \
      \               date stated in such Taking Over Certificate,\\n                                    (b)   any\
      \ further sums which the Contractor considers to be due, and\\n                                      (c) \
      \  an estimate of amounts which the Contractor considers will become due\\n                              \
      \             to him under the Contract.\\n                                    (d)   As built drawings.\\\
      n                                    (e)    ‘Local content certificate’ (if applicable) from the statutory\
      \ auditor or cost\\n                                         auditor of the company (In case of companies)\
      \ or from a practicing cost\"\n}"

      n                                     which shall be binding on the contractor.\\n\\n                    \
      \                 b)   Incorrect Measurements and Billing.\\n                                            In\
      \ the event of Contractor submitting incorrect measurements or bill for the\\n                           \
      \                             first time, the Engineer will issue a written warning to him to the effect that\
      \ the\\n                                                    facility of 80% payment without detailed check\
      \ will be withdrawn in future.  If\\n                                        the contractor repeats the same,\
      \ this 80% payment facility may be completely\\n                                     withdrawn in respect\
      \ of this contract with BMRCL.\\n                                            In addition, a penalty of Rupees\
      \ one lakh shall be imposed for submission of\\n                                        the incorrect bill.\\\
      n                                        c) On-Accounts” Payments not prejudicial to final settlement.\\n\
      \                                     “On-Accounts” Payments made to the Contractor shall be without prejudice\
      \ to\\n                                        the  final making up  of the accounts (except where measurements\
      \ are\\n                                             specifically noted in the Measurement Book as “Final\
      \ Measurement” and as\\n                                   such have signed by the Contractor) and shall in\
      \ no respect be considered or\\n                                  used as evidence of any facts stated in\
      \ or to be inferred from such accounts\\n                                      nor of any particular quantity/quality\
      \ of work having been executed nor the\\n                                manner of its execution being satisfactory.\\\
      n                                Payment made against any item doesn’t necessarily mean acceptance are\\n\
      \                                   hundred percent with respect to quality of construction (as defects could\
      \ arise\\n                                               later on), tests to be done may not have been undertaken\
      \ due to whatever\\n                                    reason before release of payment\\n              \
      \                       d)   Final Payment\\n                                The Employer shall pay the amount\
      \ certified in the Final Payment Certificate\\n                                     payable within 56 days\
      \ from the date of issue of the Final Payment Certificate.\\n                                   Employer shall\
      \ make the payment of applicable Output GST.\\n                                The Employer shall make Price\
      \ Variation Payment\\n\\n                                     e)  BMRCL is not liable to pay Interest, for\
      \ any delay in payment/payments due\\n                                             to the contractor under\
      \ this contract.\"\n}"

    and quantity variation rules where individual items can vary up to 25% plus side, and minor value items have
    specialized threshold and payment percentage bands.

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"12\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 125,\n      \"text\": \"\
      12         Variations\\n\\nRight to Vary     12.1         All Variations shall be recorded in a written instruction\
      \ from the Engineer either as\\n                          a  Contractor's  Variation  or as an Employer's\
      \  Variation, and  shall not be\\n                           implemented by the Contractor without such an\
      \ instruction in writing from the\\n                              Engineer. No Variation shall in any way\
      \ vitiate or invalidate the Contract. The\\n                               Contractor shall not make any alteration\
      \ and/or modification of the Works, unless\\n                          and until the Engineer instructs or\
      \ gives consent to a Variation. If the Construction\\n                              and/or Manufacture Documents\
      \ or Works are not in accordance with the Contract,\\n                               the rectification shall\
      \ not constitute a Variation.\\n\\nContractor’s      12.2       Value Engineering or Innovation\\nVariations\\\
      n\\nValue             12.2.1     The Contractor may submit to the Employer, in writing at his own cost, value\\\
      nEngineering                  engineering proposals for modifying the Employer’s Requirements provision of\\\
      nProposals                      additional land, access or feasibility over and above that  is provided in\
      \ the\\n                              Contract for the purpose of saving in time, construction or manufacture\
      \ costs. The\\n                              value engineering proposal shall not impair the essential character,\
      \ functions or\\n                                 characteristics or the Work, including service life, economy\
      \ of operation, ease of\\n                            maintenance, desired appearance, or Design and safety\
      \ standards.\\n                         The Contractor shall provide his value engineering proposal in a time\
      \  limit\\n                              prescribed by the Engineer. The Engineer’s decision in this regard\
      \ shall be\\n                          communicated to the Contractor within a reasonable period of time.\
      \  If by any\\n                            reason the time limit specified by the Engineer is exceeded, the\
      \ proposal may not\\n                          be considered.\\n                         The decision of the\
      \ Engineer in this regard shall be final and binding.\\n\\nValue             12.2.2           If the Employer\
      \ requires or accepts it, and if the Contractor wants to proceed with\\nEngineering                  the proposal,\
      \ the Contractor must provide (at no cost to the Employer) a detailed\\nProposals –                    report\
      \ prepared by a consultant acceptable to the Employer and which shall\\nContents                       include:\\\
      n                                       a.  a general description of the original Contract requirements for\
      \ the Works\\n                                 and the proposed changes\\n                               \
      \        b.  any  detail  of  all the proposed modifications  to the drawings and\\n                     \
      \                     specifications\\n                                          c.  any detail of  all Work\
      \ and goods affected by the value engineering\\n                                      proposal\\n        \
      \                               d.  a detailed estimate of the construction cost based on the original Contract\\\
      n                                     requirements and based on the proposed changes\\n\\n               \
      \                        e.  any resultant time extensions or reductions for the Contract\\n             \
      \                                              f.  statement to the extent of minimum saving expected. The\
      \ Contractor’s\\n                                        cost of preparing value engineering proposal shall\
      \ be excluded  in\\n                                      determining the estimated net savings in construction\
      \ costs.\\n\\nValue             12.2.3     The Employer may in his sole discretion, accept or reject the value\
      \ engineering\\nEngineering                  proposal or any part thereof and determine the estimated net\
      \ saving in the\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 126,\n      \"text\": \"Proposals-                 \
      \   construction cost. The Employer shall not be liable for delays or damages to the\\n    Employer      \
      \               Contractor due to any failure of the Employer to accept or act upon any value\\n    Review\
      \                       engineering proposal submitted pursuant to this Clause. If the submitted value\\n\
      \                                   engineering proposal is similar to a change / variation already under\
      \ consideration\\n                               by the Employer, the Employer may make such changes without\
      \ respect to the\\n                                   value engineering proposal.\\n                     \
      \          Once, the Employer  or the Engineer  rejects the value engineering during\\n                  \
      \                   proposition due to any reason,  it shall not be pursued by the Contractor in any\\n  \
      \                                   other form.\\n\\n    Amendments-    12.2.4           If the value engineering\
      \ proposal is acceptable to the Employer in whole or in\\n    Employer                       parts, it will\
      \ accept by execution of an amendment. Such amendment shall identify\\n    Issuance                      \
      \        all the changes in the specifications, Contract Period etc., shall specify net savings\\n       \
      \                       on construction costs and shall provide that the Contractor be paid 30% of saved\\\
      n                                    net savings amount based on the difference between the amount contained\
      \ in the\\n                                   Contract and the estimated net savings both as determined by\
      \ the Employer.\\n\\n     Contractor’s      12.2.5     The Contractor shall either accept or reject any proposed\
      \ amendment executed\\n    Acceptance                by the Engineer pursuant to this section within 5 working\
      \ days of its receipt date\\n    and Payment                from the Employer.  If the Contractor does not\
      \ reject the same in the period\\n                                       stipulated above, the amendments\
      \ shall be deemed to be accepted by the\\n                                    Contractor and shall become\
      \ a variation to the Contract. The Contractor’s\\n                                acceptance shall be unconditional\
      \ and compensation of 30% of the value shall\\n                                       constitute the full\
      \ compensation. The Contractor will be paid this 30% or less but\\n                                    not\
      \ more at the time of final payment on Engineer’s certification that the net\\n                          \
      \        savings as intended by value engineering have been achieved.\\n\\n    Employer’s       12.3     \
      \  “Employer’s Variation” means a change in the Employer's Requirements which\\n     Variations          \
      \      makes necessary alteration or modification of the Design, quality or scope of\\n                  \
      \           Works as described by or referred to in the Employer's Requirements. Changes\\n              \
      \                          to any sequence, method or timing of construction, manufacture, testing and\\n\
      \                               Commissioning and changes to any part of the Site or the work area or access\\\
      n                                     thereto will not constitute Employer's Variation.\\n\\n            \
      \               An Employer's Variation shall be requested and implemented in accordance with\\n         \
      \                     and subject to the following provisions:\\n\\n                                     \
      \    (a)  If the Employer requests for Variation, the Contractor shall submit following\\n               \
      \                              details at his own cost within 14 days or within the period as specified by\
      \ the\\n                                      Engineer;\\n\\n                                            \
      \                  (i)  a description of the proposed work to be performed and a programme for\\n        \
      \                                                     its execution.\\n                                  \
      \                                 (ii)  the  Contractor’s  proposal  for any  necessary  modifications  to\
      \  the\\n                                   programme according to Sub-Clause 4.13, and Key dates.\\n    \
      \                                                                  (iii) the Contractor's proposal for adjustment\
      \ to the Contract Price.\\n\\n                                                     (iv) effect on the warranties\
      \ of the Contractor set out in GCC Clause 4.2\\n\\n                                The contractor shall furnish\
      \ sufficient information in terms of rates/prices of\\n                                        the equipment/components\
      \ manufactured by the Contractor or sourced from\\n                                        the Vendors/Sub-contractors\
      \ such as: estimated man-hours, man-hours rates\\n                                               for manufactured\
      \ items, design costs, basic rate of materials, sub-assemblies,\\n                                       \
      \  taxes, duties, overheads & profits and inflation rate, so as to establish the\\n                      \
      \              reasonableness of the variation price.\\n\\n                                The decision of\
      \ the Employer in regard to consider it as Employer’s variation\\n                                       \
      \  or not is final and binding on the contractor.\\n\\n                                         (b) Any agreement\
      \ between the Engineer and the Contractor as to the terms upon\\n                                    which\
      \ an Employer's Variation may be implemented shall have no contractual\\n                                \
      \         or other legal effect, until it is in writing and is signed by the Contractor and\\n           \
      \                             the Engineer. The Engineer before signing such agreement shall take prior\\\
      n                                      approval of the Employer. The terms of this agreement will be binding\
      \ upon\\n                                        the Contractor and the Employer. This agreement shall determine\
      \ the amount\\n                                    which should be added to or deducted from the relevant\
      \ schedules in-pricing\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 127,\n      \"text\": \"document and/or the revisions\
      \ (if any) which should be made to the Payment\\n                             Schedules as a result of the\
      \ Variation.\\n\\n                                    In the event of the Engineer and the Contractor failing\
      \ to reach agreement on\\n                                 the revisions to be made to the schedules in pricing\
      \ documents the Engineer\\n                                       shall, with the approval of the Employer,\
      \ determine the amount which should\\n                           be added or deducted from the relevant schedules\
      \ amount which shall be\\n                                 binding on the Contractor. In case the Contractor\
      \ supplies part/ incomplete\\n                                 information or refuses to supply the required\
      \ information, the Employer shall\\n                              determine the cost of Variation based on\
      \ the information available to him from\\n                            any sources which in his judgment can\
      \ be used to determine the case. The\\n                                Contractor will proceed with the Work\
      \ on this basis but may submit his Claim\\n                                                             if\
      \ necessary.\\n\\n                                    In assessing work covered by any sub-contract, the Engineer\
      \ will have, where\\n                           he deems necessary, access to the original sub-contract conditions,\
      \ rates,\\n                                  prices and  details of the variation claimed, to assist  in evaluating\
      \ any\\n                                   Variations.\\n\\n                                  (c)  If the\
      \ Engineer withdraws the request for an Employer variation, the contractor\\n                            \
      \         shall have no claim of any kind whatsoever arising out of or in connection with\\n             \
      \               any of the proposal made or any failure to reach agreement in case the\\n                \
      \              Employer’s variation involves omission of part of the works the agreement\\n              \
      \                       shall address the issue of reduction in the Contract Price.\\n\\n                12.3.1\
      \      Variation in Quantity of Items Covered by the Bill of Quantities\\n\\n                       The quantities\
      \ of items shown in the Bill of Quantities are approximate, and liable\\n                                to\
      \ vary during the actual execution of the Work. The Contractor shall be bound to\\n                      \
      \        carry out and complete the stipulated work, irrespective of the magnitude of the\\n             \
      \                  variations in individual items specified in the Bill of Quantities. Also, Employer\\n \
      \                        does not guarantee work under every item of Bill of Quantities (BOQ).\\n\\n     \
      \                  Such variations in quantities shall be paid for in the manner laid down below;\\n\\n  \
      \                                                   I.   The accepted variation in quantity of each individual\
      \ item of the contract\\n                                would be up to 25% of the quantity (on Plus side)\
      \ originally contracted,\\n                                  except in case of foundation work (in which no\
      \ variation limit shall apply).\\n                                However, the rates for the increased quantities\
      \ shall be as per Sub- para\\n                                                             III below.\\n\\\
      n                                                    II.   The Contractor shall be bound to carry out the\
      \ work at the agreed rates\\n                               and shall not be entitled to any claim or any\
      \ compensation whatsoever\\n                                   upto the limit of 25% variation in quantity\
      \ of individual item of works. In\\n                                case of variation in quantity on minus\
      \ side, rates will be payable at the\\n                                 accepted rates of the contract for\
      \ the executed quantities.\\n\\n                                                   III.    In case an increase\
      \ in quantity of an individual item by more than 25% of\\n                                     the agreement\
      \ quantity is considered unavoidable, then same shall be\\n                                 executed at following\
      \ rates;\\n                                         a. Quantities operated  in excess  of 125% but upto 140%\
      \  of the\\n                                   agreement quantity of the concerned item, shall be paid at\
      \ 98% of the\\n                                           rate awarded for that item in that particular tender.\\\
      n                                         b. Quantities operated in excess of 140% of the agreement quantity\
      \ of\\n                                        the concerned item shall be paid at 96% of the rate awarded\
      \ for that\\n                                        item in that particular tender.\\n                  \
      \                          c. Variation to quantities of Minor Value Item: The  limit for varying\\n     \
      \                                      quantities for minor value items shall be 100% (as against 25%\\n \
      \                                      prescribed for other items). A minor value item for this purpose is\\\
      n                                       defined as an item whose original agreement value is less than 1 %\
      \ of\\n                                        the total original contract value.\\n                     \
      \                                          (i) Quantities operated upto and in excess of 100% of the agreement\\\
      n                                              quantity of the concerned minor value item, shall be paid at\
      \ the rate\\n                                     awarded for that item as per accepted rate;\\n         \
      \                                                           (ii) Quantities operated in excess of 100% but\
      \ upto 200% of the\\n                                      agreement quantity of the concerned minor value\
      \ item, shall be\\n                                          paid at 98% of the rate awarded for that item\

      n\\n                       12.3.2     Rates for Extra items of work / Non-Tender Items\\n\\n             \
      \                The Contractor on receipt of instructions from the Engineer shall be bound to carry\\n  \

- kind: parameter
  text: GCC Clause 13 sets forth determination and termination conditions, empowering the Employer to terminate
    the contract for contractor default upon 14 days' notice (or immediately in cases of insolvency/bankruptcy or
    corrupt practices) and specifying financial consequences, forfeiture of retention money, and performance guarantee
    encashment.

  text: GCC Clause 14 defines risk and responsibility, requiring the Contractor to indemnify the Employer and Engineer
    against all claims, damages, and losses arising from operations, and outlining Employer's risks such as war,
    civil commotion, and radioactive contamination.

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"14\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 133,\n      \"text\": \"\
      14         Risk and Responsibility\\n\\nIndemnity        14.1      The Contractor shall indemnify and hold\
      \ harmless the Employer, the Engineer, the\\n                            Designated Contractors, representatives\
      \ and employees from and against  all\\n                                 actions, suits, proceedings, claims,\
      \ damages, losses, expenses and demands of\\n                             every nature and description, by\
      \ reasons of any act or omissions of the Contractor,\\n                                  his representative\
      \ or his employees in the execution of the Works, including\\n                                professional\
      \ services provided by the Contractor or in the guarding the same.\\n                         These indemnification\
      \ obligations shall include but not be limited to claims,\\n                          damages,  losses, damage\
      \ proceedings, charges and expenses which are\\n                                   attributable to:\\n\\n\
      \                                    (a)   sickness, or disease, or death of, or injury to any person; and\\\
      n                                    (b)   loss of, or damage to, or destruction of any property (other than\
      \ the Works)\\n                                       including consequential loss of use; and\\n        \
      \                             (c)   Loss, damage or costs arising from the carriage of Plant and Materials\\\
      n                                     and/or ownership or chartering of marine vessels by the Contractor,\
      \ or any\\n                                      sub-contractor of any tier.\\n\\n                       \
      \  The Contractor shall also indemnify and save harmless the Employer from and\\n                        \
      \       against all claims and proceedings on account of infringements of patents rights,\\n             \
      \                  design, trademark name etc. as detailed out in Sub Clause 5.8.\\n\\n                  \
      \                    All sums payable by way of compensation under these conditions shall be\\n          \
      \                   considered reasonable compensation payable to the Employer, without reference\\n     \
      \                             to the actual loss or damage sustained, and whether or not any damage shall\
      \ have\\n                          been sustained. The decision of the Engineer as to compensation claimed\
      \ shall\\n                          be final and binding.\\n\\nContractor’s      14.2      The Contractor\
      \ shall take full responsibility for the care of the Works, or any part\\nCare of the                    \
      \ thereof, including full responsibility for the care of any work being manufactured,\\nWorks            \
      \             or stored off-Site for inclusion in the Works, or in the course of transportation to\\n    \
      \                           the Site, and for the care of Contractor’s Equipment, Temporary Works, Plant and\\\
      n                          any other Material, whatsoever, on the Site or delivered to or placed on the Site\
      \ in\\n                             connection with, or for the purpose of the Works.\\n\\n              \
      \           The Contractor shall take this responsibility from the Commencement Date until\\n            \
      \                   the date of issue of the Taking Over Certificate, when responsibility shall pass to\\\
      n                               the Employer. If the Engineer issues a Taking Over Certificate for any Section\
      \ or\\n                                 part of the Works, the Contractor shall cease to be responsible for\
      \ the care of that\\n                              Section or part from the date of issue of such Taking Over\
      \ Certificate when\\n                                  responsibility shall pass to the Employer.\\n\\n  \
      \                       The Contractor shall take responsibility for the care of any outstanding work which\\\
      n                                        is required to be completed prior to the expiry of the Contract Period,\
      \ until the\\n                            Engineer confirms in writing that such outstanding work has been\
      \ completed.\\n                                                   If any loss or damage happens to the Works,\
      \ any other property or person, arising\\n                            from any cause other than the Employer's\
      \ risks listed in Sub-Clause14.3, during\\n                               the period for which the Contractor\
      \ is responsible, the Contractor shall rectify such\\n                                loss or damage, at his\
      \ cost, so that the Works conform with the Contract or at the\\n                               option of the\
      \ Employer, will pay or allow to the Employer the cost of rectifying such\\n                             \
      \   loss or damage. Notwithstanding such loss or damage, the Contractor shall\\n                         \
      \   proceed with the execution of Works in  all respects in accordance with the\\n                       \
      \       Contract and the Engineer's instructions. The Contractor shall also be liable for\\n             \
      \             any loss or damage to the Works caused by any operations carried out by the\\n             \
      \                  Contractor after the date of issue of the Taking Over Certificate.\\n\\nEmployer’s    \
      \   14.3      The Employer's risks of loss or damage to physical property in India and of death\\nRisks  \
      \                   and personal injury occurring in India in consequence of the performance of\\n       \
      \                          obligations under the Contract are:\\n\\n                                    (a)\
      \   War, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), invasion, act of foreign\\n                       \
      \           enemies, act of terrorism.\\n                                    (b)    rebellion, revolution,\
      \ insurrection, or military or usurped power, or civil war,\\n                                         within\
      \ India,\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 134,\n      \"text\": \"(c)     riot, commotion or disorder\
      \ by persons unless solely restricted to or caused\\n                                     by employees of\
      \ Contractor or of sub-contractors currently or formerly\\n                                   engaged in the\
      \ Works,\\n                                          (d)   Ionising radiations, or contamination by radio-activity\
      \ from any nuclear fuel,\\n                                            or from any nuclear waste from the\
      \ combustion of nuclear fuel, radio-active\\n                                                toxic explosive,\
      \ or other hazardous properties of any explosive nuclear\\n                                     assembly or\
      \ nuclear component of such an assembly, except to the extent\\n                                         \
      \      to which the Contractor may be responsible for the use of any radio-active\\n                     \
      \                         material, Pressure waves caused by  aircraft or other  aerial devices\\n       \
      \                                   (e)    travelling at sonic or supersonic speeds, and\\n              \
      \                       use or occupation by the Employer of any part of the Works, except as\\n         \
      \                                             (f)   may be specified in the Contract.\\n\\n    Consequences\
      \   14.4             If an Employer’s risk results in loss or damage, the Contractor shall promptly notify\\\
      n     of Employer’s                the Engineer and shall rectify this loss or damage to the extent required\
      \ by the\\n    Risks                        Engineer.\\n\\n                                              \
      \              If the Contractor suffers delay and/or incurs cost from rectifying this loss or\\n        \
      \                      damage, the Contractor shall give notice to the Engineer and shall be entitled to\\\
      n                                      claim:\\n\\n                                          (a)   Extension\
      \ of time for any such delay,  if completion is or will be delayed,\\n                                   \
      \    under Sub-Clause 8.4, and\\n                                          (b)   Amount of such cost, which\
      \ shall be added to the Contract Price.\\n\\n     Contractor’s      14.5      The Contractor's risks are all\
      \ risks other than the Employer's risks given in sub-\\n    Risks                         clause14.3.\\n\\\
      n     Limitation of                Except as provided otherwise in these Conditions, neither party shall be\
      \ liable to\\n      Liability                       the other party for loss of use of any Works, loss of\
      \ profit, loss of any Contract or\\n                               any other indirect or consequential loss\
      \ or damage which may be suffered by the\\n                                     other party in connection\
      \ with the Contract. The total liability of the Contractor to\\n                                    the Employer\
      \ under the Contract shall not exceed the Contract Price. Except that\\n                                 \
      \          this Sub-Clause shall not limit the liability of the Contractor:\\n                           \
      \               (a)   under Sub-Clauses 4.18,4.19,5.7,7.10, 7.11, and 8.6\\n                             \
      \             (b)   under any other provisions of the Contract which expressly impose a\\n               \
      \                             greater liability,\\n                                           (c)    in cases\
      \ of fraud, wilful misconduct or illegal or unlawful acts, or\\n                                         \
      \ (d)    in cases of acts or omissions of the Contractor which are contrary to the\\n                    \
      \                most elementary rules of diligence which a conscientious Contractor would\\n            \
      \                        have followed in similar circumstances.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"heading_line\": \"14\
      \         Risk and Responsibility\",\n  \"review_status\": \"pending_manual_review\",\n  \"title\": \"Risk\

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"17\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 139,\n      \"text\": \"\
      17         Claims, Disputes and Conciliation\\n                         Any and all Disputes shall be settled\
      \ in accordance with the provision of this\\n                           Clause\\nProcedure for     17.1  \
      \           If the Contractor intends to claim any additional payment under any clause of\\nClaims       \
      \               these Conditions or otherwise, the Contractor shall give notice to the Engineer as\\n    \
      \                      soon as possible and in any event within 28 days of the start of the event giving\\\
      n                                   rise to the claim.\\n\\n                         The Contractor shall\
      \ keep such contemporary records as may be necessary to\\n                                substantiate any\
      \ claim, either on the Site or at any other location acceptable to the\\n                              Engineer.\
      \ Without admitting the Employer’s liability, the Engineer shall, on receipt\\n                          \
      \        of such notice, inspect such records and may instruct the Contractor to keep\\n                 \
      \                 further contemporary records. The Contractor shall permit the Engineer to inspect\\n   \
      \                                        all such records, and shall (if instructed) submit copies to the\
      \ Engineer.\\n\\n\\n                               Within 28 days of such notice, or such other time as may\
      \ be agreed by the\\n                              Engineer, the Contractor shall send to the Engineer a fully\
      \ detailed claim which\\n                               includes full supporting particulars of the basis\
      \ of the claim and additional payment\\n                               claimed. If the event or circumstance\
      \ giving rise to the claim has a continuing\\n                                    effect:\\n\\n          \
      \                        a.  the initial fully detailed claim shall be considered as interim;\\n\\n      \
      \                            b.  the Contractor shall send further interim claims at monthly intervals, giving\
      \ the\\n                                  cumulative amount claimed, and any such further particulars as the\
      \ Engineer\\n                         may reasonably require; and\\n\\n                                  \
      \  c.  the contractor shall send a final claim within 28 days after the end of effects\\n                \
      \                      resulting from the event or circumstance, or within such other period as may\\n   \
      \                          be proposed by the Contractor and approved by the Engineer.\\n\\n             \
      \                                      If the Contractor fails to comply with this Sub-clause, he shall not\
      \ be entitled to\\n                               claim any additional payment.\\n\\nPayment for      17.2\
      \      The Contractor  shall be  entitled  to have included  in any Interim Payment\\nClaims             \
      \              Certificate such amount for any claim as the Engineer considers due, after taking\\n      \
      \                        approval from  the Employer.  If the  particulars supplied are  insufficient  to\\\
      n                                substantiate the whole of the claim, the Contractor shall be entitled to\
      \ payment for\\n                           such part of the claim as has been substantiated.\\n\\nNo Legal\
      \         17.3      Any and all Disputes shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Clause\\naction\
      \ till                     17. No action at law concerning or arising out of any Dispute shall be commenced\\\
      nDispute                      unless and until all applicable Dispute resolution procedures set out in Clause\
      \ 17\\nSettlement                      shall have been finally exhausted in relation to that Dispute or any\
      \ Dispute out of\\nProcedure is                which that Dispute shall have arisen with which  it may be\
      \ or may have been\\nExhausted                   connected.\\n\\nNotice of         17.4     A Dispute shall\
      \ be deemed to arise when one party serves a notice in writing\\nDispute                         (hereinafter\
      \ called a \\\"Notice of Dispute\\\") within 30 days from the date of rejection\\n                       \
      \           of claim by the parties.\\n\\n\\nDispute           17.5       Disputes shall be settled through\
      \ Conciliation procedures as established by “The\\nResolution                      Arbitration and Conciliation\
      \ Act, 1996” and as amended from time to time.\\n\\nConciliation      17.6        Within 60 days of receipt\
      \ of Notice of Dispute, either party shall refer the matter in\\n                               dispute to\
      \ conciliation. Conciliation proceedings shall be initiated within 30 days\\n                            \
      \      of one party  inviting the other  in  writing  to  Conciliation.  Conciliation  shall\\n          \
      \             commence when the other party accepts in writing this invitation.  If the invitation\\n    \
      \                                    is not accepted, then Conciliation shall not take place.    If the party\
      \ initiating\\n                                   conciliation does not receive a reply within 30 days from\
      \ the date on which he\\n                           sends the invitation, he may elect to treat this as a\
      \ rejection of the invitation to\\n                                  conciliate and inform the other party\
      \ accordingly.\\n                         The Conciliation shall be undertaken by one Conciliator selected\
      \ from a panel of\\n                                 Conciliators maintained by the Employer. The Conciliator\
      \ shall assist the parties\\n                                  to reach an amicable settlement in an independent\
      \ and impartial manner.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 140,\n      \"text\": \"Conciliation      17.7\
      \      The Employer shall maintain a panel of Conciliators with requisite qualifications\\n    Procedure \
      \                and professional experience who shall be from serving or retired engineers of\\n        \
      \                      Government Departments, or of Public Sector Undertakings. Panel  list not to\\n   \
      \                                  include serving or former employees of the Employer. Out of this panel,\
      \ a list of\\n                                    three Conciliators shall be sent to the Contractor who shall\
      \ choose one of them to\\n                                     act as Conciliator and conduct conciliation\
      \ proceedings in accordance with “The\\n                                        Arbitration and Conciliation\
      \ Act, 1996”, of India. The party serving notice of dispute\\n                              on the other party\
      \ shall also serve such notice on the Conciliator chosen as per\\n                                       \
      \    this Clause. The Employer at the time of offering the panel of Conciliators to be\\n                \
      \                  appointed as Conciliator shall also supply the information with regard to the\\n      \
      \                                  qualifications of the said Conciliators nominated in the panel along with\
      \ their\\n                                     professional experience, phone nos. and addresses to the Contractor.\\\
      n\\n                                        In the event of the Contractor not choosing the Conciliator from\
      \ the panel furnished\\n                               by the Employer, within a period of 30 days, the Employer\
      \ is at liberty to choose\\n                              and nominate a Conciliator from the same panel and\
      \ communicate to the\\n                                    Contractor which will be final and binding on the\
      \ Contractor.\\n\\n\\n                             The Employer and the Contractor  shall  in good  faith\
      \ co-operate  with the\\n                                       Conciliator and, in particular, shall endeavour\
      \ to comply with requests by the\\n                                       Conciliator to submit written materials,\
      \ provide evidence and attend meetings.\\n                             Each party may, on his own initiative\
      \ or at the invitation of the Conciliator, submit\\n                                        to the Conciliator\
      \ suggestions for the settlement of the dispute.\\n\\n\\n                         When it appears to the Conciliator\
      \ that there exist elements of a settlement which\\n                          may be acceptable to the parties,\
      \ he shall formulate the terms of a possible\\n                                    settlement and submit them\
      \ to the parties for their observations. After receiving\\n                                    the observations\
      \ of the parties, the Conciliator may reformulate the terms of a\\n                                    possible\
      \ settlement in the light of such observations.\\n\\n\\n                                                 \
      \           If the Parties reach agreement on a settlement of the dispute, they may draw up\\n           \
      \                   and sign a  written settlement agreement.  If requested by the Parties, the\\n       \
      \                                Conciliator may draw up, or assist the Parties in drawing up, the settlement\\\
      n                                 agreement.\\n                         When the Parties sign the settlement\
      \ agreement, it shall be final and binding on\\n                                    the parties and persons\
      \ claiming under them respectively.\\n                             The Conciliator shall authenticate the\
      \ settlement agreement and furnish a copy\\n                                     thereof to each of the Parties.\\\
      n\\n\\n                            To the fullest extent feasible, the conciliatory process must be concluded\
      \ within a\\n\\n                                    period of sixty days subsequent to the acknowledgment\
      \ of the appointment notice\\n\\n                               by the Conciliator.\\n\\n                \
      \             The Parties shall not initiate, during the conciliation proceedings, any judicial\\n       \
      \                           proceedings in respect of a dispute that is the subject matter of the conciliation\\\
      n                                   proceedings.\\n\\n    Termination of    17.8      The conciliation proceedings\
      \ shall be terminated:\\n     Conciliation                    a.  by the signing of the settlement agreement\
      \ by the Parties on the date of\\n    Proceedings                    agreement; or\\n                    \
      \                    b.  by written declaration of the Conciliator, after consultation with the Parties, to\\\
      n                                        the effect further efforts at conciliation are no longer justified,\
      \ on the date of\\n                                           declaration; or\\n                         \
      \                 c.  by a written declaration of the Parties to the Conciliator to the effect that the\\\
      n                                             conciliation proceedings are terminated, on the date of declaration;\
      \ or\\n                                        d.  by a written declaration of a Party to the other Party\
      \ and the Conciliator,  if\\n                                       appointed, to the effect that the conciliation\
      \ proceedings are terminated, on\\n                                        the date of declaration.\\n   \
      \                         Upon termination of the conciliation proceedings, the Conciliator shall fix the\
      \ costs\\n                                        of the conciliation and give written notice thereof to the\

      \ agreement provides for a different\\n                                   apportionment. All other expenses\
      \ incurred by a Party shall be borne by that Party.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 141,\n      \"text\"\

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"16\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 137,\n      \"text\": \"\
      16        Force Majeure\\n\\nDefinition of      16.1         In this Clause, \\\"force majeure  \\\" means\
      \ an event beyond the control of the\\nForce Majeure              Employer and the Contractor, which makes\
      \ it impossible or illegal for a party to\\n                              perform, including but not limited\
      \ to:\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 138,\n      \"text\": \"(a)    act of God;\\n                \
      \                         (b)    war, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), invasion, act of foreign\\\
      n                                       enemies, mobilisation, requisition, or embargo;\\n               \
      \                           (c)     rebellion, revolution, insurrection, or military or usurped power, or\
      \ civil war;\\n\\n                                         (d)    contamination by radio-activity from any\
      \ nuclear fuel, or from any nuclear\\n                                      waste from the combustion of nuclear\
      \ fuel, radio-active toxic explosive, or\\n                                           other hazardous properties\
      \ of any explosive nuclear assembly or nuclear\\n                                    component of such an\
      \ assembly;\\n                                         (e)      riot, commotion or disorder, unless solely\
      \ restricted to employees of the\\n                                          Contractor or of his Sub-contractors\
      \ currently or formerly engaged on the\\n                                      Works.\\n\\n              \
      \                                              If a party considers that  it may be affected by Force Majeure,\
      \ the party shall\\n                                  promptly notify the other party and Engineer of such\
      \ Force Majeure within 21 days\\n                                        of such occurrence. If neither party\
      \ issues any notice regarding the event within\\n                              21 days of its occurrence,\
      \ the said event shall be deemed not to have occurred\\n                              and the Contract shall\
      \ continue to have effect as such.\\n\\n     Effect of Force    16.2        Neither the Employer nor the Contractor\
      \ shall be considered in default or in\\n    Majeure Event                 contractual breach to the extent\
      \ that performance of obligations is prevented by a\\n                                Force Majeure event\
      \ which arises after the date of signing of agreement. Upon\\n                                    the occurrence\
      \ of such Force Majeure, the affected party shall endeavour to\\n                                   continue\
      \ to perform its obligations as far as reasonably practicable.\\n\\n     Contractor’s      16.3          \
      \  If affected by such Force Majeure, the Contractor shall promptly notify the\\n     Responsibility     \
      \          Engineer of any proposals  for overcoming the consequences of the Force\\n                    \
      \              Majeure, including any reasonable alternative means for performance, but shall\\n         \
      \                           not carry out these proposals without the consent of the Engineer.\\n\\n    Employer’s\
      \       16.4             If affected by such Force Majeure, the Employer shall promptly notify the Engineer\\\
      n     Responsibility             and the Contractor of any proposals for overcoming the consequences of the\\\
      n                                Force Majeure.\\n\\n    Payment to       16.5            If the Works shall\
      \ suffer loss or damage due to such Force Majeure, the Contractor\\n     Contractor                      shall\
      \ be entitled to have included, in an Interim Payment Certificate, the Cost of\\n                        \
      \       work executed in accordance with the Contract.\\n\\n    Resumption of    16.6      The obligations\
      \ under the Contract shall be resumed as soon as practicable after\\n    Work                         the\
      \ event has come to an end or ceased to exist.\\n                                        In case of doubt\
      \ or dispute, whether a particular occurrence should be considered\\n                              an “event”\
      \ as defined under this clause, the decision of the Engineer shall be final\\n                           \
      \   and binding.\\n                             Works that have already been measured shall be paid for by\
      \ the Employer even\\n                                                                   if the same is subsequently\
      \ destroyed or damaged as a result of the event. The\\n                                    cost of rebuilding\
      \ or replacing any work that has been measured shall be borne\\n                               by the Employer.\\\
      n\\n     Optional          16.7        Irrespective of any extension of time,  if a Force Majeure occurs and\
      \ its effect\\n     Termination,                 continues for a periodof6 months, after notice has been given\
      \ under Sub-Clause\\n    Payment and                  16.1, either party may give to the other party a notice\
      \ of termination the Contract\\n    Release                    which shall take effect 28 days after the notice\
      \ is given. Unless at the end of 28\\n                                   days’ period the effect of the Force\
      \ Majeure has ceased, the Contract shall\\n                                    terminate upon that date. Otherwise,\
      \ the Contract shall remain in effect.\\n\\n                             The Contractor shall be paid fully\
      \ for the work done under the Contract, but not for\\n                               any defective work or\
      \ work done which has been destroyed or damaged before\\n                                                \
      \  its measurement. The Employer shall have the option to take over any Plant and\\n                     \
      \                Materials lying at site, at rates provided for in the Contract, failing that, as per\\n \
      \                                       rates, which are determined to be fair and reasonable by the Engineer.\\\
      n\\n    Release from     16.8             If under the law of the Contract the Employer and the Contractor\
      \ are released from\\n    Performance                    further performance, the sum payable by the Employer\
      \ to the Contractor shall be\\n    Under the Law                the same as would have been payable under\
      \ Sub-Clause 16.7, if the Contract had\\n                              been terminated under that Sub-Clause.\"\
      \n    }\n  ],\n  \"heading_line\": \"16        Force Majeure\",\n  \"review_status\": \"pending_manual_review\"\
      ,\n  \"title\": \"Force Majeure\"\n}"

      15.         Insurance.\\n\\n\\n    Professional    15.1       The Contractor  shall effect and maintain  Professional\
      \  Indemnity  Insurance,\\n    Indemnity                     preferably in the name of BMRCL, for the amount\
      \ in Indian Rupees stipulated in\\n    Insurance                     ‘Contract data’ In respect of any design\
      \ of the Works to be carried out by or on\\n                                     behalf of the Contractor.\
      \  This insurance, which shall ensure the Contractor’s\\n                                                \
      \  liability by reason of professional negligence and errors in the design of the Works,\\n              \
      \                          shall be valid from the date of commencement of Works, until  5 years  after the\\\
      n                                  date  of issue  of Performance  Certificate.\\n                       \
      \                  Alternatively, the Contractor shall renew the insurance before the expiry of the\\n   \
      \                                Yearly Insurance in such a way that the entire validity period is covered.\\\
      n                             The Engineer will not issue Final Payment Certificate until the Contractor has\\\
      n                                produced evidence that coverage of the Professional Indemnity Insurance has\\\
      n                              been provided for the aforesaid period.\\n\\n     Injury to third    15.2 \
      \      The contractor shall be liable for and shall indemnify the Employer (principal)\\n     party      \
      \                    against any liability, loss claim or proceedings whatsoever arising under any\\n    personnel\
      \ and                 statute or at common law in respect of personal injury to or the death of any person\\\
      n     Property of                 whosoever arising out of or in the course of or caused by the carrying out\
      \ the\\n     third party/ies                 contract works, unless due to any act or neglect of the Employer\
      \ (principal).\\n\\n                             The contractor shall be liable for and shall indemnify the\
      \ Employer(Principal)\\n                                    against any expenses, liability, loss, claim or\
      \ proceedings in respect of any injury\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 135,\n      \"text\": \"or damage\
      \ whatsoever to any property real or personal in so far as such injury or\\n                        damage\
      \ arises out of or in the course of or by reason of the carrying out of the\\n                           \
      \     contract works, and provided always that the same is due to any negligence,\\n                     \
      \        omission or default of the contractor, his servants or agents of any sub-contractor,\\n         \
      \                         his servant or agent.\\n\\nInsurance        15.3         Without prejudice to his\
      \  liability to indemnify the Employer (Principal), the\\nAgainst  Injury                contractor shall\
      \ take all types of insurance policies such as Contractors All Risks\\nto Persons and             and Workmen’s\
      \ Compensation (Employers Liability) Policy at his cost in the\\nProperty.                  JOINT NAMES OF\
      \ THE EMPLOYER (PRINCIPAL) AND CONTRACTOR AND\\n                     SUB CONTRACTOR, IF ANY and maintain such\
      \ policies throughout the period\\n                                   of contract works.\\n\\n           \
      \               Such insurance as are necessary to cover the liability of the contractor or as the\\n    \
      \                        case may be of such Sub-Contractor in respect of personal injuries or death of\\\
      n                         workmen engaged by the contractor or sub-contractor, arising out of or in course\\\
      n                                   of or caused by carrying out of work.\\n\\n                         The\
      \ contractor at his cost shall maintain in the joint names of the Employer\\n                            \
      \         (principal) and contractor such insurances as may be required in respect of any\\n             \
      \                expenses, liability, loss, claim or proceedings which the Employer (principal) may\\n   \
      \                               incur or sustain by reason of injury or damage to property real or personal\
      \ arising\\n                                out of or in the course or by reason of the carrying out the work,\
      \ and caused\\n                               otherwise than by the negligence, omission or default of the\
      \ contractor, his\\n                               servants or agents or any sub-contractor, his servants\
      \ or agents.\\n\\n                         Any such insurance policy or policies or receipts effected shall\
      \ have to be\\n                              submitted in original  with the Employer (principal).\\n\\nInsurance\
      \ of     15.4       The contractor at his cost shall in the JOINT NAMES OF THE EMPLOYER\\nthe contract   \
      \             (PRINCIPAL) AND CONTRACTOR:\\nworks under a\\nContractors All                              \
      \     i.    Insure the plant, material and works forming part of the contract works\\nRisks              \
      \                    against loss or damage by all types of risks as envisaged under the\\nInsurance     \
      \                       standard Contractors All Risks policy.\\nPolicy.                                 \
      \                    ii.    obtain the insurance policy for the full replacement cost at site of the\\n  \
      \                                       contract works entrusted to the contractor, sub-contractor.\\n   \
      \                                                               iii.    Include in the insurance policy the\
      \ cost of demolition works if any.\\n                                               iv.   Ensure that the\
      \ policy shall remain in force till the entire contract works\\n                                         \
      \          is completed and the Taking Over Certificate issued.\\n\\n                         The Contractors\
      \ All Risks policy which is an All Risks policy with only named\\n                                exclusions\
      \ normally extends cover for loss or damage caused by fire, storm,\\n                               tempest,\
      \ lightning, flood, aircraft or anything dropped there from, aerial objects,\\n                          \
      \                riot and civil commotion, defective materials, defective workmanship, etc. and\\n       \
      \                             shall be extended to cover the following:\\n\\n                            \
      \            a.  earthquake risks\\n                                        b.  terrorism\\n             \

      \ 10%\\n                                            of the contract works.\\n                            \
      \            d.  Debris removal (of insured property) to the extent of at least Rs. 50 lakhs\\n          \
      \                              e.  Owners (Principal`s) surrounding property to the extent of 10% of the\\\
      n                                           policy limits.\\n                                            \
      \              f. Defect Liability for a period of 12 months from the date mentioned in the\\n           \
      \                             taking over certificate for the whole of the works.\\n\\n Contractor’s    15.5\
      \          All the Contractor's Plant, Equipment & Materials shall be brought and kept at the\\n plant & \
