    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 88,\n  \"text\": \"Protection   of  4.17       The Contractor shall take all reasonable\
      \ steps to protect the environment (both on\\n     the                       and off the Site) and to avoid\
      \ injury, damage and nuisance to people and property\\n    Environment                   resulting from pollution,\
      \ noise and other results of his operations. The Contractor\\n                                        shall\
      \ ensure that air emissions, surface discharges and effluent from the Site\\n                            \
      \        during the Contract Period shall not exceed the values indicated in the Employer's\\n           \
      \                     Requirements & Technical  specifications, and  shall not exceed the values\\n      \
      \                              prescribed by law. The Contractor shall conform to the Employer’s Requirements\\\
      n                         & Technical specifications and shall indemnify the Employer against any liability\\\
      n                                     or damages or claims arising out of his operations. The Contractor shall\
      \ be\\n                                    responsible and liable for any stoppage, closure or suspension\
      \ of the works due\\n                                        to any contravention of statutory requirements\
      \ relating to the protection of the\\n                                 environment and shall indemnify and\
      \ keep indemnified the Employer in this\\n                                     regard.\\n                \
      \                     Outline Environmental Plan means the environmental plan forming part of the\\n     \
      \                             Tender, setting out,  in summary form, the Contractor's proposed means of\\\
      n                                 complying  with  his  obligations  in  relation  to  environmental  quality.\
      \  Site\\n                                  Environmental Plan means the site environmental plan including\
      \ all supplements\\n                                       thereto, or any amended or varied version thereof,\
      \ as submitted by the Contractor\\n                                           in accordance with Employer’s\
      \ Safety, Health and Environmental Manual (SHE\\n                                  Manual), this Clause and\
      \ which has received the Engineer’s consent. The Site\\n                                  Environmental Plan\
      \ shall include detailed policies, procedures and regulations\\n                                   which,\
      \ when implemented,  will ensure compliance  with  this  Clause. The\\n                                  \
      \  Contractor is required to make himself aware of  all the requirements of the\\n                       \
      \          Employer’s SHE Manual in this regard and comply with them.\\n\\n                             The\
      \ Contractor's Site Environmental Plan shall be developed from his Employer’s\\n                         \
      \            Safety. Health and Environmental Manual (SHE Manual), as per the Employer's\\n              \
      \                   Requirements.\\n\\n                       4.17.1      Within stipulated time as mentioned\
      \ in ‘contract data’, the Contractor shall submit\\n                              a detailed and comprehensive\
      \ Site Environmental Plan based on the Employer’s\\n                                     Safety, Health and\
      \ Environmental Manual (SHE Manual), and shall include such\\n                                        further\
      \ material, which the Contractor considers necessary and relevant.\\n\\n                            Upon the\
      \ Engineer notifying his consent to the Site Environmental Plan, or any\\n                               \
      \  supplemental part thereof, the Contractor shall adhere to the principles and\\n                       \
      \          procedures contained in such document save to the extent that the Engineer may\\n             \
      \                       give his consent to any amended or varied version thereof.\\n                    \
      \         The Contractor shall provide all necessary access, assistance and facilities to\\n             \
      \                    enable the Engineer and the Employer to monitor and conduct tests to verify that\\n \
      \                                   the Site Environmental Plan is being properly and fully implemented.\\\
      n\\n      Electricity,       4.18      The Contractor shall be responsible for making his own arrangements\
      \ at his own\\n    Water and Gas                cost to obtain supply of water, electricity or gas for the\
      \ Works. The Employer where\\n                                       feasible may at his discretion assist\
      \ the Contractor in giving recommendatory\\n                                           letters etc.\\n   \
      \  Tools, Plants     4.19       Except for any specific item mentioned in the Special Conditions of Contract\
      \ or in\\n    And Equipment              Employer’s Requirements, the Contractor shall provide  all tools,\
      \ plants and\\n    Supplied By                Equipment  for the Works.  In respect  of such exceptional \
      \ tools, plants  or\\n    The Employer              Equipment committed to be provided by the Employer under\
      \ terms and conditions\\n                                      specified in the Special Conditions of Contract,\
      \ the Contractor shall take  all\\n                                  reasonable care and shall be responsible\
      \ for all damages or loss caused by him,\\n                                       his representatives, sub-contractors\
      \ or his workmen or others while they are in his\\n                                   charge.\\n         \
      \                 No  tools, plant and equipment shall be supplied by the Employer. Unless\\n            \
      \                             specifically incorporated in special conditions, the Contractor has to arrange\
      \ all\\n                                          tools, plant, equipment required for the work.\\n      \
      \                   On completion of the Works, the Contractor shall hand over the unused balance\\n     \
      \                                   of the tools, plants and Equipment supplied by the Employer to the Employer\
      \ back\\n                                           in good order and repair, fair wear and tear expected,\
      \ and shall be responsible for\\n                               any failure to account for the same or any\
      \ damage done thereto.\\n                             The decision of the Engineer as to the amount recoverable\
      \ from the Contractor on\\n                                            this account shall be final and binding.\"\
      \n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 90,\n  \"text\": \"The Contractor shall plan transportation of construction materials\
      \ to work site in\\n                                accordance with traffic regulations enforced by local\
      \ traffic authorities from time to\\n                                   time and in such a way that congestion\
      \ on the roads and road accidents are\\n                                   avoided. The Contractor should\
      \ study this aspect thoroughly before quoting for the\\n                                  work.\\n\\n    \
      \ Contractor to     4.26       During the execution of the Works, the Contractor shall keep the Site free\
      \ from all\\n    keep Site Clear              unnecessary  obstruction, and  shall  store  or  dispose  of\
      \ any  Contractor’s\\n                               Equipment or surplus materials. The Contractor shall\
      \ clear away and remove from\\n                                    the Site any wreckage, rubbish or Temporary\
      \ Works no longer required.\\n                         On completion of the works, the Contractor shall clear\
      \ away and remove from site\\n                                                  all Constructional Plant,\
      \ surplus material and Temporary Works. He should leave\\n                                    the whole of\
      \ the site and Works in a clean, tidy and workman like condition to the\\n                               \
      \         satisfaction of the Engineer.\\n                         On completion of Work the Contractor shall\
      \ also clear away the labour camps,\\n                                hutments and other related installations\
      \ and restore the land to  its original\\n                                     condition to the satisfaction\
      \ of the Engineer within 45 days of the physical\\n                                  completion  of Work.\
      \ The cost on account  of delay  in return  of land and\\n                                   reinstatement\
      \ of original condition within the stipulated time as determined by\\n                                 Engineer\
      \ will be recovered from the Contractor’s dues.\\n                                            All garbage\
      \ shall be removed from site daily or as they accumulate. All surface\\n                              and\
      \ sub-soil drains shall be maintained in a clean, sound and satisfactory state of\\n                     \
      \             performance. No extra payment shall be made on this account.\\n                          No\
      \ final payment in settlement of the accounts for Works shall be made  till, in\\n                       \
      \               addition to any other condition necessary for such final payment, site clearance\\n      \
      \                        and clearances of labour camps etc. shall have been effected by him.  Such\\n   \
      \                               clearance may be made by the Engineer through any other agency at the expense\\\
      n                                        of the Contractor in the event of the Contractor’s failure to comply\
      \ with this\\n                                     provision within 7 days after receiving notice to that\
      \ effect from the Engineer. All\\n                               expenses on such removal / clearance shall\
      \ be debitable to the Contractor as\\n                                   loans due from the Contractor to\
      \ the Employer, and the Employer shall be\\n                                competent to recover the same\
      \ from Contractor’s on-account or final bills, or from\\n                                Performance Security\
      \ amount or from any other amount payable to the Contractor\\n                                           in\
      \ any other Contract.\\n\\n     Security of the   4.27      The Contractor shall take all measures necessary\
      \ to ensure security, including\\n     Site                           exercising control over all persons\
      \ and vehicles which are employed or engaged\\n                              on the Site or in connection\
      \ with the Works or the other works comprising the\\n                                     Project and with\
      \ the security arrangements applicable to any other site within the\\n                                   \
      \    Project.\\n                             The Contractor shall arrange the issue of passes for the admission\
      \ of all persons\\n                              and vehicles to the Site or to any part thereof and may refuse\
      \ admission to or\\n                              remove from the Site any person or vehicle failing to show\
      \ an appropriate pass on\\n                           demand to any duly authorized person.\\n\\n        \
      \                                                   If required by the Engineer, the Contractor shall submit\
      \ a list identifying all persons\\n                                        to whom passes have been issued\
      \ together with two photographs of each person\\n                              and all entities to which a\
      \ pass has been issued in respect of any vehicle and shall\\n                                        satisfy\
      \ the Engineer of the bonafides of any such person or entity.\\n\\n                             The Contractor\
      \ shall not, without the written permission of the Engineer or\\n                                   otherwise\
      \ in accordance with the Contract, allow access to the Site to any person\\n                             \
      \     unless the presence on Site of such person is necessary in connection with the\\n                  \
      \                 execution of the Works or with the discharge of the duties of any relevant authority.\\\
      n\\n                             The Contractor shall be wholly responsible for security of site and Works.\
      \ The\\n                                    Contractor shall follow relevant Safety and Security instructions\
      \ issued by the\\n                                concerned Authorities from time to time and shall work in\
      \ close coordination with\\n                                    the concerned Authorities.\\n\\n     Contractor's\

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 90,\n  \"text\": \"The Contractor shall plan transportation of construction materials\
      \ to work site in\\n                                accordance with traffic regulations enforced by local\
      \ traffic authorities from time to\\n                                   time and in such a way that congestion\
      \ on the roads and road accidents are\\n                                   avoided. The Contractor should\
      \ study this aspect thoroughly before quoting for the\\n                                  work.\\n\\n    \
      \ Contractor to     4.26       During the execution of the Works, the Contractor shall keep the Site free\
      \ from all\\n    keep Site Clear              unnecessary  obstruction, and  shall  store  or  dispose  of\
      \ any  Contractor’s\\n                               Equipment or surplus materials. The Contractor shall\
      \ clear away and remove from\\n                                    the Site any wreckage, rubbish or Temporary\
      \ Works no longer required.\\n                         On completion of the works, the Contractor shall clear\
      \ away and remove from site\\n                                                  all Constructional Plant,\
      \ surplus material and Temporary Works. He should leave\\n                                    the whole of\
      \ the site and Works in a clean, tidy and workman like condition to the\\n                               \
      \         satisfaction of the Engineer.\\n                         On completion of Work the Contractor shall\
      \ also clear away the labour camps,\\n                                hutments and other related installations\
      \ and restore the land to  its original\\n                                     condition to the satisfaction\
      \ of the Engineer within 45 days of the physical\\n                                  completion  of Work.\
      \ The cost on account  of delay  in return  of land and\\n                                   reinstatement\
      \ of original condition within the stipulated time as determined by\\n                                 Engineer\
      \ will be recovered from the Contractor’s dues.\\n                                            All garbage\
      \ shall be removed from site daily or as they accumulate. All surface\\n                              and\
      \ sub-soil drains shall be maintained in a clean, sound and satisfactory state of\\n                     \
      \             performance. No extra payment shall be made on this account.\\n                          No\
      \ final payment in settlement of the accounts for Works shall be made  till, in\\n                       \
      \               addition to any other condition necessary for such final payment, site clearance\\n      \
      \                        and clearances of labour camps etc. shall have been effected by him.  Such\\n   \

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 91,\n  \"text\": \"The Contractor, after obtaining any necessary consent from any\
      \ relevant authority,\\n                                   shall submit to the Engineer proposals showing\
      \ the layout of pedestrian routes,\\n                                     lighting, signs, and guarding any\
      \ road opening or traffic diversion which may be\\n                               required in connection with\
      \ the execution of the Works and which the Contractor\\n                               intends to construct.\
      \ Any consent given by the Engineer to such proposals shall\\n                               not relieve the\
      \ Contractor of any obligation under the Contract or absolve the\\n                               Contractor\
      \  from  any  liability  for  or  arising  from  such  proposals  or  the\\n                             implementation\
      \ thereof.\\n\\n                                      All lights provided by the Contractor shall be so placed\
      \ or screened as not to\\n                                   interfere with signs, signals or lights. The\
      \ Contractor shall not in any way obscure\\n                                or affect signs, signals or lights,\
      \ in use by any relevant authority. In the event that\\n                               the Contractor does\
      \ so, the Contractor shall pay all costs associated with the re-\\n                                      \
      \     fitting, re-instating or provision of alternatives for any sign, signal or light, obscured\\n      \
      \                          or affected.\\n\\n                            For the purposes of this Clause only,\
      \ \\\"Site\\\" shall include off-Site places of\\n                            manufacture or storage and the\
      \ Contractor's Work Areas and shall include, areas\\n                              provided to the Contractor\
      \ by others.\\n\\n Discoveries of   4.29         All fossils, coins, articles of value or antiquity and structures\
      \ and other remains or\\nArchaeological                things of geological or archaeological interest, in\
      \ addition to oil and other minerals\\nand Geological               discovered on the Site shall be the absolute\
      \ property of the Government of India\\nvalue.                     and the Contractor shall take all the necessary\
      \ precautions to prevent its workmen\\n                                or its sub-contractors' workmen or\
      \ any other person from removing or damaging\\n                          any such article or thing and shall\
      \ immediately upon discovery thereof, acquaint\\n                               the Engineer of such discovery\
      \ and carry out the instructions of the Engineer.\\n\\nPublicity          4. 30      The Contractor shall\
      \ not publish or otherwise circulate alone or in conjunction with\\n                          any other person,\
      \ any articles, photographs or other materials relating to the\\n                                Contract,\
      \ the Site, the Works, the Project or any part thereof, nor impart to the\\n                             \
      \  press, or any radio or television network any information relating thereto, nor allow\\n              \
      \            any representative of the media access to the Site, Contractor's Works Areas, or\\n         \
      \                           off-Site place of manufacture, or storage except with the permission, in writing,\
      \ of\\n                               the Employer. The Contractor shall ensure that his sub-contractors of\
      \ any tier\\n                                   shall be bound by a like obligation and shall,  if so required\
      \ by the Employer,\\n                              enforce the same at his own expense. The provisions of\
      \ this Sub-Clause shall not\\n                          exempt the Contractor from complying with any statutory\
      \ provision in regard to the\\n                                taking and publication of photographs.\\n\\\
      nDisclosure of     4.31              If the Contractor or any partner of the Contractor or Director of the\
      \ Contractor’s\\nRelationship              company is closely related to any of the Officers of the Employer\
      \ or the Engineer,\\n                                or alternatively, if any close relative of an officer\
      \ of the Employer or the Engineer\\n                           has financial interest / stake in the Contractor’s\
      \ firm, the same shall be disclosed\\n                           by the Contractor at the time of filing his\
      \ tender. Any failure to disclose the interest\\n                                involved, shall entitle the\
      \ Employer to rescind the Contract, without payment of\\n                          any compensation to the\
      \ Contractor.  The Contractor shall note that he  is\\n                                prohibited from developing\
      \ such interest during the Contract period.\\n\\nUse of           4.32        Explosives  if required on the\
      \ Work shall be used by Contractor only with prior\\nExplosives                  Approval of the Engineer\
      \ and in the manner and to the extent permitted by him.\\n                         The explosives shall be\
      \ handled, stored in a special magazine to be provided at\\n                               the cost of the\
      \ Contractor and used under the strict supervision of persons\\n                               licensed for\
      \ this purpose under the requisite statutory rules and regulations. The\\n                               Contractor\
      \ shall take all precautions in transporting and using the explosives and\\n                             \
      \ avoid damage  to nearby  structures and  utilities. The Contractor  shall be\\n                        \
      \       responsible for taking  all the precautions in the usage of the explosives at\\n                 \
      \               Contractor’s cost, sole risk and responsibility. The Contractor shall hold the\\n        \
      \                   Employer harmless and indemnify for the above.\\nProhibited       4.33\\nconduct\\n  \
      \                4.33.1     The Employer requires  that the Tenderers/Contractors observe the highest\\n \
      \                            standards of ethics during Tendering and execution of this Contract and should\"\
      \n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 91,\n  \"text\": \"The Contractor, after obtaining any necessary consent from any\

- kind: parameter
  text: Prohibited conduct under GCC Sub-Clause 4.33 encompasses corrupt and fraudulent practices, empowering the
    Employer to reject tenders, rescind contracts without compensation except for work done, and declare contractors
    ineligible for a minimum of 2 years.
  evidence_ids:
  - J0096c6ff093139d4
  relation_type: none
  explicitness: not_a_relation
  from_id: ''
  to_id: ''

  - id: J0096c6ff093139d4
    okf_path: OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE.md

    - 92
    sheet_cells: ''
    json_path: parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json

    json_pointer: /clauses/3/fragments/16
    json_record_id: null
    source_review_status: pending_manual_review
    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 92,\n  \"text\": \"not indulge in Prohibited conduct which includes ‘corrupt practice’\
      \ and ‘fraudulent\\n                                        practice’ defined as follows;\\n\\n          \
      \                                              (i)      “corrupt practice” means the offering, giving, receiving\
      \ or soliciting of\\n                                   anything of value to Employer, Engineer or any of\
      \ their employees, influence in\\n                                    the procurement process or during Contract\
      \ execution; and\\n                                                            (ii)      “fraudulent practice”\
      \ means a misrepresentation of facts  in order to\\n                                     influence a procurement\
      \ process or during the execution of a Contract to the\\n                                    detriment of\
      \ the Employer, and includes collusive practice among Tenderers (prior\\n                                \
      \        to or after tender submission) designed to establish tender prices at artificial non-\\n        \
      \                            competitive levels and to deprive the Employer of the benefits of free and open\\\
      n                                     competition.\\n\\n                                        In pursuance\
      \ with this policy, the Employer:\\n\\n                                        a. Will reject the Tender for\
      \ the Work or rescind the Contract,  if the Employer\\n                                 determines that the\
      \ Tenderer/Contractor has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent\\n                                       practices,\
      \ and\\n                                        b. Will declare a Tenderer/Contractor ineligible, either indefinitely\
      \ or for a minimum\\n                                    period of 2 years from the date of identification\
      \ of such prohibited conduct, to be\\n                              awarded a Contract/s  if he at any time\
      \ determines that the Contractor has\\n                              engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practices\
      \ in competing for, or in executing the\\n                                     Contract.\\n\\n    Compensation\
      \   4.33.2       In the event of rescission of Contract under Sub-clause 4.33.1, the Contractor\\n     to\
      \ Contractor                   shall not be entitled to any compensation whatsoever, except for the work done\\\
      n    on rescission              up to the date of rescission.\\n     of Contract\\n    under this\\n     clause\\\
      n\\n     Quality           4.34       Unless otherwise stated in Special Conditions of Contract and/or Employer’s\\\
      n    Assurance                  Requirement, the Contractor  shall  institute a  quality assurance system\
      \  to\\n                                 demonstrate compliance with the requirements of the Contract. Such\
      \ system shall\\n                              be in accordance with the details stated in the Contract. Compliance\
      \ with the\\n                                        quality assurance system shall not relieve the Contractor\
      \ of his duties, obligations\\n                                     or responsibilities.\\n              \
      \                        Details of all procedure and compliance documents shall be submitted to the\\n  \
      \                               Engineer for his consent before each execution stage is commenced.\\n\\n \
      \    Confidentiality   4.35       The Contractor shall not use or divulge, except for the purpose of the Contract\
      \ or\\n     of Information                 with the written permission of the Employer, any information relating\
      \ to the Works\\n                                     or the Project provided in the Contract or otherwise\
      \ provided by the Employer, or\\n                                    the Engineer. The Contractor shall ensure\
      \ that his sub-contractors of any tier shall\\n                              be bound by a like confidentiality\
      \ undertaking.\\n                             The Employer and the Engineer and any third party to whom an\
      \ assignment has\\n                              been made in accordance with Sub-clause 2.4 may use any information\
      \ provided\\n                               by the Contractor in accordance with the Contract. The Employer\
      \ shall use\\n                                  reasonable endeavors to ensure that the Engineer and any third\
      \ party- referred to\\n                                           in aforesaid Sub-Clause 2.4 shall not, divulge\
      \ such information except for any\\n                                purpose connected with the Contract.\"\
      \n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 84,\n  \"text\": \"Access Route    4.11       The Contractor shall be deemed to have\
      \ satisfied himself as to the suitability and\\n                                           availability of\
      \ the access routes he chooses to use. The Contractor shall (as\\n                               between the\
      \ Parties) be responsible for the maintenance of access routes. The\\n                                   \
      \ Contractor shall provide at his cost signs or directions, which he may consider\\n                     \
      \            necessary or as instructed by Engineer for the guidance of his staff, labour and\\n         \
      \                             others. The Contractor shall obtain any permission concessions and related\\\
      n                              easement right that may be required from the relevant authorities for the use\
      \ of\\n                               such routes, signs and directions.\\n                             The\
      \ Contractor shall select routes, choose and use vehicles so that movement of\\n                         \
      \            Contractor’s Equipment, Plant and Materials from and to the Site is limited so that\\n      \
      \                                         traffic is not delayed and damage to highways and bridges is prevented.\
      \ If there\\n                                              is any delay or damage or injury, the cost of rectification\
      \ or reconstruction of\\n                                highways or bridges shall be borne by the Contractor.\
      \ In case of claim arising of\\n                                    the execution of work from any aggrieved\
      \ party, the Contractor shall immediately\\n                                      report the facts to the\
      \ Engineer and negotiate a settlement. The Contractor shall\\n                                   indemnify\
      \ the Employer in respect of all claims, demands, proceedings, damages,\\n                               \
      \       costs, charges and expenses whatsoever arising out of or in relation to any such\\n              \
      \                      matters.\\n                             The Employer will not be responsible for any\
      \ claims which may arise from the use\\n                                     or otherwise of any access route.\
      \ The Employer does not guarantee the suitability\\n                                     or availability of\
      \ any particular access route, and will not entertain any claim for\\n                               any non-suitability\
      \ or non-availability for continuous use during construction of any\\n                               such\
      \ route.\\n\\n    Avoidance of     4.11.1        All operations for the execution of the Works shall be carried\
      \ out so as not to\\n     Interference                     interfere unnecessarily with the convenience of\
      \ the public or the access to public\\n                                     or private roads or footpaths\
      \ or properties owned by the Employer or by any other\\n                                   person.\\n\\n \
      \    Rights of way    4.12       The Employer will acquire and provide land for Permanent Works and right\
      \ of way\\n    and Facilities                   (within BMRCL’s  land)  for access  thereto over routes  established\
      \ by the\\n                                     Contractor. The Contractor shall bear all cost and charges\
      \ for special or temporary\\n                                         rights of way which he may require including\
      \ those for access to the Site. The\\n                                    Contractor shall also obtain, at\
      \ his risk and cost, any additional facility outside the\\n                                       Site which\
      \ he may require for the purpose of the Works. The Employer reserves\\n                                  \
      \  the right to make use of these service roads/rights of way for itself or for other\\n                 \
      \                    contractors working in the area, as and when necessary without any payment to\\n    \
      \                                the Contractor.\\n    Programmes     4.13       The Contractor shall submit\
      \ an Initial programme to the Engineer after receipt of\\n                                    the Letter of\
      \ Acceptance but not later than 28 days from the date of receipt of\\n                                   \
      \    Letter of Acceptance. The Contractor shall also submit a revised programme\\n                       \
      \        whenever the Engineer finds that the previous programme is inconsistent with\\n                 \
      \                    actual progress.\\n\\n                             Each programme shall include the following:\\\
      n                               a    the order in which the Contractor proposes to carry out the Works (including\\\
      n                                    each  stage  of  Design,  procurement,  manufacture,  delivery  to  Site,\\\
      n                                             construction, erection, testing and commissioning),\\n     \
      \                          b      all major events and  activities  in  the progress  of Construction   or\\\
      n                                       Manufacture /Documents; and\\n                                  c\
      \   The sequence of all tests specified in the Contract and Commissioning.\\n                            \
      \   d    Requirement of funds, month wise.\\n\\n                                 Unless otherwise stated in\
      \ the Contract, the programmes shall be developed using\\n                                precedence networking\
      \ techniques, showing early start, late start, early finish and\\n                                       \
      \  late finish dates.\\n\\n                          No  significant  alteration to the programmes, or to\
      \ such arrangements and\\n                                methods, shall be made without obtaining consent\
      \ of the Engineer. If the progress\\n                                        of the Works does not conform\
      \ to the programmes, the Engineer may instruct the\\n                                    Contractor to revise\
      \ the programmes, showing the modifications necessary to\\n                                  achieve completion\
      \ within the Time period for Completion.\\n\\n                             The Engineer shall inform the Contractor\
      \ in writing within 21 days after receipt of\\n                                    the above information;\"\
      \n}"

      \ Data.\\n\\n                                                                ’\\n\\n                     \
      \              4.5.2        Unless otherwise stated in the Special Conditions of Contract.\\n\\n\\n      \
      \                               a) the Contractor shall not be required to obtain consent for purchases of\\\
      n                                      Materials which are in accordance with the standards specified in the\\\
      n                                    Contract or provisions of labour or for the sub-contracts for which the\

      \                                   contractors;\\n                                       c) not less than\

      \ the Contractor  shall  notify the Engineer  of such\\n                                          intention;\
      \ and the Contractor shall give fair and reasonable opportunity for\\n                                   \

      \       The Contractor shall be responsible for observance by  all Sub-\\n                               \

      \ (a)\\n                                     shall constitute a waiver of the Contractor’s obligations under\
      \ this contract. The\\n                                 Contractor shall provide to the Engineer the details\
      \ of subcontracts upon\\n                                request of the Engineer. The Contractor shall Endeavour\
      \ to resolve all matters\\n                            and payments amicably and speedily with the sub-contractors.\\\
      n\\n\\n                                     In the event of contractor’s default for payment to any of the\
      \ sub-contractors or\\n                             Vendors of any tier engaged by him for carrying out of\
      \ this Contract, the\\n                             Employer  shall  reserve  the  right  to make payment\
      \  to  such  affected\\n                                 subcontractors or vendors on behalf of contractor\
      \ and further employer may\\n                           engage the same subcontractor or vendor on behalf\
      \ of contractor and make\\n                            payment directly to complete that part of the work\
      \ and any sums so paid\\n                                   including interest shall be debited to the Contractor’s\
      \ account.\\n\\n                                   4.5.4       The   Contractor   shall  ensure   that   their\

      \ Sub-contractors/Consultants/other\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 83,\n  \"text\": \"Compensation   4.7       Any breach of Sub-clauses 4.5 to 4.6\

      \ or non-availability for continuous use during construction of any\\n                               such\

      \ by the\\n                                     Contractor. The Contractor shall bear all cost and charges\
      \ for special or temporary\\n                                         rights of way which he may require including\
      \ those for access to the Site. The\\n                                    Contractor shall also obtain, at\
      \ his risk and cost, any additional facility outside the\\n                                       Site which\
      \ he may require for the purpose of the Works. The Employer reserves\\n                                  \
      \  the right to make use of these service roads/rights of way for itself or for other\\n                 \
      \                    contractors working in the area, as and when necessary without any payment to\\n    \
      \                                the Contractor.\\n    Programmes     4.13       The Contractor shall submit\
      \ an Initial programme to the Engineer after receipt of\\n                                    the Letter of\
      \ Acceptance but not later than 28 days from the date of receipt of\\n                                   \
      \    Letter of Acceptance. The Contractor shall also submit a revised programme\\n                       \
      \        whenever the Engineer finds that the previous programme is inconsistent with\\n                 \
      \                    actual progress.\\n\\n                             Each programme shall include the following:\\\
      n                               a    the order in which the Contractor proposes to carry out the Works (including\\\
      n                                    each  stage  of  Design,  procurement,  manufacture,  delivery  to  Site,\\\
      n                                             construction, erection, testing and commissioning),\\n     \
      \                          b      all major events and  activities  in  the progress  of Construction   or\\\
      n                                       Manufacture /Documents; and\\n                                  c\
      \   The sequence of all tests specified in the Contract and Commissioning.\\n                            \
      \   d    Requirement of funds, month wise.\\n\\n                                 Unless otherwise stated in\
      \ the Contract, the programmes shall be developed using\\n                                precedence networking\
      \ techniques, showing early start, late start, early finish and\\n                                       \
      \  late finish dates.\\n\\n                          No  significant  alteration to the programmes, or to\
      \ such arrangements and\\n                                methods, shall be made without obtaining consent\
      \ of the Engineer. If the progress\\n                                        of the Works does not conform\
      \ to the programmes, the Engineer may instruct the\\n                                    Contractor to revise\
      \ the programmes, showing the modifications necessary to\\n                                  achieve completion\
      \ within the Time period for Completion.\\n\\n                             The Engineer shall inform the Contractor\
      \ in writing within 21 days after receipt of\\n                                    the above information;\"\
      \n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 84,\n  \"text\": \"Access Route    4.11       The Contractor shall be deemed to have\
      \ satisfied himself as to the suitability and\\n                                           availability of\

      \                             others. The Contractor shall obtain any permission concessions and related\\\
      n                              easement right that may be required from the relevant authorities for the use\
      \ of\\n                               such routes, signs and directions.\\n                             The\
      \ Contractor shall select routes, choose and use vehicles so that movement of\\n                         \
      \            Contractor’s Equipment, Plant and Materials from and to the Site is limited so that\\n      \
      \                                         traffic is not delayed and damage to highways and bridges is prevented.\
      \ If there\\n                                              is any delay or damage or injury, the cost of rectification\
      \ or reconstruction of\\n                                highways or bridges shall be borne by the Contractor.\
      \ In case of claim arising of\\n                                    the execution of work from any aggrieved\
      \ party, the Contractor shall immediately\\n                                      report the facts to the\
      \ Engineer and negotiate a settlement. The Contractor shall\\n                                   indemnify\
      \ the Employer in respect of all claims, demands, proceedings, damages,\\n                               \
      \       costs, charges and expenses whatsoever arising out of or in relation to any such\\n              \
      \                      matters.\\n                             The Employer will not be responsible for any\

      \ or non-availability for continuous use during construction of any\\n                               such\

      n                                             construction, erection, testing and commissioning),\\n     \

      n                                       Manufacture /Documents; and\\n                                  c\

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 81,\n  \"text\": \"experienced contractor at the time of tender, then the Engineer\
      \ shall take\\n                                such delay into account in determining any extension of time\
      \ to which the\\n                                     Contractor is entitled under the Contract.\\n\\n   \
      \                        h      It shall be the responsibility of the Contractor to ensure that the full extent\\\
      n                                         of the Works under the Contract and the works to be carried out\
      \ by\\n                                  Designated Contractors within the Works or, in, on, under, through\
      \ and over\\n                                     the Site are co-ordinated and integrated in their design,\
      \ manufacture,\\n                                           installation and construction. Such responsibility\
      \ shall neither be mitigated\\n                                    nor in any other way affected by virtue\
      \ of similar responsibilities being\\n                                   placed on other contractors.\\n\\\
      n                         The Contractor shall be deemed to have made adequate allowance in the Contract\\\
      n                               Price and in the Works Programme in respect of these obligations.\\n\\n  \
      \                                                 If any act or omission of the Contractor whether directly\
      \ or indirectly results in the\\n                              delay in the execution of the works of a Designated\
      \ Contractor, the Contractor, in\\n                                 addition to his liability in respect of\
      \ Liquidated damages if they become due, shall\\n                          pay  to the Employer, or the Engineer\
      \ may deduct from  Interim Payment\\n                                  Certificates such amount as the Engineer\
      \ shall have certified in respect of\\n                                 additional payments or costs to the\
      \ Designated Contractor in respect of such\\n                                delay.\\n\\nSub-            \
      \   4.5                         The  Contractor  may  sub-contract  works  only  with   prior  consent  of\\\
      nContractors                            Engineer/Employer and limited to the value as stated in ‘contract\
      \ data’.\\n\\n                                   4.5.1       The Contractor shall not subcontract any part\
      \ of works for which\\n                                 subcontracting is not permitted as stated in Contract\
      \ Data.\\n\\n                                                                ’\\n\\n                     \
      \              4.5.2        Unless otherwise stated in the Special Conditions of Contract.\\n\\n\\n      \
      \                               a) the Contractor shall not be required to obtain consent for purchases of\\\
      n                                      Materials which are in accordance with the standards specified in the\\\
      n                                    Contract or provisions of labour or for the sub-contracts for which the\
      \ Sub-\\n                                       contractor is named in the Contract;\\n                  \
      \                   b) the prior consent of the Engineer shall be obtained for other proposed Sub-\\n    \
      \                                   contractors;\\n                                       c) not less than\
      \ 28 days before the intended date of each Sub-contractor\\n                              commencing work,\
      \ the Contractor  shall  notify the Engineer  of such\\n                                          intention;\
      \ and the Contractor shall give fair and reasonable opportunity for\\n                                   \
      \   contractors in India to be appointed as Sub-contractors.\\n\\n\\n                                   4.5.3\
      \       The Contractor shall be responsible for observance by  all Sub-\\n                               \
      \   contractors of  all the provisions of the Contract. The Contractor shall be\\n                       \
      \          responsible for the acts or defaults of any Sub-contractor, his representatives\\n            \
      \                       or employees, as fully as if they were the acts or defaults of the Contractor, his\\\
      n                                  representatives or employees and nothing contained in above Sub-clause\
      \ (a)\\n                                     shall constitute a waiver of the Contractor’s obligations under\
      \ this contract. The\\n                                 Contractor shall provide to the Engineer the details\
      \ of subcontracts upon\\n                                request of the Engineer. The Contractor shall Endeavour\
      \ to resolve all matters\\n                            and payments amicably and speedily with the sub-contractors.\\\
      n\\n\\n                                     In the event of contractor’s default for payment to any of the\
      \ sub-contractors or\\n                             Vendors of any tier engaged by him for carrying out of\
      \ this Contract, the\\n                             Employer  shall  reserve  the  right  to make payment\
      \  to  such  affected\\n                                 subcontractors or vendors on behalf of contractor\
      \ and further employer may\\n                           engage the same subcontractor or vendor on behalf\
      \ of contractor and make\\n                            payment directly to complete that part of the work\
      \ and any sums so paid\\n                                   including interest shall be debited to the Contractor’s\
      \ account.\\n\\n                                   4.5.4       The   Contractor   shall  ensure   that   their\
      \   Sub-contractors,\\n                                material/equipment suppliers, Consultants and other\
      \ agencies deployed by\\n                            them in connection with execution of the Contract do\
      \ not make any claim or\\n                                   raise any dispute before BMRCL. For this, necessary\
      \ provision is to be made in\\n                                 the agreement between Contractor and their\
      \ Sub-contractors/Consultants/other\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 82,\n  \"text\": \"Agencies Similarly the agreement should also incorporate the provision\
      \ of\\n                                    Dispute Resolution. An undertaking in the format provided in contact\
      \ forms shall\\n                                be submitted by Contractor in respect of each such agency:\\\
      n\\n\\n                                         4.5.5      A copy of the contract between the Contractor and\
      \ Sub-Contractor\\n                                           shall be given  to the Engineer and the Contractor\
      \  shall not make any\\n                                       modifications without the Engineer's prior\
      \ written consent. The terms and\\n                                       conditions of subcontracts, including\
      \ payments to subcontractors, shall be the\\n                                       sole responsibility of\
      \ the Contractor, and such payments shall be deemed\\n                                      included in the\
      \ Contract Price. The Contractor shall obtain the Employer's prior\\n                                    \
      \      written consent to the identity of the subcontractor, which shall be granted after\\n             \
      \                         the Employer assesses and  satisfies  itself regarding the subcontractor's\\n  \
      \                                          capability, experience, and equipment resources. The Engineer's\
      \ decision in\\n                                              this regard shall be final and binding. The\
      \ Contractor shall provide sufficient\\n                                    superintendence to ensure that\
      \ work carried out by subcontractors complies\\n                                        with the Contract\
      \ requirements\\n\\n                                         4.5.6        Engineer’s decision to define whether\
      \ the party is subcontractor or\\n                                      not shall be final and binding on\
      \ the Contractor.\\n\\n                                 Employer reserves the right to have access to the\
      \ agreement/MOU between\\n                                      the contractor and the sub-contractor and\
      \ demand a copy of the same for\\n                                       records.\\n                     \
      \         The proposed sub-contract terms and conditions shall impose on the sub-\\n                     \
      \                   contractor such terms of the Contract as are applicable and appropriate to the\\n    \
      \                                     part of the Works to be sub-contracted, to enable the Contractor to\
      \ comply with\\n                                          his obligations under the Contract.\\n\\n      \
      \                                   4.5.7           Notwithstanding any consent  to  sub-contract  given by\
      \  the\\n                                     Engineer, if in his opinion he considers it necessary, the Engineer\
      \ shall have\\n                                                       full power to order the removal of any\
      \ sub-contractor from the Site or off-Site\\n                                     place  of manufacture  or\
      \  storage, which power  shall  not be  exercised\\n                                    unreasonably.\\n\\\
      n                                    Provided  further  that  in the event  of poor/unsatisfactory performance\
      \  of\\n                                      subcontractor in terms of quality, progress, poor workmanship,\
      \ adherence to\\n                                       safety norms the Engineer may order for removal of\
      \ such subcontractor from\\n                                      the site of work. The Contractor shall demobilize/remove\
      \ such subcontractor\\n                                         within 10 days from the receipt of such instructions\
      \ from the Engineer.\\n\\n    Assignment of   4.6       The Contractor shall not assign a right or benefit\
      \ under the Contract without first\\n     Contractor’s                  obtaining Employer’s prior written\
      \ consent, otherwise than by:\\n    and Sub-\\n     contractor’s                    a.   a charge in favour\
      \ of the Contractor’s bankers of any money due or to\\n     Obligations                   become due under\
      \ the Contract, or\\n                                        b.    Assignment to the Contractor’s insurers\
      \ (in cases where the insurers have\\n                                       discharged the Contractor’s loss\
      \ or liability) of the Contractor’s right to obtain\\n                                                   \
      \   relief against any other party liable.\\n\\n                                                         \
      \   If a Subcontractor’s obligations extend beyond the expiry date of Defects Liability\\n               \
      \                      Period, then the Contractor shall assign the benefits of such obligations to the\\\
      n                                 Employer.\\n                                        In the event that a\
      \ sub-contractor of any tier provides to the Contractor or any\\n                                     other\
      \ sub-contractor a warranty in respect of Plant, Materials or services supplied\\n                       \
      \                    in connection with the Works, or undertakes a continuing obligation of any nature\\n\
      \                                whatsoever in relation to such Plant, Materials or services (including without\\\
      n                                          limitation an obligation to maintain stocks of spare parts) extending\
      \ for a period\\n                                 exceeding that of the Defects Liability Period or where\
      \ there is more than one\\n                                  Defects Liability Period exceeding that of the\
      \ latest Defects Liability Period, and if\\n                                    the Engineer so directs in\
      \ writing within 21 days of the expiry of the Defects\\n                                             Liability\
      \ Period or the latest Defects Liability Period (as the case may be), the\\n                             \
      \       Contractor shall immediately assign or obtain the assignment of the benefit of such\\n           \
      \                       warranty or obligation to the Employer or at the direction of the Employer, to any\\\
      n                                           third party referred to in Sub-Clause 2.4.\"\n}"

      \   relief against any other party liable.\\n\\n                                                         \
      \   If a Subcontractor’s obligations extend beyond the expiry date of Defects Liability\\n               \
      \                      Period, then the Contractor shall assign the benefits of such obligations to the\\\
      n                                 Employer.\\n                                        In the event that a\
      \ sub-contractor of any tier provides to the Contractor or any\\n                                     other\
      \ sub-contractor a warranty in respect of Plant, Materials or services supplied\\n                       \
      \                    in connection with the Works, or undertakes a continuing obligation of any nature\\n\
      \                                whatsoever in relation to such Plant, Materials or services (including without\\\
      n                                          limitation an obligation to maintain stocks of spare parts) extending\
      \ for a period\\n                                 exceeding that of the Defects Liability Period or where\
      \ there is more than one\\n                                  Defects Liability Period exceeding that of the\
      \ latest Defects Liability Period, and if\\n                                    the Engineer so directs in\
      \ writing within 21 days of the expiry of the Defects\\n                                             Liability\
      \ Period or the latest Defects Liability Period (as the case may be), the\\n                             \
      \       Contractor shall immediately assign or obtain the assignment of the benefit of such\\n           \
      \                       warranty or obligation to the Employer or at the direction of the Employer, to any\\\
      n                                           third party referred to in Sub-Clause 2.4.\"\n}"

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 83,\n  \"text\": \"Compensation   4.7       Any breach of Sub-clauses 4.5 to 4.6\
      \ shall entitle the Employer to rescind the\\nfor Breach                    Contract under Sub-Clause 13.2\
      \ and render the Contractor liable for any loss or\\n                        damage arising from such termination\\\
      nSetting Out       4.8\\nAccurate          4.8.1      The Contractor shall be responsible for\\nSetting Out\\\
      n                                   (a) the accurate setting out of the Works in relation to the original\
      \ points, lines and\\n                                      levels of reference given in the documents provided\
      \ by the Engineer in writing.\\n                                   (b) the correctness of position, levels,\
      \ dimensions and alignments of all parts of\\n                                   the Works\\n            \
      \                        (c) the provisions of all necessary instruments, equipment, apparatus and labour\\\
      n                                          in connection with the foregoing responsibilities\\n          \
      \                         (d) Carefully protecting and preserving all bench marks, sight rails, pegs and other\\\
      n                                    things used in setting out the Works\\n                         The checking\
      \ of any setting-out or of any line or level by the Engineer shall not in\\n                          any\
      \ way relieve the Contractor of his responsibility for the accuracy or correctness\\n                    \
      \            thereof and the Contractor shall carefully protect and preserve all bench-marks,\\n         \
      \                            sight-rails, pegs and other things used in setting out the Works.\\n\\nErrors\
      \ in          4.8.2             If at any time during the execution of the Work, an error appears in the positions,\\\
      nSetting out                      levels, dimensions or alignment of any part of the Works, the Contractor\
      \ on being\\n                               required to do so by the Engineer shall, at Contractor’s cost,\
      \ rectify such error to\\n                               the satisfaction of the Engineer.\\nSite Data   \
      \      4.9       The Employer shall have made available to the Contractor with the Tender\\n             \
      \             documents such relevant data in Employer’s possession on Geo technical data\\n             \
      \             and sub-surface conditions. The accuracy or reliability of the data/studies/reports\\n     \
      \                     and of any other information supplied at any time by the Employer or Engineer is\\n\
      \                               not warranted with respect to the viability of his Design and execution of\
      \ Works\\n                          and the Contractor shall be responsible for interpreting all such data\
      \ any error,\\n                               discrepancies. The Contractor shall conduct further investigations\
      \ considered\\n                            necessary by him at his own cost and any error, discrepancies \
      \ if found in\\n                             Employer’s data at any stage will not constitute ground for any\
      \ claim for extra time\\n                          and costs.\\n                         The Contractor shall\
      \ not be relieved from any risk or obligation imposed on or\\n                            undertaken by him\
      \ under the Contract on any such ground or on the ground that\\n                          he did not or could\
      \ not foresee any matter which may affect or have affected the\\n                              execution of\
      \ the Works, or compliance with his other obligations under the\\n                                Contract.\\\
      n\\n                         The Contractor shall be deemed to have obtained all necessary information as\
      \ to\\n                                    risks, contingencies and other circumstances which may influence\
      \ or affect the\\n                           Tender or Works.\\n\\n                        The Contractor\
      \ shall also be deemed to have inspected and examined the Site, its\\n                              surroundings,\
      \ the above data and other available information with respect to the\\n                                  \
      \     viability of his Design and execution of Works and to have satisfied himself before\\n             \
      \                  submitting the Tender, as to all the relevant matters including without limitation:\\n\\\
      n                                            (a) the form and nature of the Site, including the sub-surface\
      \ conditions;\\n                                            (b) the hydrological and climatic conditions;\\\
      n                                              (c) the extent and nature of the work, Plant, and Materials\
      \ necessary for\\n                                           the execution and completion of the Works and\
      \ the remedying of any\\n                                             defects;\\n                        \
      \                    (d) the applicable laws, procedures and labour practices\\n                         \
      \                   (e) The Contractor’s requirement for access, accommodation, facilities,\\n           \
      \                               personnel, power, transport and other services.\\n                       \
      \                                 (f)  the risk of injury or damage to property adjacent to the Site and to\
      \ the\\n                                         occupiers of such property or any other risk.\\n\\nSufficiency\
      \ of    4.10       The Contractor shall be deemed to have satisfied himself as to the correctness\\naccepted\
      \                  and sufficiency of the Contract Price. Unless otherwise stated in the Contract, the\\nContract\
      \                     Contract Price shall cover all his obligations under the Contract and all things\\nAmount\
      \                     necessary for the proper design, execution and completion of the Works, testing\\n \
      \                         and commissioning and remedying of any defects.\"\n}"

- kind: review_question
  text: GCC 4.32 contains generic conditional wording on Engineer-approved explosives, while Volume 2 Scope Clause
    11 expressly states that use of explosives will not be permitted. Preserve both source statements and cross-reference
    the scope prohibition beside the GCC summary; the generic text must not be presented alone as permission for
    this demolition package. This draft finding does not decide document precedence or legal applicability.
  evidence_ids:
  - J919318f1e3e3911e
  - J2b2f745124be1231
  relation_type: none
  explicitness: not_a_relation

    quote: "{\n  \"pdf_page\": 91,\n  \"text\": \"The Contractor, after obtaining any necessary consent from any\
      \ relevant authority,\\n                                   shall submit to the Engineer proposals showing\
      \ the layout of pedestrian routes,\\n                                     lighting, signs, and guarding any\
      \ road opening or traffic diversion which may be\\n                               required in connection with\
      \ the execution of the Works and which the Contractor\\n                               intends to construct.\
      \ Any consent given by the Engineer to such proposals shall\\n                               not relieve the\
      \ Contractor of any obligation under the Contract or absolve the\\n                               Contractor\
      \  from  any  liability  for  or  arising  from  such  proposals  or  the\\n                             implementation\
      \ thereof.\\n\\n                                      All lights provided by the Contractor shall be so placed\
      \ or screened as not to\\n                                   interfere with signs, signals or lights. The\
      \ Contractor shall not in any way obscure\\n                                or affect signs, signals or lights,\
      \ in use by any relevant authority. In the event that\\n                               the Contractor does\
      \ so, the Contractor shall pay all costs associated with the re-\\n                                      \
      \     fitting, re-instating or provision of alternatives for any sign, signal or light, obscured\\n      \
      \                          or affected.\\n\\n                            For the purposes of this Clause only,\
      \ \\\"Site\\\" shall include off-Site places of\\n                            manufacture or storage and the\
      \ Contractor's Work Areas and shall include, areas\\n                              provided to the Contractor\
      \ by others.\\n\\n Discoveries of   4.29         All fossils, coins, articles of value or antiquity and structures\
      \ and other remains or\\nArchaeological                things of geological or archaeological interest, in\
      \ addition to oil and other minerals\\nand Geological               discovered on the Site shall be the absolute\
      \ property of the Government of India\\nvalue.                     and the Contractor shall take all the necessary\
      \ precautions to prevent its workmen\\n                                or its sub-contractors' workmen or\
      \ any other person from removing or damaging\\n                          any such article or thing and shall\
      \ immediately upon discovery thereof, acquaint\\n                               the Engineer of such discovery\
      \ and carry out the instructions of the Engineer.\\n\\nPublicity          4. 30      The Contractor shall\
      \ not publish or otherwise circulate alone or in conjunction with\\n                          any other person,\
      \ any articles, photographs or other materials relating to the\\n                                Contract,\
      \ the Site, the Works, the Project or any part thereof, nor impart to the\\n                             \
      \  press, or any radio or television network any information relating thereto, nor allow\\n              \
      \            any representative of the media access to the Site, Contractor's Works Areas, or\\n         \
      \                           off-Site place of manufacture, or storage except with the permission, in writing,\
      \ of\\n                               the Employer. The Contractor shall ensure that his sub-contractors of\
      \ any tier\\n                                   shall be bound by a like obligation and shall,  if so required\
      \ by the Employer,\\n                              enforce the same at his own expense. The provisions of\
      \ this Sub-Clause shall not\\n                          exempt the Contractor from complying with any statutory\
      \ provision in regard to the\\n                                taking and publication of photographs.\\n\\\
      nDisclosure of     4.31              If the Contractor or any partner of the Contractor or Director of the\
      \ Contractor’s\\nRelationship              company is closely related to any of the Officers of the Employer\
      \ or the Engineer,\\n                                or alternatively, if any close relative of an officer\
      \ of the Employer or the Engineer\\n                           has financial interest / stake in the Contractor’s\
      \ firm, the same shall be disclosed\\n                           by the Contractor at the time of filing his\

## Key Parameters and Source Statements

- The Contract Data establishes key project parameters including a 12-month completion period, 5% performance security, milestone-based liquidated damages capped at 5% of the contract price, and a 6-month defects liability period.
  - **Draft review note:** Contract Data baseline: six months. The Contract Agreement template separately states twelve months; discrepancy unresolved. Supporting finding: `Ccbee310449417dd2`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data|General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 143; quotation `J099b5fe5de51f74d`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/contract_data_table.json#/items/10`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data|General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 142; quotation `J50cf7f54666ad6c6`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/contract_data_table.json#/items/8`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data|General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 142; quotation `J6d08f664b55a27f6`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/contract_data_table.json#/items/7`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data|General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 142; quotation `J8bd217cf1c0cb384`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/contract_data_table.json#/items/1`.

- The Defects Liability Period is specified as 6 months from the date of Taking Over Certificates being issued for the whole of the work.
  - **Draft review note:** Contract Data baseline: six months. The Contract Agreement template separately states twelve months; discrepancy unresolved. Supporting finding: `Ccbee310449417dd2`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data|General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 143; quotation `J099b5fe5de51f74d`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/contract_data_table.json#/items/10`.

- The Engineer has explicit authority to oversee works, monitor test results, and issue necessary instructions for execution, but holds no authority to amend the Contract or relieve the Contractor of its obligations.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 3 — The Engineer|Clause 3 — The Engineer]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 75, 76; quotation `Jfc9714b11b6c93cb`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/2`.

- The successful tenderer must furnish a Performance Security either as an unconditional and irrevocable e-Bank Guarantee from an Indian Scheduled Bank or scheduled Foreign Bank, or as an Insurance Surety Bond from an IRDA-authorized insurer.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 4 — The Contractor|Clause 4 — The Contractor]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 78; quotation `J53354df6bf3b7556`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/3/fragments/2`.

- Performance Security is required to be valid and enforceable up to 60 days beyond the completion period, and extensions must be provided by the contractor at their own cost if the completion period is extended.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 4 — The Contractor|Clause 4 — The Contractor]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 78; quotation `J53354df6bf3b7556`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/3/fragments/2`.

- The Contractor must submit an initial programme using precedence networking techniques to the Engineer no later than 28 days from the date of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 4 — The Contractor|Clause 4 — The Contractor]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 84; quotation `J18ff8ca501f1ddf3`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/3/fragments/8`.

- Sub-contracting of works is permitted only with the prior consent of the Engineer or Employer and is limited to the value stated in the Contract Data, and the Contractor remains fully responsible for all acts, defaults, and omissions of any sub-contractor.
  - **Draft review note:** Historical GCC 4.5 wording only: Corrigendum 2 adds SCC 4 instructing deletion of GCC 4.5. Do not present this baseline permission as an unamended operative requirement. Supporting finding: `C83e868feeefc8e7a`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 4 — The Contractor|Clause 4 — The Contractor]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 81; quotation `J9c3e04f4e576342b`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/3/fragments/5`.

- Under GCC Clause 5.3, the Engineer's review period for each Construction and/or Manufacture Document shall not exceed 21 days from receipt, unless otherwise stated in the Employer's Requirements.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 5 — Design|Clause 5 — Design]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 92, 93, 94, 95, 96, 97; quotation `J77b7b5d197f3383c`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/4`.

- Under GCC Clause 6.3, the Contractor must not employ any retired employee of the Employer or Engineer unless they have completed at least two years post-retirement or obtained a no-objection certificate from the Employer.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 6 — Staff and Labour|Clause 6 — Staff and Labour]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 97, 98, 99, 100; quotation `Jf60d5499e22ff823`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/5`.

- The Contractor must submit its proposed Site Quality Plan based on the Outline Quality Plan and ISO 9001-1991 standards within 30 days of receiving the Letter of Acceptance, with any supplements submitted at least 14 days before work commencement.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 7 — Quality Control|Clause 7 — Quality Control]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 100, 101, 102, 103, 104; quotation `Jec665a3a5a7e3d74`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/6`.

- Tests on Completion include pre-commissioning tests (dry or cold functional tests), commissioning tests (operational tests), and trial operation, following a 21-day notice period given by the Contractor to the Engineer.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 7 — Quality Control|Clause 7 — Quality Control]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 100, 101, 102, 103, 104; quotation `Jec665a3a5a7e3d74`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/6`.

- Statutory safety approvals and sanctions from the Commissioner of Railway Safety or Commissioner of Metro Railway Safety (CMRS) are mandatory prior to the commissioning and public passenger introduction of the system.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 7 — Quality Control|Clause 7 — Quality Control]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 100, 101, 102, 103, 104; quotation `Jec665a3a5a7e3d74`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/6`.

- The Defects Liability Period is specified as 6 months from the date of Taking Over Certificates being issued for the whole of the works, and is extendable if the works cannot be used due to defects or damage.
  - **Draft review note:** Contract Data baseline: six months. The Contract Agreement template separately states twelve months; discrepancy unresolved. Supporting finding: `Ccbee310449417dd2`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 10 — Defects Liability|Clause 10 — Defects Liability]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 108, 109, 110; quotation `J3ee05cf07206532c`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/9`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data|General Conditions of Contract and Contract Data]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 143; quotation `J099b5fe5de51f74d`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/contract_data_table.json#/items/10`.

- Contract Price provisions under GCC Clause 11 establish rules for output GST reimbursement, changes in law, custom duty project import benefits, and detailed price variation formulas covering labour, fuel, materials, plant, steel, and cement components.
  - **Draft review note:** Historical GCC price-variation text: Corrigendum 2 adds SCC 6 instructing deletion of GCC 11.1.2 and 11.1.2.1–11.1.2.4; its Contract Data amendment retains NOT APPLICABLE. Supporting finding: `C91113f62b7e67b8e`.
  - Evidence: [[OKF_bundle/Technical/Vol1/secE#Clause 11 — Contract Price and Payment|Clause 11 — Contract Price and Payment]]; `Vol1DLNP1.pdf`; PDF page(s) 115; quotation `J39a95f3672044adc`. JSON: `parsed_json/vol1/section_e_gcc/gcc_clauses.json#/clauses/10/fragments/5`.
